advancedExpressions.example: The clue to lasting happiness lies not in what we own but in the quality of the bonds we nurture. （not...but 对照，点明核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She found a clue and became excited.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her heart leapt the instant her fingers brushed the hidden note, for she knew at once that this fragile scrap of paper was the clue that would finally lead her to the truth. （读后续写·发现·激动）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 身体反应(heart leapt) + 时间连词(the instant) + 动作细节(fingers brushed) + 结果从句强化意义(the clue that would...)

sentenceUpgrade.original: People's actions can tell you about their character.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: More often than not, it is not grand declarations but the smallest, most unconscious actions that offer the truest clues to a person's character. （议论文·识人·观点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语(More often than not) + it is not...but 强调句 + 最高级并列(smallest, most unconscious)突出对比

classPractice.question: 警方仍在寻找能帮助搜索失踪女孩的线索。Police are still looking for ____ in their search for the missing girl.
classPractice.note: 【课件】原题（Reading LP 语境应用）。考点:look for clues '寻找线索',clue 可数,此处用复数。

classPractice.question: The mysterious note turned out to be the only clue ____ the whereabouts of the missing painting.
classPractice.note: 考点:固定搭配 a clue to sth,介词用to,不用of。

classPractice.question: 老实说,我对他为什么突然离开一无所知。To be honest, I ____ ____ ____ ____ why he suddenly left.
classPractice.answer: don't have a clue / haven't got a clue
classPractice.note: 考点:not have a clue '一无所知',口语强调完全不知情。

classPractice.question: 请把下句译成英文:随着一条条线索被挖出,真相渐渐清晰起来。
classPractice.answer: As the clues were dug up one by one, the truth gradually took shape / became clear.
classPractice.note: 考点:clue 与 dig up 呼应课文;take shape '逐渐成形'。

translation: vt. 把（动物）关在笼中 | n. 笼子
original_sentence: Read these lines, pay attention to the image of the caged bird and try to find out what it means.
readingExamples: Read these lines, pay attention to the image of the caged bird and try to find out what it means.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a structure made of wires or bars in which birds or animals are kept
(2) n. a similar structure used to protect people or things, or as a lift in a mine
(3) vt. to put or keep a bird or an animal in a cage; to confine
(4) vt. (often passive) to trap or restrict someone so that they lose their freedom

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）束缚，牢笼（象征限制自由的处境）
uncommonMeanings.example: The dull routine of the office had become a gilded cage, and each morning she longed a little more fiercely for the open sky beyond the window. （读后续写·困境·渴望自由）

posExamples.sentence: The caged bird sang a trembling song of a distant sky it could no longer see, and something in that sound made the little girl press her hand against the cold bars and quietly weep. （读后续写·象征·自由）
I strongly believe that no wild creature should ever be caged for our amusement, and I am writing to urge our club to support the local wildlife protection campaign. （应用文·倡议信）
To cage a spirit that yearns to soar is, in the end, futile; true freedom, like a caged bird's song, cannot be silenced forever. （议论文·自由·论证）
When at last the rescuers unlatched the rusty cage, the frightened fox hesitated at the open door, unable to believe that the wide green world was truly his again. （读后续写·救助·重获自由）

wordForms.adjective: caged（a. 关在笼中的，被困的）
wordForms.other: cagey / cagy(a. 谨慎的,守口如瓶的);rib cage(n. 胸腔);易混拼写:cage(笼)≠cave(洞穴)≠gauge(测量);注意 cage→caged 去e加ed。

idioms.translation: 惹恼某人，激怒某人
idioms.example: His mocking grin was clearly meant to rattle her cage, but she refused to give him the satisfaction of a reaction. （读后续写·冲突·克制）

idioms.translation: 镀金的牢笼（指看似优渥、实则不自由的处境）
idioms.example: For all its comfort, the mansion felt to her like a gilded cage, and no amount of luxury could fill the ache for a life of her own choosing. （读后续写·矛盾·渴望自由）

collocations.phrase: a caged bird（课文原句·象征）
collocations.example: Read these lines, pay attention to the image of the caged bird and try to find out what it means. 读这几行,留意'笼中鸟'这一意象,试着弄清它的含义。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: cage vt. 把……关进笼中 / n. 笼子（课堂·一词两性）
collocations.translation: 作动词'关进笼中';作名词'笼子'
collocations.example: It is cruel to cage a wild animal that longs for the open sky. 把渴望天空的野生动物关进笼里是残忍的。
He could no longer bear to keep the injured eagle in a cage once its broken wing had healed. （读后续写·善良·抉择）
An empty bird cage swung gently by the window, a silent reminder of the friend who had at last flown free. （读后续写·象征·离别）
She paced the tiny room like a caged animal, her restless energy with nowhere to go. （读后续写·焦躁·画面）

collocations.phrase: release / free sth from a cage
collocations.example: The moment they freed the parrots from their cage, a burst of colour exploded into the morning air. （读后续写·释放·喜悦）
Against all odds the clever raven escaped from its cage, and the children cheered as if it were their own freedom won. （读后续写·励志·自由）
He felt caged in by everyone's expectations, until one bold decision finally set his true self free. （读后续写·成长·突破）

collocations.translation: 金丝笼（喻富足却不自由的生活）
collocations.example: Wealth had built her a golden cage, yet all she truly craved was the simple freedom to be ordinary. （议论文·自由与财富·论证）
His heart pounded so violently against his rib cage that he was sure the whole room could hear it. （读后续写·紧张·身体反应）

synonyms.example: Illness had confined the old sailor to his bed, yet in his dreams he still rode the roaring waves of his youth. （读后续写·困境·精神自由）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:confine 是正式动词，泛指限制、局限（空间或抽象），程度可轻可重;cage 作动词更具体、更形象，特指'关进笼子'般的困住。

synonyms.example: Trapped by the rising floodwaters, the villagers climbed to their rooftops and waited, hour after anxious hour, for rescue. （读后续写·灾难·求生）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:trap 强调突然陷入无法脱身的处境，常有危险意味;cage 强调被围困、失去自由，情感上更偏'束缚、压抑'。

synonyms.example: Grief seemed to imprison her heart, until a stranger's small kindness gently unlocked the door. （读后续写·情感·治愈）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:imprison 语气最重，指关押或（比喻）严重禁锢;cage 兼有具体（关笼）与比喻（束缚）双重用法，画面感更强。

advancedExpressions.expression: cage sth / be caged in / a caged bird / a gilded cage / rattle sb's cage
advancedExpressions.example: Trapped in a gilded cage of others' expectations, he felt as caged as any bird behind bars. 困在他人期望的金丝笼里,他觉得自己就像笼中之鸟。

advancedExpressions.expression: cage 名词'笼子',动词'关进笼中',过去分词caged作定语'笼中的'
advancedExpressions.example: They caged the parrot (v.); the caged parrot (adj.) missed the sky; its cage (n.) hung by the window. 三种用法各司其职。

advancedExpressions.expression: like a caged bird, sb. longed for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like a caged bird beating its wings against the bars, she longed for a horizon wider than the four grey walls of her routine. （明喻+象征，续写刻画对自由的渴望）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us not cage ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us not cage these magnificent creatures for a moment's amusement, but pledge instead to protect the wild homes that are rightfully theirs. （倡议信结尾，not...but 对照呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: no cage, however golden, can ...
advancedExpressions.example: No cage, however golden, can silence the deep human yearning to be free; it is this yearning that has driven every great struggle in history. （however 让步+隐喻，深化自由主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bird was in a cage and wanted to be free.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Behind the cold iron bars, the little bird pressed against the door and sang on, its trembling notes carrying a longing for the boundless sky that no cage could ever contain. （读后续写·象征·渴望自由）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语前置(Behind...bars) + 拟人(pressed, sang on) + 心理投射(a longing for) + 象征收束(no cage could contain)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not keep wild animals in cages.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To cage a wild creature is to rob it of the very wildness that makes it magnificent; if we truly admire these animals, we must learn to love them enough to let them roam free. （议论文·动物保护·论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: To do is to do 定义式主句 + the very...that 强调定语从句 + 分号递进 + enough to 结构升华论点

classPractice.question: The image of the ____ (cage) bird in the poem stands for a soul that longs to be free.
classPractice.note: 考点:cage 过去分词caged作定语'被关在笼中的',呼应课文意象。

classPractice.question: 把渴望蓝天的鸟关进笼子是残忍的。It is cruel ____ ____ a bird that ____ for the open sky.
classPractice.note: 考点:cage 作及物动词'关进笼中';long for '渴望'。

classPractice.question: 请把下句译成英文:再豪华的金丝笼也困不住一颗向往自由的心。
classPractice.answer: No gilded cage, however luxurious, can trap a heart that yearns for freedom.
classPractice.note: 考点:a gilded cage 习语;however+adj. 让步。

translation: n. （鸟的）啭鸣；颤音 | vt. 欢快地高声说 | vi. 发颤音
definitionEn:
(1) n. a high, quavering sound made by a bird or by a human voice as it rises and falls rapidly
(2) n. (in music) an ornament produced by rapidly alternating between two adjacent notes
(3) vi. (of a bird or singer) to produce a rapid, vibrating series of notes
(4) vt. to say or sing something in a bright, high, quavering voice

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （语音学）颤音（如西班牙语中舌尖颤动的 r 音）
uncommonMeanings.example: The Spanish teacher rolled the rolling r into a perfect trill, and the whole class leaned forward, trying in vain to make their stubborn tongues obey. （读后续写·语言课堂·模仿发音）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （电话、铃声等）发出连续清脆的颤响
uncommonMeanings.example: Somewhere down the empty corridor a phone began to trill, its shrill insistence slicing through the midnight silence like a blade. （读后续写·悬疑·深夜来电）

posExamples.sentence: At the first pale hint of dawn, a solitary lark rose from the dew-soaked meadow, and its silvery trill spilled across the valley, as though the morning itself had found a voice. （读后续写·自然清晨·希望降临）
The moment the audition doors opened, the nervous girl steadied her breath and let her voice trill effortlessly up the scale, silencing every whisper in the crowded hall. （读后续写·选拔·逆袭）
I am writing to invite you to our spring campus concert, where the trill of the flute and the warm hum of the cello will weave an evening you are sure to treasure. （应用文·邀请信）
It is often the smallest joys — a child who trills a nursery rhyme on the bus, a stranger who hums along — that remind us how naturally the human heart reaches for music. （议论文·音乐与人性）

wordForms.other: trilling (现在分词/动名词); trilled (过去式/过去分词)

collocations.phrase: a bird's trill / the trill of a bird（课堂·核心义n.）
collocations.example: At dawn the trill of a lark filled the quiet valley. 拂晓时分,云雀的啭鸣充满了寂静的山谷。

collocations.phrase: trill (vi.) 发出颤音 / (vt.) 用颤声唱说（课堂·动词）
collocations.translation: (鸟、人声、乐器)发颤音;婉转地唱
collocations.example: A canary trilled happily in its cage by the window. 窗边笼中的金丝雀欢快地啭鸣着。
A skylark's trill drifted down from the cloudless sky, so pure that the weary travellers paused, forgetting for a moment how far they still had to walk. （读后续写·旅途·慰藉）

collocations.phrase: the trill of a flute / whistle
collocations.example: The distant trill of a flute floated over the lake, and the ripples seemed to dance in time with the melody. （读后续写·湖畔·意境）
With a delicate musical trill, the pianist brought the sonata to its shimmering close, and the audience held its breath. （应用文·音乐会报道）
The children trilled with laughter as the puppy chased its own tail across the sunlit lawn. （读后续写·童趣·温馨）
From the topmost branch came a high, clear trill, announcing that spring had at last returned to the frozen woods. （读后续写·季节·转机）
She trilled a cheerful tune while packing the picnic basket, her good spirits infecting everyone in the kitchen. （读后续写·出游·愉悦）
As the final chorus swelled, she let her voice trill above the choir, a thread of gold woven through the harmony. （读后续写·合唱·闪光时刻）
The nightingale burst into a trill so sudden and so sweet that the lovers on the bridge fell silent, unwilling to break the spell. （读后续写·夜色·浪漫）

synonyms.example: Deep in the hedgerow a wren warbled its endless, liquid song, indifferent to the storm gathering overhead. （读后续写·自然·顽强）
synonyms.usage: 与 trill 都指鸟鸣婉转颤动;warble 更强调音调连续起伏、如流水般绵延,trill 更强调快速震颤的高音

synonyms.example: Sparrows chirped busily in the eaves as the old man scattered crumbs across the frosty courtyard. （读后续写·冬日·温情）
synonyms.usage: chirp 指短促、单调的叫声,声音简单;trill 是连续、婉转、有颤音的悦耳声,层次更丰富

synonyms.example: His voice quavered with emotion as he thanked the teacher who had never once given up on him. （读后续写·师恩·感激）
synonyms.usage: quaver 多指因情绪激动或紧张导致声音不由自主地颤抖,常含脆弱感;trill 指有意为之的悦耳颤音,多为褒义

advancedExpressions.expression: trill(婉转颤鸣) / warble(如流水般起伏) / chirp(短促啁啾) / quaver(颤抖发声)
advancedExpressions.example: The sparrow chirped, the thrush warbled, and high above them a lark trilled its silver song. 麻雀啁啾,画眉婉转,而在它们上方云雀发出银铃般的颤鸣。

advancedExpressions.expression: the trill of ... broke the silence, as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The trill of a lone thrush broke the silence, as if nature itself were urging her to take the first, trembling step forward. （以鸟鸣拟人化推动人物心理,续写转折段）

advancedExpressions.expression: from ... came the trill of ..., filling the air with ...
advancedExpressions.example: From the open windows of the music room came the trill of eager young voices, filling the whole campus with the unmistakable warmth of spring. （介词短语前置+抽象名词收束,活动通讯生动开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a single trill can ..., so too can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a single trill can transform a silent dawn into a symphony of hope, so too can one act of kindness set an entire community singing.

sentenceUpgrade.original: A bird sang in the morning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the first sunbeam pierced the mist, a small bird tilted back its head and poured out a trill so joyous that the whole waking wood seemed to hold its breath and listen. （读后续写·清晨·生机）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句(As...)营造画面 + 动作细节(tilted back its head) + 拟人(the wood held its breath) + so...that 结果状语放大感染力

sentenceUpgrade.original: The music at the concert was beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I shall long remember how the delicate trill of the violin rose above the hushed hall, a moment of such fragile beauty that many in the audience found their eyes unexpectedly bright with tears. （应用文·音乐会观后感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I shall long remember how... 正式回忆句式 + 抽象名词具体化(the trill of the violin) + 同位语评点(a moment of...) + 情感收束(eyes bright with tears)

classPractice.question: 选词填空(trill / roar / whisper):At the first light of dawn, a lark rose into the sky and its clear ____ spilled across the meadow.
classPractice.note: 考点:trill 指鸟的清亮颤鸣,契合云雀+黎明的语境。

classPractice.question: A canary was ____ (trill) merrily in its cage as the morning sun streamed in.
classPractice.note: 考点:trill 作不及物动词'发颤鸣',过去进行时用trilling。

classPractice.question: 请把下句译成英文:远处传来一支长笛的颤音,在湖面上久久回荡。
classPractice.answer: From afar came the trill of a flute, echoing long over the lake.
classPractice.note: 考点:the trill of a flute 搭配;from afar 前置引出画面。

translation: vt. 解释，说明；把……理解为，领会；演绎 | vi. 口译
original_sentence: Experts provide interpretations of Du Fu’s works from different perspectives.
readingExamples: Experts provide interpretations of Du Fu’s works from different perspectives.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to explain the meaning of something, or to understand it in a particular way
(2) v. to translate one spoken language into another (as an interpreter)
(3) v. to perform a piece of music, a role, or a work of art in a way that shows your understanding of it
(4) v. to decide that something has a particular meaning and to understand it in this way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】interpreter 口译员；演绎的人（interpret 的派生名词）
uncommonMeanings.example: As an interpreter, she rendered the speaker's every word into fluent Chinese without a moment's hesitation. 作为口译员，她把讲者的每句话都毫不迟疑地译成流利的中文。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】interpretation 解释；演绎（interpret 的派生名词，可作多种解读 be open to interpretation）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her evidence suggests a different interpretation of the events. 她的证据暗示这些事件可能有另外一种解释。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 口译，当口译员（现场把一种口语译成另一种）
uncommonMeanings.example: The graduate was asked to interpret between the two delegations at the summit. 这位毕业生受邀在峰会上为两个代表团做口译。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 演绎，诠释（音乐、戏剧、舞蹈等艺术作品）
uncommonMeanings.example: The young pianist interpreted the mournful sonata with such raw emotion that several listeners were seen quietly wiping away tears, hearing in his touch a grief he never spoke of aloud. （读后续写·艺术·以乐传情）

posExamples.sentence: Standing before the faded diary, she struggled to interpret her late grandmother's cramped handwriting, and with each line she deciphered, a woman she had never truly known slowly came alive before her eyes. （读后续写·亲情·发现真相）

At the international summit, the young graduate was asked to interpret for the visiting delegation, and though her hands trembled, her calm, accurate rendering soon won admiring nods from seasoned diplomats. （读后续写·成长·首次挑战）
I would advise every reader to interpret the poet's silence not as weakness but as a deliberate space in which the imagination is invited to breathe. （应用文·读书心得·观点分享）
History teaches us that the same event may be interpreted in radically different ways, which is precisely why we must weigh multiple perspectives before rushing to judgement. （议论文·批判性思维·多元视角）

wordForms.other: 构词法:inter-(在……之间) + pret(价格/中介说明,拉丁 pretium) → '居间说明'→'解释、口译';派生 misinterpret(v. 误解)、reinterpret(v. 重新诠释)。辨析:interpreter(口译)≠translator(笔译)。

collocations.phrase: interpret the poem（课件·义1 解释/阐释）
collocations.translation: 【课件】解释，阐释（explain the meaning of sth）
collocations.example: The students were asked to interpret the poem. 学生们被要求诠释那首诗的意义。

collocations.phrase: interpret sth as sth（课件·义2 把…理解为）
collocations.translation: 【课件】把……理解为，领会（understand sth in a way）
collocations.example: I didn't know whether to interpret her silence as acceptance or refusal. 我不知道该把她的沉默解读为接受还是拒绝。

collocations.phrase: interpret the role（课件·义3 演绎）
collocations.example: He interpreted the role with a lot of humour. 他把这个角色演绎得十分幽默。

collocations.phrase: interpret for sb（课件·vi. 口译义）
collocations.translation: 【课件】为某人做口译（现场把一种口语译成另一种）
collocations.example: They spoke good Spanish and promised to interpret for me. 他们西班牙语说得很好，答应替我做口译。

collocations.phrase: be open to interpretation（课件·名词搭配）
collocations.example: Dreams are open to interpretation. 梦可以做各种诠释。

collocations.phrase: interpret sth as sth（核心结构）
collocations.example: She interpreted his silence as anger. 她把他的沉默理解为生气。

collocations.phrase: provide interpretations of sth（课文原句·名词）
collocations.example: Experts provide interpretations of Du Fu's works from different perspectives. 专家们从不同角度对杜甫的作品作出解读。（课文原句）
Only after years of hardship did he finally interpret the true meaning of his father's parting words, and the understanding brought both peace and regret. （读后续写·成长·迟来的领悟）
A responsible researcher must interpret data with scrupulous honesty, resisting the temptation to bend inconvenient findings to fit a preferred conclusion. （议论文·学术诚信·论证）

collocations.translation: 正确地/字面地/宽泛地理解
collocations.example: Taking the metaphor too literally, the students interpreted the poem incorrectly and missed the ocean of feeling hidden beneath its simple words. （议论文·文学·常见误区）

collocations.phrase: provide / offer an interpretation of sth
collocations.example: Experts provide interpretations of Du Fu's works from different perspectives, reminding us that a great poem is a mirror in which every generation sees its own reflection. （议论文·经典·永恒价值）

collocations.phrase: be difficult / hard to interpret；be open to interpretation
collocations.translation: 难以解读的；有多种解读空间的
collocations.example: The abstract painting was open to interpretation in a dozen ways, and the gallery guide encouraged each visitor to trust his own eyes rather than seek a single 'right' answer. （应用文·参观感想·艺术）

synonyms.example: She spent her summer translating an old volume of French poetry, determined to carry its beauty across the barrier of language. （读后续写·热爱·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:translate 指语言间转换,通常指'笔译'(书面);interpret 作翻译义时特指'口译'(现场即时口头翻译),二者不可混用。此外 interpret 还可表'解读、诠释(艺术、含义)',translate 无此义。

synonyms.example: The patient teacher explained the difficult theorem three times over, until at last the puzzled frown on the boy's face melted into a smile of understanding. （读后续写·师生·耐心）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:explain 最普通,重在'把事情讲清楚让人明白';interpret 更强调'解读、领会隐含意义或加以诠释',对象常是复杂、含糊或艺术性的内容。

synonyms.translation: （正式）理解，解释（尤指法律或言辞）
synonyms.example: His remark could easily be construed as an insult, though I am convinced no offence was ever intended. （议论文·言辞·歧义）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:construe 较正式书面,多用于对言辞、条款、行为的'理解、解释',常暗含'可能有不同理解';日常口语和艺术演绎场合仍用 interpret。

advancedExpressions.type: 课件·interpret 三义+口译（词族）
advancedExpressions.expression: interpret 1)解释/阐释 2)把…理解为(as) 3)演绎;vi.口译 interpret for sb → interpreter(口译员) / interpretation(解释;演绎) be open to interpretation
advancedExpressions.example: The actor's fresh interpretation of the role won praise, while the interpreter beside him rendered the director's words into three languages. 那位演员对角色的全新演绎备受好评，身旁的口译员则把导演的话译成三种语言。

advancedExpressions.expression: interpret sth as / read sth as / understand sth to mean / take sth to mean
advancedExpressions.example: I would not interpret his silence as indifference; I read it rather as a sign of deep respect. 我不会把他的沉默解读为冷漠,倒觉得那是深深敬意的表现。

advancedExpressions.expression: interpret → interpretation / interpreter / misinterpret(误解) / reinterpret(重新诠释)
advancedExpressions.example: A single word, misinterpreted, can start a quarrel; the same word, reinterpreted with kindness, can end one. 一个词被误解会引发争吵,同一个词以善意重新诠释却能平息争吵。

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. come to interpret ... not as ... but as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did she come to interpret her mother's strictness not as coldness but as love wearing a sterner face — a love that had shielded her all along. （倒装+not...but...对比重构认知，续写结尾情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should be cautious about how we interpret ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should be cautious about how we interpret online information, for a single misread sentence can spread misunderstanding faster than truth can chase it. （倡议信/演讲中提出理性建议）

advancedExpressions.expression: the same ... can be interpreted in strikingly different ways, depending on ...
advancedExpressions.example: The same historical decision can be interpreted in strikingly different ways, depending on the values and vantage point of the one who tells the story — which is why no single account should ever go unquestioned. （引出多元视角，论证批判性思维）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She didn't understand what he meant, so she thought he was angry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Unable to interpret the sudden coldness in his voice, she assumed he was angry with her — never suspecting that it was fear, not fury, that had turned his words to ice. （读后续写·误会·心理反转）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语 Unable to interpret... 前置作状语 + never suspecting 现在分词补充真相 + fear, not fury 头韵对比制造张力，化直白为含蓄

sentenceUpgrade.original: People understand this event in different ways.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That a single event should be interpreted in such wildly divergent ways is, in itself, powerful evidence that truth is rarely as simple as any one narrator would have us believe. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That 引导的主语从句提前 + in itself 强调 + be interpreted 被动增强客观性 + would have us believe 收尾，句式凝练有思辨感

classPractice.question: 这份资料可以从多方面解读。The data can be ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 【课件】原题（Reading LP 语境应用）。考点:被动语态 be interpreted;in ... ways '以……方式'。

classPractice.question: Experts have provided different ____ (interpret) of the same poem, which shows how rich its meaning is.
classPractice.note: 考点:different 后接可数名词复数,interpret→interpretation→interpretations。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(interpret / translate):(1) She was hired to ____ for the delegation at the live meeting.(2) He is ____ the novel from English into Chinese at home.
classPractice.note: 考点:interpret=现场口译;translate=(书面)笔译,二者不可混用。

classPractice.question: 别把他的沉默误解为冷漠。Don't ____ his silence ____ indifference.
classPractice.note: 考点:interpret sth as sth '把……理解为……'。

translation: 耐心，忍耐力
original_sentence: (From “Caged Bird” by Maya Angelou) Third, if you are still struggling to interpret the meaning of a poem even with much painstaking effort, just have some patience.
readingExamples: (From “Caged Bird” by Maya Angelou) Third, if you are still struggling to interpret the meaning of a poem even with much painstaking effort, just have some patience.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the ability to stay calm and accept a delay, difficulty, or suffering without becoming angry or upset
(2) n. the quality of being able to continue doing something for a long time without losing interest or hope
(3) n. the capacity to tolerate other people's faults or annoying behaviour calmly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式英语）单人纸牌游戏（即美式 solitaire）
uncommonMeanings.example: On the long, storm-bound evenings when the ferry could not sail, the old lighthouse keeper played patience by candlelight, laying out the worn cards with the slow ritual of a man long accustomed to waiting. （读后续写·孤独·打发时光）

posExamples.sentence: With trembling fingers and endless patience, the boy pieced together the shattered vase his mother treasured, and by midnight the cracks were nearly invisible — as though care alone could mend what carelessness had broken. （读后续写·亲情·弥补过错）
I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude for the boundless patience you showed me during those difficult months, when my grades plummeted and my confidence all but vanished. （应用文·感谢信·师恩）

Great achievements are rarely the child of talent alone; more often they are forged through quiet patience, the willingness to labour on long after applause and encouragement have fallen silent. （议论文·成功·坚持）
If you are still struggling to interpret the meaning of a poem even with much painstaking effort, just have some patience and let its beauty reveal itself in its own time. （应用文·读书建议·方法分享）

wordForms.other: ★重点辨析:patient 有两种词性——(1) adj. 有耐心的;(2) n. 病人!如 a patient patient(一位有耐心的病人)。反义:impatience(n. 不耐烦)、impatient(adj.)、impatiently(adv.)。注意 patience(耐心,n.)与 patients(病人复数)读音相同、拼写不同,勿混。

idioms.translation: 忍耐是一种美德（谚语）
idioms.example: 'Patience is a virtue,' her grandfather always said, and only in adulthood did she grasp how much strength that gentle old saying truly demanded. （读后续写·哲思·代际智慧）

idioms.translation: 考验某人的耐心；使某人不耐烦
idioms.example: The endless delays and broken promises tried his patience to the very limit, yet he swallowed his frustration and kept his voice steady for the sake of the frightened child beside him. （读后续写·克制·责任）

idioms.translation: 圣人般的耐心（极有耐心）
idioms.example: Teaching thirty restless six-year-olds to read demands the patience of a saint, and Ms. Lin, remarkably, seemed to possess exactly that. （读后续写·教师·赞美）

collocations.phrase: have (no) patience with sb / sth（课件·核心搭配）
collocations.example: I have no patience with people who are always complaining. 我对老是抱怨的人毫无耐心。

collocations.phrase: run out of / lose patience with sb（课件·重点·失去耐心）
collocations.example: He walked so slowly that his brother ran out of / lost patience with him. 他走得太慢，弄得哥哥对他失去了耐心。
Just have some patience — the answer will come. 耐心点——答案会出现的。（呼应课文'just have some patience'）

collocations.phrase: patience with sb / sth（固定介词with）
collocations.example: The teacher showed great patience with the slow learners. 老师对学得慢的学生极有耐心。
With patience and a gentle hand, she coaxed the terrified stray from beneath the car, whispering reassurances until at last it crept trustingly into her arms. （读后续写·善举·动物救助）
The maddeningly slow queue tested the patience of even the most easy-going travellers, yet the old couple simply held hands and smiled, unhurried by the world's impatience. （读后续写·对比·从容）

collocations.phrase: have the patience to do sth
collocations.example: Few people today have the patience to master an instrument, for it demands years of unglamorous practice before a single note earns applause. （议论文·浮躁·专注）
His constant excuses had long worn out the patience of his colleagues, yet the kindly foreman gave him one final, undeserved chance. （读后续写·宽容·转机）
Restoring the crumbling mural required boundless patience, and the elderly artist devoted a decade of quiet mornings to bringing its faded colours back to life. （读后续写·匠心·坚守）
Driven beyond all patience by the ceaseless bullying, the timid boy at last stood tall and, to everyone's astonishment, spoke up for himself. （读后续写·成长·觉醒）

synonyms.example: It was sheer perseverance, not luck, that carried her through eight years of setbacks to the summit of her chosen field. （议论文·成功·毅力）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'面对困难不放弃、坚持到底'的行动力；patience 侧重'平静地等待、忍受'的心态。前者强调坚持奋斗，后者强调冷静忍耐

synonyms.example: A truly civilised society is built on tolerance — the willingness to live peacefully alongside those whose beliefs differ from our own. （议论文·社会·包容）
synonyms.usage: 侧重对不同意见、行为或人的'容忍、接纳'；patience 更侧重对延迟、困难、痛苦的'耐心忍受'。tolerance 针对差异，patience 针对等待

synonyms.example: The marathon is less a test of speed than of endurance, of the body's capacity to keep going when every muscle begs it to stop. （读后续写·体育·极限）
synonyms.usage: 侧重长时间承受身体或精神痛苦的'耐力、持久力'，常用于极限、苦难语境；patience 更偏心理层面的'平静等待与忍耐'，语气较温和

advancedExpressions.type: 课件·patient 词族（adj./n. 病人 + impatient）
advancedExpressions.expression: patience(n.耐心) → patient(adj.有耐心的 / n.病人) ↔ impatient(adj.急切的·不耐烦的);be impatient to do sth 急于做某事
advancedExpressions.example: He's impatient to know what happened. 他急于想知道发生了什么事。（课件例句;注意 patient 既是'有耐心的'又是'病人'）

advancedExpressions.expression: have patience / show patience with sb / lose patience / run out of patience / with patience
advancedExpressions.example: He never lost patience with his students, no matter how many times they got it wrong. 无论学生错多少次,他从不对他们失去耐心。

advancedExpressions.expression: patient 既是形容词'有耐心的',又是名词'病人';patience 只作名词'耐心'
advancedExpressions.example: A good doctor must be patient (adj.) with every patient (n.). 好医生必须对每一位病人都有耐心。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was ... patience, not ..., that finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was quiet patience, not fierce ambition, that finally opened the door she had knocked on for so many years. （强调句突出品格 + not...but 对比，续写点明成长真谛）

advancedExpressions.expression: your patience meant more to me than ...
advancedExpressions.example: Your unwavering patience meant more to me than any words of praise ever could, for it taught me to believe in a boy the whole world had given up on. （感谢信中升华师恩，情真意切）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an age of instant gratification, patience has become ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an age of instant gratification, patience has become both the rarest and the most precious of virtues — the quiet discipline that separates lasting achievement from fleeting success. （对比时代背景引出论点，思辨性强）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She waited calmly and did not get angry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She waited with a patience that bordered on serenity, her hands folded, her breathing slow, refusing to let frustration steal the peace she had worked so hard to earn. （读后续写·心理描写·从容）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: a patience that bordered on serenity 抽象名词具象化 + 三个细节（hands folded, breathing slow）白描沉静 + refusing to 分词短语点明内心选择

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need patience to succeed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If there is a single quality that distinguishes those who ultimately succeed from those who fall short, it is surely patience — the willingness to keep faith with a distant goal long after others have surrendered to the ease of giving up. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If there is a single quality that... it is surely 强调句式凸显核心 + 破折号后同位语下定义 + long after 状语从句制造时间纵深，论证有力

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·汉语提示）
classPractice.question: ____ ____ ____ (需要极大的耐心) for Annie to teach me to speak French.
classPractice.note: 【课件】原题。考点:It takes patience (to do) sth '做某事需要耐心';patience 不可数。

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·汉语提示）
classPractice.question: He walked so slowly that his brother ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ (对他不耐烦了).
classPractice.answer: lost patience / ran out of patience with him
classPractice.note: 【课件】原题。考点:lose patience with sb / run out of patience with sb '对某人失去耐心'。

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·汉语提示）
classPractice.question: She was a lively young woman ____ ____ ____ ____ (富有耐心和想象力).
classPractice.note: 【课件】原题。考点:with + 抽象名词 表'具有……(品质)',作后置定语。

classPractice.question: The nurse treated every ____ (patient) with such ____ (patient) that even the most anxious among them felt calm.
classPractice.note: 考点:第一空 every+名词单数用patient(病人);第二空 such+抽象名词用patience(耐心)。

classPractice.question: 如果你实在弄不懂这首诗,就耐心一点吧。If you still can't understand the poem, just ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 考点:have patience '有耐心',呼应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 请把下句译成英文:老师对我的耐心比任何表扬都更让我感动。
classPractice.answer: My teacher's patience with me moved me more than any praise ever could.
classPractice.note: 考点:patience with sb 固定介词with;比较级强调。

translation: 到旁边，在旁边；另，除；除……以外
original_sentence: So if you do not get it, set the poem aside and come back to it later.
readingExamples: So if you do not get it, set the poem aside and come back to it later.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. to or towards one side; out of the way
(2) adv. so as to be kept separate, saved, or reserved for a special purpose
(3) adv. (aside from) apart from; except for; in addition to
(4) n. a remark made quietly so that only certain people will hear it; (in a play) words spoken by an actor to the audience, not heard by other characters

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （aside from）除……之外；此外
uncommonMeanings.example: Aside from its cost, the plan has no real drawback. 除了花费之外,这个计划没有真正的缺点。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 留出，储备（表'专门留作某用'，常与set/put连用）
uncommonMeanings.example: She set aside a little money each month for the trip. 她每月留出一点钱以备旅行。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （戏剧）旁白；（谈话中的）离题插话、悄悄话
uncommonMeanings.example: In the middle of his solemn speech, the old actor turned to the audience and, in a whispered aside, confessed the stage fright he had battled for fifty years — and the theatre erupted in warm, knowing laughter. （读后续写·舞台·真情流露）

posExamples.sentence: She quietly stepped aside to let the exhausted stretcher-bearers pass, and in that small act of yielding, the frantic crowd seemed to remember, all at once, what it meant to be kind. （读后续写·灾难·人性微光）
So if you do not get it, set the poem aside and come back to it later, for some meanings, like stubborn seeds, need time and silence before they finally take root. （应用文·读书建议·方法）
I would suggest that we set aside a small portion of our monthly allowance for the children in the mountain villages, so that a little of our comfort may become their hope. （应用文·倡议书·公益）
Aside from its obvious economic benefits, the high-speed rail network has quietly transformed the way ordinary families live, work, and stay connected across vast distances. （议论文·社会发展·多重影响）

idioms.translation: 除……之外（除此以外还有；除此以外都不）
idioms.example: Aside from a faint scar above his eyebrow, there was nothing to suggest that this gentle librarian had once been a soldier who survived a war. （读后续写·人物·反差铺陈）

idioms.translation: 说正经的，别开玩笑了
idioms.example: 'All joking aside,' the coach said, his smile fading, 'if we don't defend as one, we will lose everything we've fought for this season.' （读后续写·球队·转折严肃）

idioms.translation: 把某人拉到一边（私下说话）
idioms.example: After the meeting, the headmaster drew the trembling boy aside and, instead of the scolding he feared, offered a few quiet words that would change the course of his life. （读后续写·师生·意外温情）

collocations.phrase: set / put sth aside（课文原句·搁置/留出）
collocations.translation: 把……放一边;另外留出(时间、钱)
collocations.example: So if you do not get it, set the poem aside and come back to it later. 若你读不懂,就把这首诗放一放,过后再回来读。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: aside from sth（课堂·多义习语）
collocations.translation: 除……之外(还有);除……之外(都不)
collocations.example: Aside from a little tiredness, I feel perfectly fine. 除了有点累,我感觉好极了。

collocations.phrase: brush / push sth aside（课堂·不予理会）
collocations.translation: 把……推到一边;不予理会,漠视
collocations.example: He brushed aside my worries and told me not to fuss. 他对我的担忧不屑一顾,叫我别大惊小怪。
The veteran captain willingly stepped aside so that the promising rookie could lead, proving that true greatness sometimes lies in knowing when to make room for others. （议论文·领导力·成全）
The two old rivals finally laid their differences aside, and their handshake beneath the setting sun closed a quarrel that had shadowed the whole village for decades. （读后续写·和解·释怀）
Casting aside her long-held prejudice, she opened the door to the stranger in the storm — a decision that, in time, gave her a friend for life. （读后续写·善意·转变）
The kind nurse took the anxious young father aside and, choosing her words with great care, prepared him gently for the news he most feared to hear. （读后续写·医院·体贴）
We cannot stand aside while others suffer, for indifference, though it seems harmless, is often the quiet accomplice of injustice. （议论文·社会责任·呼吁）

synonyms.example: Apart from a single flickering candle, the vast hall lay in total darkness, and every footstep echoed like a question no one dared to answer. （读后续写·悬疑·氛围）
synonyms.usage: 作副词表'分开、相隔'或短语 apart from 表'除……之外'，与 aside from 意义相近可互换；但'放到一边'这一动作义（set aside）只能用 aside

synonyms.example: Besides its stunning natural scenery, the region boasts a rich cultural heritage that draws scholars from around the globe. （应用文·景点介绍·补充）
synonyms.usage: besides 侧重'除……之外还有'（递进、增补）；aside from 既可表'除……之外还有'，也可表'除……之外都不'，语义更灵活，需看语境判断

synonyms.example: She quietly tucked the old photograph away in a drawer, unwilling to let a single glance reopen a wound that had taken years to heal. （读后续写·情感·珍藏与回避）
synonyms.usage: away 强调'离开、到别处、收起'的方向与距离；aside 强调'到一旁、留出、搁置'。put away 是'收好'，put aside 是'搁置/留出'，含义不同

advancedExpressions.expression: set/put sth aside(搁置/留出) / aside from(除……之外) / brush aside(不理会) / take sb aside(拉到一边) / joking aside(说正经的)
advancedExpressions.example: Joking aside, we must set aside our differences and, brushing aside all excuses, finish the job together. 说正经的,我们必须放下分歧,抛开一切借口,一起把事情做完。

advancedExpressions.expression: aside 作副词'到一旁/留出/除外',又可作名词'旁白';aside from=apart from '除……之外'
advancedExpressions.example: Aside from the aside he whispered to the audience, the actor set his script aside and improvised. 除了对观众悄声说的那句旁白,演员把剧本搁到一边即兴发挥。

advancedExpressions.expression: setting aside ..., sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Setting aside her own exhaustion and fear, she reached out to steady the trembling stranger — and in giving comfort, found her own courage restored. （分词短语前置舍己 + and 引出反哺式收尾，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: I propose that we set aside ... so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I propose that we each set aside just one hour a week to accompany the lonely elderly in our community, so that no one need face the twilight of life entirely alone. （倡议信中提出具体可行的行动）

advancedExpressions.expression: aside from ..., there remains the deeper question of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Aside from the undeniable convenience of technology, there remains the deeper question of whether, in gaining the whole digital world, we are quietly losing the art of genuine human connection. （aside from 让步后转入核心论点，层层递进）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He moved aside and let the old man go first.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a word, the young man stepped aside and gestured for the frail stranger to pass, and something in that quiet courtesy softened the weary faces of everyone waiting in the rain. （读后续写·善意·感染他人）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Without a word 状语开篇突出无声之善 + gestured for sb. to do 补充动作细节 + something in that... softened 用抽象主语写出善意的涟漪效应

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should save some money to help poor students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my sincere hope that each of us might set aside even a modest sum every month, so that a child in some distant mountain village may one day sit in a classroom we helped to build. （应用文·倡议书·正式呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my sincere hope that 正式主观句式 + even a modest sum 弱化门槛增强可行性 + so that 目的状语具象化受益画面，感染力强

classPractice.question: If you really can't get the meaning, just set the poem ____ and come back to it later.
classPractice.note: 考点:set sth aside '把……放一边',呼应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 除了偶尔头疼之外,他身体状况很好。____ ____ an occasional headache, he is in perfect health.
classPractice.note: 考点:aside from = apart from '除……之外',句首大写。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(aside / away):(1) She put a little money ____ every month for emergencies.(2) He quietly stepped ____ to let the elderly couple pass.
classPractice.note: 考点:put sth aside '留出/储备';step aside '让到一旁'。away=收起/离开,put away 是'收好',含义不同。

translation: 把……放一边；另外留出
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to save or reserve something, especially money or time, for a particular purpose
(2) phr. v. to stop using or considering something for a while; to put it to one side
(3) phr. v. to decide that a feeling, disagreement, or difference is not important and to ignore it for the sake of something greater
(4) phr. v. (law) to officially cancel or overrule a previous decision or judgement

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法律）撤销，宣布（判决、决定）无效
uncommonMeanings.example: After fresh evidence came to light, the court agreed to set aside the original verdict, and the man who had lost ten years to a wrongful conviction finally walked free into the morning sun. （读后续写·正义·迟来的清白）

posExamples.sentence: Every month, however tight the budget, my mother quietly set aside a few coins in a battered tin, and years later I learned that those coins had paid, one by one, for my university dreams. （读后续写·母爱·无声奉献）
Frustrated by the tangled draft, she wisely set the essay aside for a night, and by morning the very sentences that had defeated her seemed to untangle themselves with ease. （读后续写·写作·沉淀的智慧）
I sincerely hope that our two classes can set aside our long-standing rivalry and join hands for the charity marathon, for a shared cause is worth far more than any old dispute. （应用文·倡议书·团结）
If humanity hopes to confront the climate crisis, nations must be willing to set aside narrow self-interest and act, at last, as citizens of one fragile, shared planet. （议论文·全球议题·呼吁合作）

collocations.translation: 【课件】把（诗/某物）放到一边，暂时不看
collocations.example: So if you do not get it, set the poem aside and come back to it later. 如果你读不懂，就先把这首诗放到一边，过会儿再回来看。

collocations.phrase: set aside a few hours (for sth)
collocations.example: Try to set aside a few hours a week for exercise. 尽量每周腾出几个小时锻炼身体。
She wants to put her pocket-money aside for holidays. 她想把零花钱存起来留着度假用。
She pulled the curtain aside. 她把窗帘拉到一边。
Joe stepped aside to let Jane go in first. 乔往旁边让了让，让简先进去。

collocations.translation: 【课件】把某人拉到一边（单独说话）
collocations.example: She took me aside to tell me the exciting news. 她把我拉到一边，告诉我那个激动人心的消息。
I didn't accept the job because it was badly paid and, aside from that, it wasn't interesting. 我没接受那份工作，因为薪水低，而且除此之外它也没什么意思。

collocations.translation: 存钱，留出钱（一笔钱专用于某目的）
collocations.example: Each month she set aside a little for her son's education. 她每月留出一点钱供儿子上学。

collocations.phrase: set aside time (for sth / to do sth)
collocations.example: You should set aside some time to relax. 你应该留出一些时间放松。
Let us set aside our differences and work together. 让我们搁置分歧，齐心协力。

collocations.phrase: set aside one's pride / prejudice / fears
collocations.example: He set aside his pride and asked for help. 他放下骄傲，开口求助。

collocations.translation: 把某物放在一边（可分开：set money aside / set aside money）
collocations.example: She set the book aside and answered the phone. 她把书放在一边，接了电话。
Setting aside her paralysing fears, she climbed onto the stage, gripped the microphone, and delivered the speech that would silence every doubter in the hall. （读后续写·成长·突破自我）
The ambitious expansion plan was reluctantly set aside when funds ran dry, though the founder vowed, eyes blazing, that it was merely postponed and never abandoned. （读后续写·创业·坚持）

synonyms.example: He put aside his novel to answer the frantic knocking at the door, never dreaming that the stranger outside would change his quiet life forever. （读后续写·转折·意外来客）
synonyms.usage: 与 set aside 几乎完全同义，可互换，都可表'搁置、存钱、放下情绪'；set aside 略正式，且独享'法律上撤销判决'一义

synonyms.example: The generous hotel owner always reserved a warm room and a hot meal for any traveller stranded by the winter storms. （读后续写·善意·雪中送炭）
synonyms.usage: reserve 是单个动词，正式，多指为特定目的'预留、保留'（座位、资源、时间）；set aside 更口语、更灵活，还能表'搁置分歧/情绪'，reserve 不能

synonyms.example: For three long years the boy saved up every coin he earned, dreaming of the day he could place a real telescope in his little sister's hands. （读后续写·亲情·梦想）
synonyms.usage: save up 专指'长期积攒（钱）以备将来'，口语化，只用于金钱；set aside 既可存钱也可留时间、搁分歧，适用范围广得多

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·set 的高频短语
advancedExpressions.expression: set aside 搁置/留出 ｜ set out (to do) 出发；着手 ｜ set up 建立，创办 ｜ set off 出发；引发 ｜ set about (doing) 开始做 ｜ set down 记下 ｜ set free 释放
advancedExpressions.example: They set aside their quarrel, set up a joint team, and set out to finish the project. 他们搁置争吵，组建联合小组，动身去完成项目。（一句串记 set 短语群）

advancedExpressions.expression: set aside ≈ put aside（搁置/存钱，可互换）≈ lay aside（放下/储存，书面）｜ 留出钱/时间: set aside = reserve = save up（专指攒钱）｜ '搁置分歧': set aside / put aside / shelve one's differences
advancedExpressions.example: put aside = set aside: He put aside his novel to answer the door. 他放下小说去开门。（表'搁置'时二者可换）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·可分短语动词的语序
advancedExpressions.expression: set...aside 为'动词+副词'型可分短语：宾语是名词时 set aside sth 或 set sth aside 皆可；宾语是代词时必须拆开 set it aside（不可 set aside it）。
advancedExpressions.example: set aside the money = set the money aside（都对）／ set it aside（√）｜ set aside it（×）。代词只能放中间。

advancedExpressions.expression: setting aside ..., sb. chose to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Setting aside every reason to walk away, she chose to stay — and in that choice, made not out of ease but out of love, she became the person she had always hoped to be. （分词前置舍弃 + 破折号补足动机，续写点题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us set aside ... and unite in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us set aside whatever has divided us and unite in this common cause, for a river of small streams, once joined, can move even the heaviest of stones. （倡议信中以比喻收束，号召团结）

advancedExpressions.expression: only by setting aside ... can we hope to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only by setting aside short-sighted self-interest can we hope to build a future worth handing to the generations who will inherit this earth. （Only by 倒装强调条件，议论文结尾呼吁）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They stopped fighting and worked together during the flood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the floodwaters rose, the two feuding families set aside years of bitterness in a single heartbeat, wading shoulder to shoulder through the muddy current to carry the village's children to higher ground. （读后续写·灾难·化敌为友）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: When 时间状语开篇造势 + set aside years of bitterness in a single heartbeat 时间对比凸显转变之快 + shoulder to shoulder 细节强化团结画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Countries must stop being selfish to solve climate change.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If our shared planet is to endure, the nations of the world must find the wisdom to set aside narrow self-interest and act, however belatedly, as guardians of a home that belongs to us all. （议论文·全球议题·呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If ... is to endure 条件句制造紧迫感 + find the wisdom to 委婉有力 + however belatedly 插入语承认现实 + guardians of a home 隐喻升华立意

classPractice.question: 【课件】Einstein liked Bose's paper so much that he ____ ____ his own work and translated it into German. 爱因斯坦特别喜欢 Bose 的论文，于是他把自己的工作放在一边，把 Bose 的论文译成了德语。
classPractice.note: set aside 把……放在一边、暂时搁置；此处叙述过去，set 三态同形，仍作 set aside

classPractice.question: 【课件】____ ____ ____ time to do some mending jobs. 设法留出时间做一些修修补补的活儿。
classPractice.note: try and do = try to do 设法做某事；set aside time 留出时间。三空填 Try and set aside

classPractice.question: In the face of the flood, the two families finally ____ ____ their old quarrel and helped each other. （搁置）
classPractice.note: set aside differences/quarrel 搁置分歧；此处用一般过去时 set aside（set 三态同形）

classPractice.question: The plan sounded good, but they had to set ____ aside because of a lack of money.
classPractice.note: 可分短语动词：宾语为代词必须拆开放中间 set it aside，不能说 set aside it

classPractice.question: 无论工作多忙，她总会腾出一小时给女儿读书。However busy she was, she always ____ ____ an hour to read to her daughter.
classPractice.note: set/put aside time 留出时间；set 过去时同形，put 过去时也同形。此处仅两空填一个动词短语

translation: 偏远的，偏僻的；遥远的，久远的；疏远的
original_sentence: As an explorer, you will not reach your goal immediately—you need to go on a journey to a remote and unknown destination.
readingExamples: As an explorer, you will not reach your goal immediately—you need to go on a journey to a remote and unknown destination.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. far away from towns, cities, or other places where people live; isolated
(2) adj. far away in time; distant in the past or future
(3) adj. (of a chance or possibility) very small; unlikely to happen
(4) adj. distant in manner; not friendly; cool and unwilling to become involved
(5) n. a hand-held device for controlling a television or other equipment from a distance (short for remote control)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （可能性）极小的，微乎其微的（a remote possibility/chance）
uncommonMeanings.example: Though the chance of rescue seemed remote, the stranded climbers refused to surrender hope. 尽管获救的希望微乎其微，被困的登山者仍拒绝放弃。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （态度/关系）冷淡的，疏远的，不友好的
uncommonMeanings.example: Her father had always seemed remote and unreachable. 她父亲一向显得冷淡而难以亲近。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （时间）遥远的，久远的（the remote past/future）
uncommonMeanings.example: These fossils take us back to the remote past. 这些化石把我们带回遥远的过去。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 遥控器（remote control 的简称，口语）
uncommonMeanings.example: Pass me the remote, please. 请把遥控器递给我。

posExamples.sentence: The narrow path wound deeper into the remote mountains, where mist swallowed the peaks and the only sound was the whisper of wind through ancient pines — a silence so profound it seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·探险·环境渲染）

As an explorer, you will not reach your goal immediately—you need to go on a journey to a remote and unknown destination, trusting that every uncertain step brings the horizon a little closer. （应用文·励志演讲·比喻）
I am writing to appeal for volunteers to teach in the remote villages of the west, where bright, eager children wait patiently for the education that could unlock a wider world. （应用文·倡议书·支教）

In our hyper-connected age, it is a bitter irony that people separated by remote distances can converse in an instant, while those seated at the same table drift silently into their glowing screens. （议论文·科技·人际疏离）

wordForms.other: remote control (n. 遥控器)

idioms.translation: 一点也不知道，毫无头绪
idioms.example: Handed the mysterious old key by the dying stranger, the boy had not the remotest idea that it would open a door onto the greatest adventure of his life. （读后续写·悬念·命运伏笔）

idioms.translation: 一点也不……，完全不……
idioms.example: The task was not remotely as simple as the confident young intern had assumed, and by nightfall he understood, humbled, just how much he still had to learn. （读后续写·成长·受挫领悟）

collocations.translation: 【课件】远离……的；偏远的，与……相距甚远
collocations.example: The farmhouse is remote from any other buildings. 这座农舍远离其他任何建筑，十分偏僻。

collocations.translation: 【课件】在遥远的过去（时间上久远的）
collocations.example: It happened in the remote past, so no one worries about it any more. 那是很久以前发生的事了，所以再没人为此烦心。

collocations.translation: 【课件】远房表亲（人关系上不密切的、远亲的）
collocations.example: He is only a remote cousin of mine. 他只是我的一个远房表亲。

collocations.phrase: a remote area / region / village / mountain
collocations.example: The doctor worked in a remote mountain village for years. 那位医生在偏远山村工作了多年。
He couldn't find the remote control for the TV. 他找不到电视的遥控器。
There is only a remote possibility that the plan will fail. 这个计划失败的可能性微乎其微。
The custom dates back to the remote past. 这一习俗可追溯到遥远的过去。
His ideas seemed remote from real life. 他的想法似乎脱离现实。
During the storm, students turned to remote learning. 暴风雨期间学生转向远程学习。
The temple stood remote and inaccessible atop a sheer cliff, and only the most devoted pilgrims ever completed the treacherous climb to its ancient gates. （读后续写·朝圣·意志考验）
After the quarrel, the once-warm household felt strangely remote, and the boy realised, with a pang, how quickly a home could turn into a house of strangers. （读后续写·家庭·裂痕）

synonyms.example: The isolated lighthouse, cut off from the mainland for days on end, became both a prison and a sanctuary for the keeper who had chosen its solitude. （读后续写·孤独·矛盾心境）
synonyms.usage: isolated 强调'与外界隔绝、孤立无援'，突出隔绝状态；remote 强调'地理上遥远、偏僻'，突出距离。偏远之地未必隔绝，隔绝之地未必偏远

synonyms.example: A distant rumble of thunder rolled across the plain, and the shepherd hurried his flock homeward before the storm could close the gap. （读后续写·自然·预兆）
synonyms.usage: distant 与 remote 都可表空间/时间/情感上的'遥远、冷淡'，常可互换；但 remote 的'偏远'语气更强（人迹罕至），distant 更中性（只是有距离）

synonyms.example: They found a secluded cove where no footprints marred the sand, and for one golden afternoon the whole noisy world seemed to fall away. （读后续写·独处·宁静）
synonyms.usage: secluded 侧重'隐蔽、僻静、不受打扰'，常含'惬意、私密'的积极意味；remote 侧重'偏远、远离人烟'，可褒可贬，更强调地理距离

advancedExpressions.expression: a remote village 偏远村庄 ｜ remote control 遥控器 ｜ a remote possibility 极小可能 ｜ the remote past 遥远的过去 ｜ remote from reality 脱离现实 ｜ remote learning 远程学习
advancedExpressions.example: It is only a remote possibility, but the remote control could be lost in that remote village. 可能性微乎其微，但遥控器也许丢在那个偏远村庄里了。（一句串记多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: remote（偏远，人迹罕至）≈ isolated（与外界隔绝）≈ distant（有距离，中性）≈ secluded（隐蔽僻静，多褒义）｜ 表'冷淡': remote ≈ distant ≈ cold, aloof
advancedExpressions.example: isolated 强隔绝、distant 中性、secluded 含惬意，remote 强调地理上偏远：a remote / isolated / secluded village 侧重各不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: remote adj. → remotely adv.（一点也不，not remotely）→ remoteness n. 偏远/疏远 ｜ remote control n. 遥控器（合成词）
advancedExpressions.example: The two answers are not remotely similar. 这两个答案毫不相似。（remotely 与否定连用表'丝毫不'）

advancedExpressions.expression: in that remote ..., where ..., sb. felt ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that remote valley, where no human voice had echoed for miles, she felt for the first time the vast, humbling silence of a world that had never needed her at all. （where 定语从句铺垫空旷 + felt 引出渺小感，续写心理描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: children in remote ... deserve the same chance to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Children in remote mountain villages deserve the same chance to dream as any child in the city, and it is within our power, however small our efforts may seem, to help open that door. （倡议信中以平等呼吁打动人心）

advancedExpressions.expression: however remote ... may appear, ...
advancedExpressions.example: However remote the possibility of failure may appear, a wise leader prepares for it all the same, for it is precisely the risks we dismiss that most often bring us down. （However + adj. 让步倒装 + 警句收尾，论证严谨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They travelled to a faraway village that few people visited.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: They journeyed deep into a remote village so untouched by the modern world that the children gathered in wide-eyed wonder around the strangers, as though visitors from another century had wandered into their timeless mountain home. （读后续写·偏乡·文化碰撞）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: so ... that 结果状语渲染偏远程度 + wide-eyed wonder 神态白描 + as though 比喻（另一世纪的来客）强化时空反差

sentenceUpgrade.original: Even though people are far apart, technology lets them talk, but families ignore each other at home.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a bitter paradox of our times that technology can bridge the most remote of distances in a heartbeat, yet leaves families seated side by side at the dinner table, each lost in a lonely world of glowing glass. （议论文·科技·人际疏离）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a bitter paradox that 点明悖论定调 + can bridge... yet leaves... 转折对比 + a lonely world of glowing glass 隐喻手机屏幕，收尾意味深长

classPractice.question: 用 remote 的恰当形式/搭配填空：There is only a ____ possibility that we will win, so don't get your hopes up too high.
classPractice.note: a remote possibility/chance 极小的可能性——本单元重点搭配

classPractice.question: 在 remote / isolated / distant 中选最佳：The lighthouse was completely cut off from the mainland, ____ from all human contact.
classPractice.note: isolated 强调'与外界隔绝'；remote 侧重地理偏远，distant 侧重单纯有距离

classPractice.question: The two brothers grew ____ (remote) as the years passed, until they hardly spoke at all.
classPractice.note: grow/become remote 变得疏远、冷淡；remote 此处取'冷淡'义，作系动词表语用原级

translation: vt. 奖励，奖赏 | n. 奖励，回报；赏金
original_sentence: I couldn’t believe it when I heard he did around 250 paintings Visiting museums is a very rewarding experience.
readingExamples: I couldn’t believe it when I heard he did around 250 paintings Visiting museums is a very rewarding experience.
definitionEn:
(1) n. something given in return for good behaviour, effort or achievement; a prize or benefit
(2) n. a sum of money offered for catching a criminal or returning lost property
(3) vt. to give something to someone because they have done something good or worked hard
(4) vt. to be the satisfying or profitable result of an effort

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 赏金，悬赏（为缉拿罪犯或寻回失物而提供的钱）
uncommonMeanings.example: A handsome reward was posted for any clue leading to the missing painting, and within days the sleepy town swarmed with strangers, each nursing a private hope of striking it rich. （读后续写·悬赏引发的骚动·人性百态）

posExamples.sentence: When she finally saw her grandmother's tears of joy at the reunion, she knew that every sleepless night of saving had been worth it — this quiet moment was reward enough. （读后续写·亲情团聚·情感回报）
I am writing to propose that our school set up a monthly reward for the class that recycles the most, so as to turn an ordinary habit into a shared source of pride. （应用文·建议信）
Life has a curious way of rewarding those who persevere long after others have given up, for the harvest of patience often ripens in silence, unseen until the very last. （议论文·坚持与回报）
As the exhausted runner crossed the line last, the crowd rose to their feet and rewarded his courage with an ovation far louder than any winner had received. （读后续写·体育励志·尊重勇气）

wordForms.other: rewarded (adj. 得到回报的)

collocations.phrase: reward sb with sth for (doing) sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】因（做）某事而用某物奖赏某人
collocations.example: He rewarded us for helping him. 他因我们帮了他而给我们奖赏。
She started singing to the baby and was rewarded with a smile. 她开始给宝宝唱歌，宝宝报以一个微笑。

collocations.phrase: give / offer a reward to sb for sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】为某事给某人报酬/奖赏
collocations.example: Several of the parents were giving their children rewards for passing exams. 有几位家长因孩子考试及格而给他们奖励。

collocations.phrase: in reward for sth = as a reward for sth
collocations.example: A £100 reward has been offered for the return of the necklace. 已悬赏 100 英镑寻回那条项链。

collocations.translation: 【课件】觉得（做某事）值得做、有意义、有收获
collocations.example: When asked for his views about his teaching job, Philip said he found it very interesting and rewarding. 被问及对教学工作的看法时，菲利普说他觉得这份工作既有趣又有意义。
She got a reward for her honesty. 她因诚实而得到奖励。
The teacher rewarded him for his hard work. 老师奖励他的努力。
They rewarded the boy with a new bike. 他们奖给男孩一辆新自行车。
He was given a holiday as a reward for his effort. 他因努力而获得假期作为奖励。

collocations.translation: 一次有意义／有收获的经历
collocations.example: Volunteering was a truly rewarding experience. 做志愿者是一次非常有意义的经历。
Only those willing to endure the tedium of daily practice will one day reap the rewards of true mastery. （议论文·勤奋与成就）
In reward for their tireless service, the villagers presented the young doctor with a banner they had embroidered by hand. （读后续写·村民感恩）
The scholarship was a fitting reward for years of quiet dedication that no one but her family had ever witnessed. （应用文·表彰）
The company offered a generous reward for information that would help recover the stolen research data. （应用文·启事）
He chose teaching in a remote mountain village over a career of rich financial reward, convinced that some things matter more than money. （议论文·价值取向）
As the golden wheat swayed at last across the once-barren field, the family finally tasted the sweet rewards of hard work. （读后续写·丰收·环境描写）

synonyms.translation: 奖品，奖金（尤指竞赛所得）
synonyms.example: She clutched the first prize to her chest, hardly daring to believe that the years of practice had come to this. （读后续写·获奖时刻）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:prize 特指竞赛、比赛或抽奖中赢得的奖品或奖金，有"胜出"之意；reward 更泛，强调因努力、善行或成就而"应得的回报"，不必经过竞争。

synonyms.example: The company offered generous recompense to the workers who had been unfairly dismissed. （应用文·正式赔偿）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:recompense 较正式、书面，多指对损失、辛劳或伤害的"补偿、酬劳"，常见于议论文与正式文书；reward 中性通用，偏"奖励"而非"补偿"。

synonyms.example: The staff received a year-end bonus in recognition of the record profits they had helped achieve. （应用文·职场）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:bonus 特指工资之外的额外金钱奖励（尤指年终奖、绩效奖），范围窄；reward 可指物质或精神层面的一切回报。

advancedExpressions.expression: a reward for sth 对……的奖励 ｜ reward sb for (doing) sth 因某事奖赏某人 ｜ reward sb with sth 用某物奖赏某人 ｜ as a reward 作为奖励 ｜ reap the rewards of 收获……的回报
advancedExpressions.example: The company rewarded her for her loyalty with a bonus, a fitting reward for ten years of service. 公司因她的忠诚发给她奖金，这是对十年服务应得的回报。（一句含 reward sb for/with + a reward）

advancedExpressions.expression: reward 因努力/善行'应得的回报'（不必竞争）｜ award 官方'授予'的奖项/奖金（可作动词 award sb sth）｜ prize 竞赛/抽奖'赢得的'奖品｜ bonus 工资外的'奖金/额外好处'
advancedExpressions.example: She won first prize（竞赛奖品）in the contest, received an award（官方颁奖）from the mayor, got a year-end bonus（年终奖）at work, and felt her honesty was its own reward（善行的回报）. 四词对比一句记。

advancedExpressions.expression: reward n./v. → rewarding adj. 有回报的/值得的（a rewarding experience）→ rewarded 得到回报的 ｜ 现在分词/过去分词作定语区别：a rewarding job（令人有收获的）vs. a well-rewarded effort（得到回报的）
advancedExpressions.example: Teaching is hard but deeply rewarding. 教书辛苦，却极有意义。（rewarding 描述事物令人有收获）

advancedExpressions.expression: the greatest reward lay not in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The greatest reward lay not in the trophy gleaming on the shelf, but in the quiet pride shining in her father's weary eyes. （not...but 对比结构 + 环境细节(gleaming/shining 视觉呼应)，续写结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: to reward ... is to encourage ...
advancedExpressions.example: To reward every small act of kindness is, in truth, to encourage a whole community to grow gentler day by day. （不定式作主语 + to do 表语的判断句式，倡议信深化）

advancedExpressions.expression: virtue is its own reward
advancedExpressions.example: As the old saying goes, virtue is its own reward; those who do good chiefly for applause have already missed the deeper joy of goodness itself. （引用谚语 virtue is its own reward 提升说理厚度，议论文点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She worked hard and got a reward.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: After months of toiling in obscurity, rising before dawn and studying long past midnight, she was at last rewarded with a letter of acceptance that trembled in her hands as she read it aloud through tears of disbelief. （读后续写·苦尽甘来·细节+动作描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语铺陈(rising before dawn...past midnight) + be rewarded with 被动升级 + 定语从句(that trembled in her hands) + 动作与神态描写(read aloud through tears)营造画面感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Helping others makes us happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Reaching out to those in need is a deeply rewarding act, for the warmth we kindle in another's heart never fails to circle back and glow within our own. （议论文·助人为乐）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: deeply rewarding 形容词升级 + for 引导原因分句 + 隐喻(warmth we kindle / glow within our own) + never fails to 双重否定强调必然性

classPractice.question: 【课件】警方正在出 300 美元赏金悬赏有关那起抢劫案的消息。
classPractice.answer: The police are offering a $300 reward for information about the robbery.
classPractice.note: offer a reward for sth 为某事提供悬赏；reward 此处作名词'赏金'

classPractice.question: 【课件】作为对他通过考试的奖赏，父母亲送给他一块新的手表。
classPractice.answer: As a reward for his passing the examination, his parents gave him a new watch.
classPractice.note: as a reward for (doing) sth 作为对……的奖赏；for 后接动名词复合结构 his passing

classPractice.question: 【课件】对于他的帮助，我会酬谢他的。
classPractice.answer: I shall reward him for his help.
classPractice.note: reward sb for sth 因某事奖赏/酬谢某人；reward 此处作及物动词

classPractice.question: 【课件】我不指望得到任何东西作为报酬。
classPractice.answer: I don't expect anything in reward.
classPractice.note: in reward 作为回报；in reward for sth = as a reward for sth

classPractice.question: 【课件】When ____ (ask) for his views about his teaching job, Philip said he found it very interesting and ____ (reward).
classPractice.note: when (he was) asked 状语从句省略，用过去分词 asked 表被动；find it rewarding 觉得（工作）有意义/有收获，rewarding 形容事物

classPractice.question: Volunteering at the shelter turned out to be a deeply ____ (reward) experience that changed how I saw the world.
classPractice.note: a rewarding experience 有意义的经历；rewarding 形容事物'令人有收获的'

classPractice.question: The old fisherman rewarded the boy ____ his honesty ____ the finest pearl in his collection. （介词）
classPractice.note: reward sb for sth（因某事）+ reward sb with sth（用某物）——本单元双搭配

classPractice.question: 在 reward / award / prize 中选最佳：She won first ____ in the national writing contest.
classPractice.note: prize 指竞赛/比赛中赢得的奖；win first prize 固定说法；reward 侧重努力善行的回报

translation: 经常地，一直
original_sentence: complex constantly contradictory dig up interpret remote reward set aside B2 The lecture transcript uses some compound adjectives.
readingExamples: complex constantly contradictory dig up interpret remote reward set aside B2 The lecture transcript uses some compound adjectives.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. all the time; repeatedly and without interruption
(2) adv. very often; again and again over a period of time
(3) adv. in a way that does not change; faithfully and steadily

posExamples.sentence: Throughout that endless winter, she constantly returned to the window, pressing her cheek against the cold glass, watching the empty road for the son who had promised to come home. （读后续写·思念守望·细节动作）
I would advise every newcomer to our club to constantly seek feedback from senior members, since honest advice, though sometimes hard to hear, is the surest ladder to improvement. （应用文·经验分享）
In an age when technology is constantly reshaping the way we live, those who refuse to keep learning will inevitably find themselves stranded on the shore of progress. （议论文·终身学习）
Her grandmother had loved her constantly and without condition, and it was this steady, unwavering love that anchored the girl through every storm of her youth. （读后续写·亲情·恒久之爱）

collocations.translation: 【课件】不断变化的，一直在变（constantly 始终、一直，=repeatedly）
collocations.example: Fashion is constantly changing. 时尚一直在变。
He talked constantly about his work. 他老是谈起自己的工作。

collocations.translation: 【课件】持续不断的联系（constant adj. 连续不断的）
collocations.example: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia. 他在澳大利亚期间一直与家人保持联系。

collocations.translation: 【课件】恒定不变的温度（constant adj. 恒久不变的）
collocations.example: The fridge keeps food at a constant temperature. 冰箱把食物保持在恒定的温度。
The world is constantly changing. 世界在不断变化。
The photo constantly reminded her of home. 那张照片不断让她想起家。
We should constantly strive to improve ourselves. 我们应不断努力提升自己。
As a wildlife photographer, he was constantly on the move, chasing the shifting light across deserts and frozen peaks. （读后续写·人物职业·漂泊）
Parents who constantly worry about their children's grades may, without meaning to, rob them of the joy of learning. （议论文·教育反思）
Even after she moved abroad, the two friends stayed constantly in touch, sharing every triumph and every tear across the ocean. （读后续写·跨越距离的友谊）
Living constantly under pressure, many teenagers forget that rest is not a reward for work done, but a condition for work well done. （议论文·青少年压力）
A truly great team does not rest on past glory but strives to constantly improve, treating every defeat as a lesson in disguise. （议论文·团队精神）

synonyms.example: He continually interrupted the speaker, until even the most patient listeners began to frown. （读后续写·令人不耐的举动）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:continually 强调"反复发生、时断时续"，暗含次数多且常带轻微负面色彩；constantly 既可指"持续不断"也可指"频繁"，语气更中性通用。

synonyms.example: The lighthouse keeper lived perpetually alone, his only company the roar of the sea and the cry of gulls. （读后续写·孤独氛围）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:perpetually 语气最强，指"永无止境、永恒不变"，偏文学与夸张；constantly 更日常，程度稍弱。

synonyms.example: She repeatedly checked the lock before leaving, unable to shake the feeling that something was wrong. （读后续写·不安心理）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:repeatedly 只强调"动作多次重复"，不含"持续不停"之意；constantly 可兼指"持续"与"频繁"两种情形。

advancedExpressions.expression: constant adj. 不断的/恒定的 → constantly adv. 不断地 → constancy n. 恒定/坚贞。近义副词梯度：always > constantly ≈ continually > frequently > sometimes。
advancedExpressions.example: a constant flow of visitors 络绎不绝的访客 → Visitors came constantly. 访客络绎不绝。（形→副转换）

advancedExpressions.expression: constantly（持续/频繁，中性）≈ continually（时断时续、反复，略贬）≈ continuously（不间断，一刻不停）≈ perpetually（永无止境，文学）≈ repeatedly（多次重复）
advancedExpressions.example: continually 有间断、continuously 无间断：It rained continuously for three days. 连下三天雨（不停）／ He continually interrupts. 他老是打断（时断时续）。

advancedExpressions.expression: constantly 作频度状语：一般动词前、be/助动词/情态动词后；也可置句首或句尾。常用于进行时表'总是（含情绪）'。
advancedExpressions.example: She is constantly complaining about the noise. 她老是抱怨噪音。（be 后 + 进行时表反复，带责怪语气）

advancedExpressions.expression: her mind was constantly haunted by ...
advancedExpressions.example: Her mind was constantly haunted by the image of that empty chair, and no amount of laughter around the table could fill the silence it left behind. （constantly haunted by 心理煎熬 + 定语从句 + 环境反衬，续写抒情段）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should constantly remind ourselves that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should constantly remind ourselves that a single considerate act can brighten a stranger's entire day. （we should constantly remind ourselves that 呼吁句式，倡议信收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a world that is constantly ..., only ... can ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a world that is constantly accelerating, only those who learn to pause and reflect can truly steer their own lives. （in a world that is constantly + 定语从句铺垫背景 + only...can 强调结论，议论文开篇）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He always thought about his hometown.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: No matter how far his travels carried him, his thoughts drifted constantly back to the small mountain village where the smell of wood smoke and the sound of his mother's lullaby still lingered in memory. （读后续写·思乡·感官细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: No matter how 让步状语从句开篇 + drifted constantly back 生动动词 + where 定语从句 + 感官描写(smell of wood smoke / sound of lullaby)唤起画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Society is changing fast, so we must keep learning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Since the society we live in is constantly evolving at a dizzying pace, it is imperative that each of us cultivate the habit of lifelong learning, lest we be left stranded by the relentless tide of change. （议论文·终身学习）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Since 引导原因状语从句 + constantly evolving 现在分词生动化 + it is imperative that + 虚拟语气 + lest 引导目的状语 + 隐喻(tide of change)

classPractice.question: 【课件】The direction of the wind is ____ (constant) changing.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 changing 需用副词 constantly；constant adj. → constantly adv.

classPractice.question: 【课件】Babies need ____ (constant) attention.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 attention 需用形容词 constant，表'连续不断的、时时刻刻的'关注

classPractice.question: In an age when technology is ____ (constant) reshaping the way we live, those who refuse to learn will be left behind.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 reshaping 需用副词 constantly；constant → constantly

classPractice.question: 在 constantly / continuously 中选：It rained ____ for three whole days without stopping.
classPractice.note: continuously 强调'一刻不停、不间断'；constantly 侧重'频繁/一直'，可有间断

classPractice.question: 桌上那张褪色的照片不断提醒着他对母亲的承诺。The faded photo on the desk ____ ____ him ____ the promise to his mother.
classPractice.note: constantly remind sb of sth 不断提醒某人某事；remind...of... 固定搭配

translation: 符合逻辑的，逻辑上的；合乎情理的
original_sentence: You might need to abandon logical thinking to discover its true inner beauty.
readingExamples: You might need to abandon logical thinking to discover its true inner beauty.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. seeming reasonable, sensible or expected in the circumstances
(2) adj. based on clear, sound reasoning; correct according to the rules of logic
(3) adj. (of a person) able to think clearly and reason in a well-organised way

posExamples.sentence: When the storm cut off the only road, the logical thing to do was to shelter in the cave, yet fear whispered that they should press on into the darkness. （读后续写·危机抉择·理智与恐惧的对抗）
In this report I will present, in a clear and logical order, the causes of the falling attendance and the steps I believe our club should take. （应用文·调查报告）
A convincing argument must rest on logical reasoning rather than raw emotion, for once feelings run ahead of facts, the truth is the first thing to be lost. （议论文·理性思辨）
Calm and logical even in the face of disaster, the old captain guided every trembling passenger onto the lifeboats before he would consider his own escape. （读后续写·人物刻画·临危不乱）

collocations.example: Following the clues, the detective reached a logical conclusion. 沿着线索，侦探得出了合乎逻辑的结论。
The task trains students' logical thinking. 这项任务训练学生的逻辑思维。
There must be a logical explanation for the strange noise. 那奇怪的声音一定有个合理的解释。
Given his talent, medicine seemed the logical choice. 鉴于他的天赋，学医似乎是顺理成章的选择。
Arrange your ideas in a logical order. 把你的观点按逻辑顺序排列。
The essay impressed the examiners because every paragraph was logical and coherent, each sentence building naturally upon the last. （议论文·写作评价）
Her plan made perfect logical sense on paper, but life, as she would soon learn, rarely follows a tidy blueprint. （读后续写·计划与现实）
With her sharp, logical mind, she untangled the confusing timetable in minutes and won the gratitude of the whole team. （应用文·人物表彰）

synonyms.example: It seemed reasonable to wait until dawn before searching the forest, when at least they would have light on their side. （读后续写·合理判断）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:reasonable 侧重"合情合理、明智可接受"，含道德与常识判断；logical 强调"符合逻辑推理链条"，更偏思维方法本身。

synonyms.example: Try to stay rational, she urged herself, even as panic clawed at the edges of her mind. （读后续写·压抑情绪·保持理智）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:rational 常与 emotional 相对，强调"以理性而非情感行事"，多形容人的心态；logical 强调思维或论证"合乎逻辑"，也可形容非人事物（如 a logical order）。

synonyms.example: Despite his exhaustion, he delivered a coherent account of the accident that helped the police piece together the truth. （应用文·陈述）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:coherent 强调"各部分连贯一致、条理清晰"，多形容文章、论述或表达；logical 强调"推理正确"，二者常并列出现却侧重不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: logic n. 逻辑（不可数）→ logical adj. 合乎逻辑的 → logically adv. 逻辑上地 → illogical adj. 不合逻辑的（前缀 il- 表否定，用于 l 开头词）→ logician n. 逻辑学家
advancedExpressions.example: There is no logic in his argument, so his conclusion is illogical. 他的论证毫无逻辑，因此结论不合逻辑。（logic n. / illogical adj. 对比）

advancedExpressions.expression: l 前用 il-：illogical, illegal, illiterate ｜ m/p 前用 im-：impossible, impolite ｜ r 前用 ir-：irregular, irresponsible ｜ 其余多用 in-：incorrect, informal
advancedExpressions.example: logical → illogical（l前 il-）／ possible → impossible（p前 im-）／ regular → irregular（r前 ir-）。记'字母同化'规律。

advancedExpressions.expression: logical 合乎'逻辑推理链条'（可修饰物：a logical order）｜ reasonable 合'情'合理、明智可接受（含常识判断）｜ rational 理性的、以理智而非情感行事（多形容人，常与 emotional 相对）
advancedExpressions.example: It was the logical conclusion（逻辑结论）, a reasonable choice（明智之选）made by a rational mind（理性头脑）. 三词侧重不同，一句区分。

advancedExpressions.expression: logic told her ..., yet her heart ...
advancedExpressions.example: Logic told her to turn back before nightfall, yet her heart, stubborn and unreasoning, urged her onward towards the flickering light in the distance. （logic told...yet her heart 理智与情感对照 + 拟人化，续写心理冲突段）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the sake of clarity, the following points are arranged in a logical order
advancedExpressions.example: For the sake of clarity, the following suggestions are arranged in a logical order, from the most urgent to the most far-reaching. （for the sake of clarity + arranged in a logical order 说明文条理句式，报告/建议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: what appears logical on the surface may prove ... beneath
advancedExpressions.example: What appears logical on the surface may prove deeply flawed beneath, for cold reasoning that ignores human feeling is only half the truth. （what 主语从句 + on the surface / beneath 表里对照，深化辩证论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: His idea was logical, so we agreed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So logical and clearly reasoned was his proposal that, one by one, even the most sceptical members of the committee found their objections melting away and nodded in reluctant agreement. （议论文/应用文·会议场景·说服过程）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: So + adj. 倒装强调(So logical...was) + one by one 渐进细节 + 定语从句 + 生动动词(objections melting away) + reluctant agreement 心理转变

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should think logically before making a decision.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before committing ourselves to any irreversible course, we ought to reason through the matter logically and calmly, weighing each possible outcome as a chess player weighs his every move. （议论文·理性决策）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Before 时间状语从句前置 + ought to 建议语气 + reason through 短语动词 + 副词并列(logically and calmly) + 明喻(as a chess player weighs his move)

classPractice.question: A convincing argument must rest on ____ (logic) reasoning rather than raw emotion.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 reasoning 用形容词 logical；logic n. → logical adj.

classPractice.question: His argument was full of contradictions and completely ____ (logical), so no one was convinced.
classPractice.note: 前缀 il-（用于 l 开头词）构成反义 illogical 不合逻辑的

classPractice.question: 在 logical / rational 中选：Try to stay ____ and don't let panic control your decisions.
classPractice.note: rational 常与 emotional 相对，形容人'保持理智'；logical 侧重论证/思维'合乎逻辑'

translation: 内心的，精神的；里面的，内部的
original_sentence: You might need to abandon logical thinking to discover its true inner beauty.
readingExamples: You might need to abandon logical thinking to discover its true inner beauty.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. inside or contained within something; located further towards the centre
(2) adj. relating to your mind, spirit or feelings rather than to your body or the outside world
(3) adj. (of a group or organisation) close to the centre of power; private and not known to outsiders

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 核心圈的，居于权力中心的（如 inner circle 核心圈子）
uncommonMeanings.example: For years he had lingered on the fringes, and the night he was finally welcomed into the leader's inner circle, he felt both exhilaration and a strange, creeping unease. （读后续写·融入核心圈·复杂心理）

posExamples.sentence: Only when the noise of the crowd faded away did she hear, at last, the quiet voice of her inner self telling her which road was truly her own. （读后续写·自我觉醒·内心之声）
Through our reading club, I hope every member can explore the inner beauty of poetry and discover a peace that the busy outside world so rarely offers. （应用文·社团倡议）
True confidence springs not from outward praise but from an inner conviction that one's worth does not rise or fall with the opinions of others. （议论文·内在自信）
Behind the grand hall lay an inner courtyard, hushed and green, where a single old plum tree had blossomed faithfully for a hundred springs. （读后续写·环境描写·幽静庭院）

wordForms.other: innermost (adj. 最深处的，内心最深的)

collocations.example: You might need to abandon logical thinking to discover the inner beauty of a poem. 你或许需要放下逻辑思维，去发现一首诗的内在美。（呼应课文）
She rarely shared her inner thoughts with anyone. 她很少向人吐露内心的想法。

collocations.translation: 内城区（常指市中心破旧贫困区）
collocations.example: The charity ran free classes for children of the inner city. 那家慈善机构为内城区的孩子开设免费课程。
After years of restless striving, he found a rare inner peace on that quiet mountainside. 多年不安的奋斗后，他在那宁静的山坡上找到了难得的内心平静。
Whenever doubt clouded her judgement, she learned to trust the steady inner voice that had never once led her astray. （议论文·倾听内心）
Poetry opens a door into the poet's inner world, letting us wander among feelings we ourselves have never dared to name. （议论文·文学感悟）
