advancedExpressions.expression: step into the ... era and discover ...
advancedExpressions.example: Come and step into the Romantic era at our poetry evening, and discover how words written two centuries ago can still set the heart racing. （邀请信情境代入）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an era where ..., it has never been more important to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an era where information floods in from every direction, it has never been more important to cultivate the ability to think for ourselves.

sentenceUpgrade.original: Times were changing and she felt sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the last of the gaslights was extinguished and the electric glare spread across the city, she stood at her window and felt, with a pang she could not name, that an entire era was quietly slipping into memory. （读后续写·时代变迁·情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As引导的时代背景状语 + 具体意象对比(gaslights vs electric glare) + with a pang she could not name心理描写 + slipping into memory拟人收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: This is a time of great change.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We find ourselves living through an era of such dizzying transformation that the certainties of yesterday dissolve almost before we have learned to rely on them. （议论文·时代主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: We find ourselves living through...正式表达 + such...that结果状语 + dizzying transformation强化程度 + 抽象哲思(certainties dissolve)提升思辨

classPractice.question: 选词填空（era / age / period）：The Tang ____ (a span of several centuries in history) produced China's greatest poetry.
classPractice.note: 指'一段历史时期'最中性用 period；此处强调时间段，不强调时代特征

classPractice.question: 印刷机的发明开启了一个学习的新时代。The printing press ____ ____ a new ____ of learning.
classPractice.note: usher in a new era 开启一个新时代；era of sth 表'……的时代'

classPractice.question: We are living in an era ____ which change happens faster than ever.
classPractice.note: in an era in which... = in an era where...，介词+关系代词引导定语从句

translation: 区，行政区；地区，区域
original_sentence: (2) _________________ (grow) up in the beautiful Lake District, Wordsworth had a childhood that was perfect for a developing poet.
readingExamples: (2) _________________ (grow) up in the beautiful Lake District, Wordsworth had a childhood that was perfect for a developing poet.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an area of a town, city, or country, especially one that has particular features or is used for a particular purpose
(2) n. an administrative division of a country, county, or city with defined boundaries
(3) n. a region regarded as a unit for a specific characteristic (e.g. a lake district, a mining district)

posExamples.sentence: As night fell over the old district, lanterns flickered to life one by one, and the narrow alleys filled with the warm smell of noodles and the murmur of neighbours calling one another home. （读后续写·街区·温情）
On behalf of our neighbourhood committee, I am writing to invite volunteers to help clean up the riverside district this weekend and restore its former beauty. （应用文·倡议书）
When a single district is allowed to hoard the finest schools and hospitals, the promise of equal opportunity becomes little more than a hollow slogan. （议论文·社会公平）
Growing up in the beautiful Lake District, Wordsworth had a childhood perfectly suited to a developing poet, its mist-veiled hills stirring his imagination from the earliest age. （读后续写·成长背景）

collocations.translation: 住宅区/商业区/商务区【课堂高频·功能分区】
collocations.example: By day the business district hummed with hurried footsteps; by night it fell silent as a deserted stage. （读后续写·环境对比）

collocations.translation: (英国)湖区【专有名词，课文华兹华斯故乡】
collocations.example: Growing up in the beautiful Lake District, Wordsworth drew endless inspiration from its lakes and fells. （读后续写·地名）
Wandering through the historic district, she felt as though she had stepped straight into a fading photograph. （读后续写·怀旧）
The charity's mission was to bring hope to children growing up in the city's poorest districts. （应用文·公益）
Families often move house simply to secure a place in a better school district. （议论文·教育公平）
The festival transformed every district of the city into a river of colour and song. （读后续写·节日）
News of the miracle soon spread from the village to all the surrounding districts. （读后续写·消息传播）
The reform divided the province into twelve administrative districts, each with its own council. （议论文·行政）

synonyms.example: This area of the city is famous for its lively night markets. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: 【课堂三词辨析 district/region/area】area 最普通宽泛，可指任意大小、无行政含义的'地方/区域'；district 更具体，多指城市内部有明确边界或功能的城区/行政区(a business district)

synonyms.example: The northern region enjoys long summers and gentle winters. （议论文·地理）
synonyms.usage: region 指范围较大的地区，常是一国之内的大片区域(the coastal region, an autonomous region)；district 范围更小，通常在城市内部或作较小行政单位——大区用 region，小区/城区用 district

synonyms.example: Everyone in the neighbourhood knew the kind old baker on the corner. （读后续写·邻里温情）
synonyms.usage: neighbourhood 侧重人们居住、彼此相识的社区，带人情味；district 更中性，指行政或功能划分的区域，不强调邻里关系

advancedExpressions.expression: a residential / commercial / business / historic / school district + the surrounding districts
advancedExpressions.example: 老师板书：district 常与'功能形容词'搭配指城市分区，选词时和 area/region 对比——小城区用 district，大区域用 region，泛指地方用 area。（课堂词块梳理）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a district where ..., sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a district where every wall told a story and every doorway framed a familiar face, she had never once felt alone. （定语从句渲染街区氛围,续写烘托归属感）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us join hands to make our district a place where ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us join hands to make our district a place where clean streets and blooming gardens greet every passer-by. （倡议信号召句）

advancedExpressions.expression: no child's future should be decided by the district in which they happen to be born
advancedExpressions.example: No child's future should be decided by the district in which they happen to be born; opportunity, if it means anything at all, must reach every corner of the land.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She walked through the old part of town and felt happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As she wandered deeper into the old district, past crumbling archways and shops that time had forgotten, a quiet contentment stole over her — here, at last, was a corner of the world that had refused to hurry. （读后续写·环境+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As引导动态描写 + past引出的具体意象(archways, shops) + a quiet contentment stole over her心理拟人 + 破折号哲思收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Some districts have much better schools than others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a troubling reality that the quality of a child's education still hinges, all too often, on the district into which they are born rather than on the effort they are willing to make. （议论文·教育公平）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a troubling reality that...评价性主句 + hinges on...精准动词 + all too often插入语强化 + rather than对比凸显不公

classPractice.question: 选词填空（district / region / area）：Wordsworth grew up in the beautiful Lake ____, a place of lakes and hills in England.
classPractice.note: the Lake District 是英国专有地名'湖区'，固定搭配用 District

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（district / region）：The northern ____ of the country enjoys a warmer climate than the south.
classPractice.note: 指一国之内的大片区域用 region；district 多指城市内部或较小行政区

classPractice.question: 汉译英：许多家庭搬家只是为了进入一个更好的学区。
classPractice.answer: Many families move house simply to get into a better school district.
classPractice.note: school district 学区；move house 搬家；simply to do 只是为了

translation: 分岔，岔开；分歧，相异；偏离
original_sentence: I shall be telling this with a sigh Somewhere ages and ages hence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I— I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
readingExamples: I shall be telling this with a sigh Somewhere ages and ages hence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I— I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
definitionEn:
(1) v. (of roads, lines, or paths) to separate and go in different directions from a common point
(2) v. (of opinions, ideas, or accounts) to differ or be at variance with one another
(3) v. to depart or deviate from a set course, standard, or expected pattern
(4) v. (of two people's lives, interests, etc.) to develop in increasingly different ways

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (数学)发散(级数、数列不收敛)
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher explained, chalk squeaking, why the series diverged instead of settling on a single, comfortable value — and for the first time the abstract symbols began to breathe. （读后续写·课堂顿悟·数学）

posExamples.sentence: Two roads diverged in the golden wood, and as she stood at the fork, heart pounding, she knew that whichever she chose would quietly reshape the whole course of her life. （读后续写·抉择·画面感）
I must point out that my views on this matter diverge somewhat from yours, though I remain confident that we can still reach a solution acceptable to all. （应用文·回信·委婉表异议）
When expert opinions diverge so sharply, the wisest course is not to seize the first answer offered, but to weigh each argument on its own merits. （议论文·理性思辨）
As the years passed, the two friends' ambitions gradually diverged — one drawn to the bright lights of the city, the other to the quiet certainties of the family farm. （读后续写·人生分岔）

collocations.translation: 两条路分岔【课文 Frost 经典意象】
collocations.example: 课文原句：Two roads diverged in a wood, and I — I took the one less traveled by. 林中两条路分岔，而我——我选择了人迹更少的那一条。

collocations.translation: 背离，偏离(某标准/路线/观点)【课堂高频·介词 from】
collocations.example: The moment his plan began to diverge from the rules, his teammates exchanged uneasy glances. （读后续写·分歧）
On the question of homework, teachers' and students' opinions could hardly diverge more sharply. （议论文·观点分歧）
Their accounts of that fateful night diverged so widely that the truth seemed forever out of reach. （读后续写·悬疑）

collocations.translation: 在观点/兴趣上产生分歧
collocations.example: As they grew older, the brothers began to diverge in their interests, yet their affection never wavered. （读后续写·亲情）
A healthy divergence of opinion, far from weakening a team, often sharpens its collective judgement. （议论文·辩证）
The two thinkers set out from the same question but arrived, by wholly divergent paths, at opposite conclusions. （议论文·思想）
Beyond the old oak the trail diverged into three faint tracks, each vanishing into the mist. （读后续写·探险·环境）

synonyms.example: My opinion differs from his, but I respect his right to hold it. （议论文·观点）
synonyms.usage: differ 只表静态的'不同'；diverge 强调从共同点出发后逐渐分开、越走越远的动态过程，画面感更强——两条路、两种人生用 diverge

synonyms.example: He refused to deviate from the principles his mother had taught him. （读后续写·坚守）
synonyms.usage: deviate 侧重偏离既定标准/常规/正道，常含轻微负面色彩(deviate from the plan)；diverge 更中性，侧重方向或观点的分开

synonyms.translation: 汇合，趋同【反义词·课堂对举】
synonyms.example: The two rivers converge just below the ancient bridge. 两条河在古桥下方汇合。
synonyms.usage: converge 是 diverge 的反义词：con-(共同)表'从不同方向汇聚到一点/趋于一致'，di-(分开)表'从一点向不同方向分开'——一对同根反义词，记 diverge 顺带记 converge

synonyms.example: The group split into two camps over how to spend the fund. （议论文·分歧）
synonyms.usage: split 更口语直接，强调一分为二地对立；diverge 更书面，强调渐行渐远的过程，可用于路、意见、人生

advancedExpressions.expression: two roads diverge / diverge from sth / opinions diverge / diverge widely / a divergence of opinion
advancedExpressions.example: 老师板书：'偏离某标准'diverge from sth（介词 from）；'意见分歧'opinions diverge；名词 divergence，形容词 divergent。（课堂词块梳理）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·diverge 词族与反义 converge
advancedExpressions.expression: diverge (v.) → divergence (n.) → divergent (adj.)｜反义 converge → convergence → convergent
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 -verge(=turn 转)：di-(分开)+verge=向不同方向转→分岔；con-(共同)+verge=向一起转→汇合。一正一反成对记忆。（课堂构词法）

advancedExpressions.expression: at the point where the two paths diverged, sb. hesitated, knowing that ...
advancedExpressions.example: At the point where the two paths diverged, he hesitated, knowing full well that the road he chose would forever close the door on the one he left behind. （呼应弗罗斯特意象,续写抉择时刻的心理张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: while our views may diverge on ..., I trust that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While our views may diverge on the finer details, I trust that our shared goal will keep us working side by side. （回信中礼貌承认分歧又保持合作）

advancedExpressions.expression: where opinions diverge, it is reason, not volume, that should decide
advancedExpressions.example: Where opinions diverge, it is reason, not the volume of one's voice, that should ultimately decide which view prevails.

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were two roads and I had to choose one.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Where the path diverged beneath the trembling autumn leaves, I stood for a long, breathless moment — two futures stretching away before me, each whispering its own quiet promise, each demanding that I let the other go. （读后续写·抉择·画面与心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Where引导地点状语营造场景 + 破折号引出内心 + two futures拟人(whispering, demanding) + 排比(each...each...)强化两难

sentenceUpgrade.original: People have different opinions about this.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely because our opinions diverge that debate becomes worthwhile; were we all to think alike, thought itself would soon wither for want of challenge. （议论文·辩证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is precisely because...that强调因果 + were we all to think alike虚拟倒装 + for want of challenge书面表达 + wither拟人升华思辨

classPractice.question: In the poem, two roads ____ (diverge) in a yellow wood, and the traveller had to choose.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文 Frost《The Road Not Taken》，叙述过去用过去式 diverged

classPractice.question: My views on this matter diverge ____ yours, but let's discuss them calmly.
classPractice.note: diverge from sth 与……不同/背离，介词固定为 from

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（diverge / converge）：Whereas the two roads diverged in the wood, the two mountain streams ____ into one river below.
classPractice.note: converge 汇合，是 diverge(分岔)的反义词；此处两溪汇成一河用 converge

translation: vi. & vt. (bent, bent) (使)弯曲，弯腰 | n. 弯曲，弯道
definitionEn:
(1) v. to move part of your body so that it is not straight, especially the top part of your body towards the ground
(2) v. to force something that was straight into a curved or angular shape, or to become curved in this way
(3) n. a curved part of something, especially a road or river
(4) v. to change or influence a rule, the truth, etc. to suit yourself

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①(道路、河流的)弯，转弯处（a sharp bend 急转弯；round the bend 在拐弯处）
uncommonMeanings.example: As we rounded the last bend in the mountain road, the whole valley suddenly opened up before us. 我们绕过山路最后一个弯，整个山谷豁然展现在眼前。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②弯腰，俯身（bend down / bend over 弯下腰）
uncommonMeanings.example: She bent down and gently picked up the fallen fledgling. 她弯下腰，轻轻捧起掉落的雏鸟。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 屈从，使屈服；违心迁就
uncommonMeanings.example: He was a man who would rather break than bend — and it was precisely this stubborn integrity that both isolated him and, in the end, earned him everyone's grudging respect. （读后续写·人物气节·刚直不阿）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （为迁就而）通融，变通（常作 bend the rules）
uncommonMeanings.example: Just this once, the headmaster agreed to bend the rules, allowing the exhausted rescue volunteers to sit the exam a day later. （读后续写·善意通融）

posExamples.sentence: The old fisherman bent slowly over the frozen boy, his weathered hands trembling as he wrapped his own coat around the small shivering figure lying on the pier. （读后续写·危难救助·动作特写）
I would like to remind every hiker that the mountain trail bends sharply near the cliff edge, so please slow down and keep close to the inner side for your own safety. （应用文·安全须知）
As we rounded the last bend in the mountain road, the entire valley suddenly unfolded before us, bathed in the golden light of the setting sun. （读后续写·景物描写·豁然开朗）
Those who bend the truth to win an argument may triumph in the moment, yet they quietly erode the very trust on which any lasting relationship depends. （议论文·诚信主题）

wordForms.other: 【不规则变化】bend - bent - bent（过去式=过去分词=bent）；bent 亦可作形容词'弯曲的'(a bent nail 一根弯钉子)

idioms.translation: 竭尽全力，想方设法（帮某人）
idioms.example: The new teacher bent over backwards to help the struggling student catch up, staying behind every afternoon until the corridors fell silent. （读后续写·师恩·尽心尽力）

idioms.idiom: bend one's mind / efforts to sth
idioms.translation: 全神贯注于，集中精力做
idioms.example: Once she bent her mind to the problem, hours slipped by unnoticed, and by dawn the tangled equations had finally yielded their secret. （读后续写·钻研）

idioms.translation: 把某人逼疯，使人烦透
idioms.example: The endless drilling from the construction site next door was slowly driving the whole neighbourhood round the bend. （读后续写·生活困扰）

collocations.example: The road bends sharply to the left. 这条路向左急转弯。

collocations.phrase: bend your knees / bend down / bend forward
collocations.translation: 俯身，（使）弯腰，身体前倾【课件·vi.&vt.义②】
collocations.example: Bend your knees, keeping your back straight. 屈膝，保持背部挺直。 / I bent down and tied my shoelace. 我弯下腰系鞋带。 / She bent forward to pick up the newspaper. 她俯身去捡报纸。

collocations.phrase: bend sth (in the wind) 压弯，弄弯
collocations.translation: 压弯，弄弯（使弯曲）【课件·vi.&vt.义③】
collocations.example: Fields of wheat bent in the wind. 大片麦田在风中弯下了腰。

collocations.translation: 歪曲事实，稍加曲解【课件·翻译原句】
collocations.example: I wasn't exactly lying when I said I hadn't seen her — I was just bending the truth a little. 我说我没看见她时并不完全是撒谎，只是稍微歪曲了一下事实。

collocations.phrase: a sharp bend in the road
collocations.translation: （尤指道路或河流的）拐弯，弯道【课件·n.义①】
collocations.example: He slowed down when he drove near a sharp bend in the road. 开到道路的一处急转弯附近时，他放慢了车速。

collocations.translation: （身体的）弯曲；屈膝运动【课件·n.义②】
collocations.example: We started the session with a few knee bends to warm up. 我们以几次屈膝运动开始热身。

collocations.translation: 弯腰，俯身，身体前倾【课堂高频·动作】
collocations.example: The old fisherman bent down over the frozen boy and wrapped his own coat around him. 老渔夫弯下腰俯身在冻僵的男孩身上，把自己的外套裹在他身上。

collocations.translation: 通融，灵活变通规则【熟词僻义·常考】
collocations.example: Just this once, the teacher agreed to bend the rules and let him hand in the essay a day late. 就这一次，老师同意通融，让他晚一天交作文。
A warning sign cautioned drivers of a hairpin bend ahead, where more than one careless traveller had come to grief. （读后续写·山路）
Just round the bend, a cottage appeared, its chimney breathing thin blue smoke into the crisp morning air. （读后续写·发现·温暖意象）
No amount of pressure could bend the young activist to their will; her convictions stood firm as a rock in a rising tide. （议论文·坚守信念）
He vowed he would never bend the knee to injustice, whatever the cost to himself. （读后续写·抗争精神）
On bended knee, the knight begged the queen's forgiveness for the failure that had haunted him for years. （读后续写·古典叙事）
She bent down and gently picked up the fledgling that had tumbled from its nest, cradling it against the warmth of her palm. （读后续写·爱护生命）
Bending forward eagerly, the children pressed their faces to the glass, marvelling at the fish that drifted like living jewels. （读后续写·童趣·好奇）

synonyms.example: The path curved gracefully through the rose garden, inviting visitors to slow their steps and breathe in the fragrance. （读后续写·景物）
synonyms.usage: curve 强调平滑连续的弧线，多为自然优美的弯曲；bend 可指人或物被外力弯折，也指道路的转弯，动作感更强

synonyms.example: Exhausted, he leaned against the ancient oak, letting its rough bark steady his shaking legs. （读后续写·疲惫）
synonyms.usage: lean 指身体或物体朝某方向倾斜、依靠，不含'弯折成曲线'之意；bend 强调弯曲本身

synonyms.example: The elderly gardener stooped to tend the seedlings, his knees protesting yet his hands as tender as ever. （读后续写·勤劳）
synonyms.usage: stoop 特指弯腰低头这一具体姿态，常带年迈或谦卑意味；bend 用法更广，可指任何弯曲

advancedExpressions.expression: bend（vi.&vt.）①(使)拐弯转弯 the road bends sharply｜②俯身/弯腰 bend your knees / bend down / bend forward｜③压弯弄弯 Fields of wheat bent；bend the truth 歪曲事实
advancedExpressions.example: 课件板书 bend 三义：①道路'拐弯'The road bends sharply to the left. ②身体'俯身弯腰'Bend your knees. ③外力'压弯'Fields of wheat bent in the wind.（Integrated skills 课件一词多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: a sharp bend in the road（道路/河流的弯道）｜knee bends（身体的弯曲）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件板书 n. 两义：①a sharp bend in the road 道路急转弯；②a few knee bends 屈膝运动。（Integrated skills 名词义梳理）

advancedExpressions.expression: bend down/over 弯腰｜a sharp bend 急转弯(n.)｜bend the rules 变通｜bend to one's will 使屈从
advancedExpressions.example: 老师板书：bend 三层义——①身体/物体弯曲(bend down)②道路名词'弯'(round the bend)③抽象'变通/屈从'(bend the rules / bend to sb's will)。（课堂一词多义梳理）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·bend 不规则动词
advancedExpressions.expression: bend - bent - bent
advancedExpressions.example: 过去式和过去分词都是 bent；bent 还能当形容词'弯的'。对比 send-sent-sent、lend-lent-lent 一起记。（课堂动词变化）

advancedExpressions.expression: one may bend, but one will never break
advancedExpressions.example: Battered by one misfortune after another, she bent under the weight of it all — but she never broke; something deep within simply refused to surrender. （对比修辞 bend/break，塑造坚韧形象，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: please be reminded that the road bends sharply at ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please be reminded that the trail bends sharply just beyond the waterfall, where a moment's carelessness could prove costly. （温馨提示句式，用于活动须知/安全告示）

advancedExpressions.expression: true principle bends for no one
advancedExpressions.example: A rule worth keeping is a rule that bends for no one; the instant we make exceptions for the powerful, fairness itself begins to crumble. （用 bend 的'通融'义反向论证原则的不可动摇）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He bent down to help the old man.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a moment's hesitation, he bent down and slid a steadying arm beneath the old man's, lifting him from the icy pavement as gently as if he were raising his own grandfather. （读后续写·助人·动作+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Without a moment's hesitation 状语提速 + slide/lift 连贯动作链 + as if 明喻拉近情感距离

sentenceUpgrade.original: The road had many bends.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mountain road wound upward in an endless succession of bends, each turn revealing a fresh vista more breathtaking than the last, until sky and summit seemed to merge into one. （读后续写·景物·递进）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: wound upward 动态化道路 + each turn revealing 独立分词状语 + more...than the last 递进比较 + until 引出高潮意象

classPractice.question: 她往前倾身，在我耳边低语。
classPractice.answer: She bent forward and whispered in my ear.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；bend forward 身体前倾，bend 过去式为 bent（bend-bent-bent）

classPractice.question: 这条河有一连串的急弯。
classPractice.answer: There are a series of sharp bends in the river.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；bend 作名词'弯道'，a series of sharp bends 一连串急弯，谓语用 are（a series of + 复数）

classPractice.question: 当我说我没看见她时，确切地说我并没有说谎，我只是稍微歪曲了一下事实。
classPractice.answer: I wasn't exactly lying when I said I hadn't seen her — I was just bending the truth a little.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；bend the truth 歪曲事实；was bending 过去进行时表当时正在做

classPractice.question: As we rounded the last ____ (bend) in the road, a beautiful lake came into view.
classPractice.note: 此处 bend 作名词'弯道'，round the bend 绕过弯道；the last bend 单数

classPractice.question: Just this once, the manager agreed to ____ the rules and give her a second chance.
classPractice.note: bend the rules 通融、灵活变通规则，熟词僻义

classPractice.question: 他弯下腰，把那个哭泣的孩子抱了起来。He ____ ____ and lifted the crying child into his arms.
classPractice.note: bend down 弯腰；bend 的过去式为 bent（bend-bent-bent）

translation: n. 声称，宣称；所有权；索赔 | vt. 宣称，声称；要求；索取；获得
definitionEn:
(1) v. to say that something is true although it has not been proved and other people may not believe it
(2) v. to officially or formally state that you have a right to something and ask for it
(3) n. a statement that something is true, though it has not been proved
(4) n. a demand or request for something you consider your right, especially money or property

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①声称，宣称（尤指未经证实：claim that ... / claim to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: He claimed that he had seen the whole accident, though no one else could confirm it. 他声称目睹了整个事故，尽管无人能够证实。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②索取，认领；要求获得(自己有权得到的东西：claim a prize / claim compensation)
uncommonMeanings.example: I am writing to claim the lost wallet described in yesterday's notice. 我写信是想认领昨天启事中描述的丢失钱包。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 夺去（生命）；造成（伤亡）（claim lives / claim sb's life）
uncommonMeanings.example: The earthquake claimed hundreds of lives in a single night, and by morning the once-bustling town lay silent beneath a shroud of grey dust. （读后续写·灾难·沉重氛围）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （事物）需要，值得（占用时间、注意力）
uncommonMeanings.example: The rescue mission claimed every ounce of their attention, so that hunger and exhaustion were forgotten until the last survivor was safely ashore. （读后续写·全神贯注）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 主张，说法（未经证实的陈述）；索赔要求（make a claim）
uncommonMeanings.example: Extraordinary claims demand extraordinary evidence. 非凡的主张需要非凡的证据。

posExamples.sentence: Trembling with excitement, the boy claimed that he had seen a shooting star grant his wish, and no words of doubt from the grown-ups could dim the light in his eyes. （读后续写·童真·坚信）
I am writing to claim the lost wallet described in yesterday's notice, and I would be most grateful if you could tell me when I may collect it. （应用文·认领信）
Extraordinary claims demand extraordinary evidence; before we accept any theory as fact, we must subject it to the cold, patient scrutiny of scientific testing. （议论文·科学精神）
As the flood waters rose, she waded back into the ruined house to claim the only photograph of her late mother, refusing to let the current take that last memory too. （读后续写·亲情·危难抉择）

idioms.translation: 声称对……拥有权利；自称具有
idioms.example: Many towns lay claim to being the poet's birthplace, yet only one can point to the crumbling cottage where he first put pen to paper. （议论文/说明文·文化归属）

idioms.translation: 宣示对……的所有权，占得一席之地
idioms.example: With that stunning final performance, the unknown dancer staked her claim to a place among the country's very best. （读后续写·崭露头角）

idioms.translation: 成名之处，引以为傲的资本
idioms.example: The sleepy village's only claim to fame was the ancient bridge under which, legend said, a dragon once slept. （读后续写·地方色彩）

collocations.phrase: claim (that) ... / claim to be / It is claimed that ...
collocations.example: He claims (that) he was not given a fair hearing. 他声称自己没有得到公正的申辩机会。 / I don't claim to be a feminist, but I'd like to see more women in top jobs. 我并不自称是女权主义者，但我希望有更多女性担任高层职位。

collocations.translation: 宣布／宣称（取得）重大突破【课件·v.义②索要索取/宣称获得】
collocations.example: Scientists claimed a major breakthrough in the fight against the disease. 科学家宣布在抗击这种疾病方面取得了重大突破。

collocations.translation: 夺走三条生命【课件·熟词僻义·常考】
collocations.example: The car crash claimed three lives. 那场车祸夺走了三条生命。

collocations.phrase: claim a place on the team
collocations.translation: 在队伍中赢得一席之地【课件】
collocations.example: She has finally claimed a place on the team. 她终于在队伍中赢得了一席之地。

collocations.translation: 领取失业救济金【课件·索取/领取义】
collocations.example: He's not entitled to claim unemployment benefit. 他没有资格领取失业救济金。
You can claim back the tax on your purchases. 你可以索回所购物品的税款。
There is great potential for customer anger over delays caused by weather, unclaimed luggage and technical problems. 天气原因、无人认领的行李和技术问题引起的延误极可能招致顾客不满。

collocations.phrase: denied the claim that ... / make a claim that ...
collocations.translation: 否认……的说法／作出……的声称【课件·n.义①声称断言】
collocations.example: The singer has denied the claim that she is leaving the band. 这名歌手否认了她要离开乐队的说法。 / He made a claim that he couldn't live up to his parents' expectations. 他声称自己无法达到父母的期望。
The police lack enough evidence to support these claims. 警方缺乏足够的证据来支持这些说法。

collocations.phrase: lay claim to sth / have no claim on sth
collocations.translation: 声明对……的所有权／对……无所有权【课件·n.义②权利、所有权】
collocations.example: They had no claim on the land. 他们无权索要那块土地。 / You can lay claim to the property only with proper documents. 你只有凭合法文件才能声明对该财产的所有权。

collocations.phrase: make a claim (on / for sth) / lodge a claim for sth
collocations.example: You can make a claim on your insurance policy for £2000. 你可按保险单索赔2000英镑。
The union put forward a three per cent pay claim. 工会提出了提高工资3%的要求。
Please fill in the claim form and return it to the insurance company. 请填写索赔申请表并寄回保险公司。

collocations.phrase: claim that ... / claim to do sth
collocations.translation: 声称……【课堂高频·两种句型】
collocations.example: The boy claimed that he had seen a shooting star. / He claimed to have finished the work alone. 男孩声称看见了一颗流星。/ 他声称独自完成了这项工作。
No one dared claim responsibility for the broken window, and an uneasy silence settled over the classroom. （读后续写·校园·担当）

collocations.translation: 夺去（生命）【熟词僻义·常考】
collocations.example: The flood claimed dozens of lives before the rescue teams could reach the valley. 洪水在救援队到达山谷之前就夺去了数十条生命。
Before you make such a bold claim in your essay, be sure you can back it up with solid evidence. （议论文·论证规范）
The passengers were advised to claim compensation from the airline for the flight that had stranded them overnight. （应用文·维权）
She stood up at the meeting, calm but firm, to claim the rights that had long been denied to workers like her. （读后续写·抗争）
The article was riddled with unfounded claims that crumbled the moment they were checked against the facts. （议论文·批判）
Rather than claim credit for the victory himself, the captain praised every teammate by name. （读后续写·谦逊·领导力）
The trembling child stepped forward to claim the reading prize, clutching the certificate as though it were treasure. （读后续写·荣誉时刻）
A convincing argument must back up every claim with data, examples, or the testimony of experts. （议论文·方法）

synonyms.example: He asserted, with a confidence that silenced the room, that the missing key had never left his pocket. （读后续写·据理力争）
synonyms.usage: assert 语气比 claim 更坚决自信，强调有力地陈述立场；claim 常暗含'未经证实、他人或存疑'

synonyms.example: The judges declared her the winner, and the hall erupted in thunderous applause. （读后续写·揭晓时刻）
synonyms.usage: declare 指正式、公开地宣布，具权威性；claim 侧重个人主张，可能真伪待考

synonyms.example: The customers demanded a full refund after discovering the defect. （应用文·投诉）
synonyms.usage: 作'索取'讲时，demand 语气强硬、含理直气壮的要求；claim 更中性，指依权利提出请求

advancedExpressions.expression: v. ①声称断言 claim (that)/claim to be/It is claimed that ②索要索取 claim a major breakthrough / claim three lives 夺走三条生命 / claim a place on the team / claim unemployment benefit / claim back｜n. ①声称 make a claim that ②权利所有权 lay claim to / have no claim on ③索赔 make a claim for / a pay claim 加薪要求 / claim form
advancedExpressions.example: 课件板书 claim：动词'声称'(claim to be)与'索取/领取/夺命'(claim back / claim three lives)；名词'声称/所有权/索赔'(lay claim to / a pay claim / claim form)。看语境定义项。（Integrated skills 课件一词多义）

advancedExpressions.type: 课件·make(s) all the difference（挂 claim）
advancedExpressions.expression: sth make(s) all the difference (to sb/sth) = have a significant effect on a person or situation 大不相同；关系重大｜反：not make any difference to 对……没影响
advancedExpressions.example: Where you live can make all the difference to the way you feel. 住在哪里会极大地影响你的感受。 / Exercise makes all the difference. 锻炼身体非常重要。 / His retirement won't make any difference to the way we handle things. 他的退休不会影响我们处理事情的方式。（Integrated skills 课件语块）

advancedExpressions.expression: claim that ...(声称)｜claim a prize/compensation(索取)｜claim lives(夺命)｜claim responsibility(声称负责)｜make a claim(提出主张)
advancedExpressions.example: 老师板书：claim 四大义——声称(claim that/to do)、索取认领(claim a prize)、夺去生命(claim lives)、名词'主张/索赔'(make a claim)。看语境定义项。（课堂一词多义梳理）

advancedExpressions.expression: claim + that 从句 / claim + to do / to have done
advancedExpressions.example: '声称做了某事'两种写法：He claimed that he had solved it. = He claimed to have solved it.（claim to 后接完成式表'声称已做'）（课堂句法）

advancedExpressions.expression: though sb. claimed ..., the truth soon revealed itself
advancedExpressions.example: Though he claimed to have acted alone, the truth soon revealed itself, unravelling thread by thread until the whole scheme lay bare. （悬念铺陈+渐进揭示，用于续写反转段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to claim ... and would appreciate it if ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to claim the umbrella I left in the reading room and would appreciate it if you could keep it at the front desk for me. （礼貌申请句式，认领/申请类书信通用）

advancedExpressions.expression: a claim unsupported by evidence is nothing more than opinion
advancedExpressions.example: A claim unsupported by evidence is nothing more than opinion dressed as fact; genuine persuasion is built brick by brick upon proof. （用 claim 界定'主张 vs 事实'，强调论证严谨性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He said he was innocent.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He claimed his innocence in a voice that never wavered, meeting each accusing stare head-on, as if daring the whole room to prove him wrong. （读后续写·据理力争·心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: claim 替 say 更精准 + in a voice that never wavered 状语显定力 + meeting...head-on 分词伴随动作 + as if daring 心理外化

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people say this product is the best.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While the manufacturer boldly claims that its product outshines every rival on the market, a discerning consumer should never take such an assertion at face value without first examining the evidence behind it. （议论文·批判性思维）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While 让步开篇 + claim/assertion 同义替换避重复 + take...at face value 地道搭配 + without first examining 状语强调理性

classPractice.question: 那个年轻人声称对父亲的财产拥有继承权。
classPractice.answer: The young man laid claim to his father's property.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；lay claim to sth 声明对……拥有权利（lay-laid-laid）

classPractice.question: 如果你在网上买的货物有损坏，可以要求退钱。
classPractice.answer: You can claim your money back if the goods you bought online are damaged.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；claim ... back 索回、要回；claim your money back 要求退钱

classPractice.question: 据声称有些工人一周工作一百个小时左右。
classPractice.answer: It was claimed that some workers worked about 100 hours a week.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；It was claimed that ... 据声称……（形式主语 it + 被动，等于 It is/was said that）

classPractice.type: 语境应用（课件·完成句子）
classPractice.question: 据说这种新药能有效缓解症状。It is claimed that ____________.
classPractice.answer: It is claimed that the new medicine can effectively relieve the symptoms.
classPractice.note: 课件句型；It is claimed that + 从句 = 据说、据称，形式主语被动句型（= It is said that）

classPractice.question: He claimed ____ (finish) the whole project by himself, but nobody quite believed him.
classPractice.note: claim to have done 声称已经做了某事；不定式完成式表'先于谓语发生'

classPractice.question: The terrible flood ____ dozens of ____ before help finally arrived.
classPractice.note: claim lives 夺去生命，熟词僻义；主语为灾难/事故时常用此义

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（claim / declare）：A convincing essay must never ____ anything it cannot back up with evidence.
classPractice.note: claim 指提出（未必证实的）主张；declare 指权威正式宣布，此处指论文中的'主张'用 claim

translation: (trod, trodden) 踩，踏；踩死，践踏；行走，步行
definitionEn:
(1) v. to put your foot down while you are stepping or walking; to step or walk
(2) v. to press or crush something with your feet
(3) v. to move or behave in a particular, especially careful, way
(4) n. the way that someone walks, or the sound they make while walking; the part of a stair or a tyre that you step or press on

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①踩，踏；行走（tread on sth 踩到某物；tread carefully 小心走路/谨慎行事）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the dark he trod on a dry twig, and the sudden crack froze everyone. 黑暗中他踩到一根干树枝，突然的断裂声让所有人都僵住了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 谨慎行事，小心处理（tread carefully / lightly；tread a fine line 拿捏分寸）
uncommonMeanings.example: Knowing how fragile his friend's confidence was, he chose to tread carefully, wrapping each piece of hard truth in gentle words. （读后续写·体贴·分寸）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 脚步（声）；步态
uncommonMeanings.example: She recognised the heavy, unhurried tread on the stairs long before the door opened — Grandfather was home at last. （读后续写·亲情·熟悉的脚步）

posExamples.sentence: The children trod softly across the creaking floorboards, holding their breath, terrified that a single sound might wake the sleeping giant of a father downstairs. （读后续写·紧张·蹑手蹑脚）
Visitors are kindly requested not to tread on the freshly planted lawns, so that the grass may grow thick and green for everyone to enjoy. （应用文·公园告示）
In the hushed museum, every visitor's tread echoed against the marble, as though the very building were listening to the footsteps of history. （读后续写·氛围·静谧）
When discussing sensitive cultural differences, we must tread with respect and humility, for a careless remark can wound more deeply than we ever intend. （议论文·跨文化交流）

wordForms.other: 【不规则变化】tread - trod - trodden（/trod）；-ing 形式 treading。过去分词 trodden 常见于 well-trodden、trodden underfoot

idioms.translation: 小心谨慎地行事，如履薄冰
idioms.example: The negotiations were delicate, and both sides knew they had to tread lightly if the fragile truce was to hold. （议论文/记叙文·处理棘手局面）

idioms.translation: 冒犯某人，越权触怒他人
idioms.example: He longed to offer advice but feared treading on the veteran's toes, so he held his tongue and simply watched. （读后续写·分寸·顾虑）

idioms.translation: 登台演戏，从事戏剧表演
idioms.example: For fifty years she had trodden the boards, and even now the roar of the audience set her heart racing like a girl's. （读后续写·热爱·坚守）

idioms.translation: 踩水；（喻）原地踏步，毫无进展
idioms.example: For months the project seemed to tread water, until a single fresh idea finally set it surging forward. （读后续写/议论文·困境与突破）

collocations.translation: 踩到某物【课堂高频·介词 on】
collocations.example: Visitors are kindly requested not to tread on the freshly planted lawns. 敬请游客不要踩踏刚栽种的草坪。

collocations.translation: 谨慎行事，如履薄冰【熟词僻义·常考】
collocations.example: The negotiations were delicate, and both sides knew they had to tread lightly if the fragile truce was to hold. （议论文/记叙文·处理棘手局面）

collocations.translation: 踩水；(喻)原地踏步，毫无进展
collocations.example: For months the project seemed to tread water, until a single fresh idea finally set it surging forward. 好几个月来这个项目似乎原地踏步，直到一个新想法终于让它奋起前行。
A good teacher treads a fine line between being strict and being kind, firm enough to guide yet warm enough to inspire. （议论文·教育之道）

collocations.translation: 冒犯某人，越权触怒他人
collocations.example: He longed to offer advice but feared treading on the veteran's toes, so he held his tongue and simply watched. （读后续写·分寸·顾虑）

collocations.translation: 老路，众人走过的常规道路
collocations.example: Rather than follow the well-trodden path into a safe office job, he set off to teach in a remote mountain village. （读后续写·不走寻常路）
He trod softly into the ward, unwilling to disturb the fragile peace of the sleeping patients. （读后续写·体贴·安静）
It broke her heart to see the wildflowers she had nurtured trodden underfoot by careless passers-by. （读后续写·惋惜·爱护自然）

collocations.translation: 追随某人的脚步，继承其事业
collocations.example: Determined to tread in his late father's footsteps, the young man devoted himself to the study of medicine. （读后续写·传承·志向）
Sensing the tension in the room, she trod carefully, choosing every word as if picking her way across thin ice. （读后续写·察言观色）
Undaunted by failure, she chose to tread the lonely path of a pioneer, where no footprints had gone before. （读后续写·追梦·孤勇）

collocations.translation: 老路，众人走过的常规道路
collocations.example: Rather than follow the well-trodden path into a safe office job, he set off to teach in a remote mountain village. （读后续写·不走寻常路）

synonyms.example: She stepped cautiously onto the frozen lake, testing each patch of ice before trusting it with her weight. （读后续写·小心翼翼）
synonyms.usage: step 是最普通的'迈步'，中性口语；tread 更书面、更具画面感，且能引申为'谨慎行事'或指'脚步声/步态'

synonyms.example: The panicked crowd surged forward, trampling everything in its path. （读后续写·混乱·灾难）
synonyms.usage: trample 强调粗暴、破坏性地反复踩踏，含贬义;tread 语气中性，可轻可重

synonyms.example: He paced the corridor for hours, his footsteps marking out the long agony of waiting for news. （读后续写·焦虑·等待）
synonyms.usage: pace 特指因焦虑或思考而来回走动；tread 泛指行走或踏踩，不含'来回'之意

advancedExpressions.expression: tread on sth 踩到｜tread carefully/lightly 谨慎行事｜tread water 原地踏步｜tread a fine line 拿捏分寸｜tread in sb's footsteps 追随
advancedExpressions.example: 老师板书：tread 由'踩/走'引申出大量比喻——tread carefully=谨慎行事，tread water=毫无进展，tread on sb's toes=冒犯。（课堂词块梳理）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·tread 不规则动词
advancedExpressions.expression: tread - trod - trodden (/trod)
advancedExpressions.example: 过去式 trod，过去分词 trodden（也可用 trod）；a well-trodden path 一条被走烂的老路。对比 freeze-froze-frozen 记'-en 结尾的过去分词'。（课堂动词变化）

advancedExpressions.expression: with each cautious tread, ...
advancedExpressions.example: With each cautious tread, the old floorboards groaned beneath her, and her heart hammered louder than she thought her fear could bear. （介词短语开篇+声音细节，渲染紧张，续写氛围段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us tread gently upon ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us tread gently upon this land we all share, for every blade of grass we protect today is a gift to the generations that follow. （祈使呼吁句式，用于环保倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: to tread the fine line between ... requires ...
advancedExpressions.example: To tread the fine line between confidence and arrogance requires a rare blend of self-belief and humility. （用 tread the fine line 抽象化'把握分寸'，论证类议题通用）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He walked quietly into the room.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He trod softly into the darkened room, each careful step swallowed by the thick carpet, holding his breath as though the very silence might shatter at the slightest sound. （读后续写·蹑手蹑脚·感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: tread 替 walk 更具文学质感 + each careful step swallowed 被动化脚步声 + holding his breath 分词伴随 + as though 夸张比喻

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should be careful about other people's feelings.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When our words touch upon another's grief or shame, we would do well to tread with the utmost care, remembering that a single thoughtless remark can leave a wound that no apology fully heals. （议论文·同理心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: tread with the utmost care 比喻化'谨慎' + would do well to 委婉建议 + remembering that 分词补充 + 具象化后果收束论点

classPractice.question: A sign at the park entrance asks visitors not to ____ on the newly planted flowers.
classPractice.note: tread on sth 踩到/践踏某物，介词固定为 on

classPractice.question: The subject was so sensitive that everyone knew they had to tread ____ (careful).
classPractice.note: tread carefully 谨慎行事；修饰动词 tread 用副词 carefully

classPractice.question: 几个月来这个项目原地踏步，毫无进展。For months the project simply ____ ____, making no progress at all.
classPractice.note: tread water 原地踏步/毫无进展；过去式为 trod（tread-trod-trodden）

translation: 叹息，叹气
original_sentence: At first sight, the overall scene of life in the capital city appears peaceful and cheerful.
readingExamples: At first sight, the overall scene of life in the capital city appears peaceful and cheerful.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to breathe out slowly and noisily, especially to express tiredness, sadness, relief, or a wish for something
(2) n. the act of sighing, or the sound made by doing this
(3) v. (literary) (of the wind, trees, etc.) to make a long, soft sound like a sigh

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （风、树等）发出叹息般的簌簌声（文学用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The autumn wind sighed through the bare branches, and something in that mournful sound seemed to echo the loneliness in the old man's heart. （读后续写·借景抒情·孤寂）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 渴望，思念（sigh for，较古旧文学用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Far from home on the eve of the festival, she sighed for the warm lamplight and the laughter of the family table she had left behind. （读后续写·思乡）

posExamples.sentence: When the last name on the rescue list was finally ticked off, the exhausted captain sighed with relief and sank slowly onto the deck, his eyes brimming with unspoken tears. （读后续写·如释重负·危难化解）
A collective sigh of disappointment rippled through the audience when the announcement came that the concert had been cancelled due to the storm. （应用文·活动通报/记叙）
With a heavy sigh, she closed the diary that had accompanied her through the hardest year of her life, grateful that the darkest days now lay behind her. （读后续写·释然·成长）
Too many of us sigh over lost opportunities instead of acting on the ones before us; regret, after all, changes nothing, while effort changes everything. （议论文·把握当下）

idioms.translation: 如释重负的一声叹息
idioms.example: Only when the plane touched down safely did the whole cabin let out a sigh of relief, and a scattered, grateful applause broke the tense silence. （读后续写·转危为安）

idioms.idiom: breathe / heave a sigh of relief
idioms.translation: 松一口气
idioms.example: The moment the examiner said 'Well done', I heaved a sigh of relief so deep it felt as if a mountain had rolled off my shoulders. （读后续写·紧张之后·比喻）

collocations.translation: 如释重负的一声叹息，松一口气【课堂高频】
collocations.example: Only when the plane touched down safely did the whole cabin let out a sigh of relief. 直到飞机安全着陆，整个机舱才松了一口气。

collocations.translation: (深深地)叹一口气，松一口气【固定搭配·heave 高级】
collocations.example: The moment the examiner said 'Well done', I heaved a sigh of relief so deep it felt as if a mountain had rolled off my shoulders. （读后续写·紧张之后·比喻）

collocations.translation: 叹着气，无奈地【状语·课堂高频】
collocations.example: With a sigh, she set aside the dream of the city and turned back to care for her ailing mother. （读后续写·牺牲·亲情）
The old teacher sighed deeply as he read the letter from his very first student, now grown and grateful across the years. （读后续写·师生情·感怀）

collocations.translation: 一声深沉、沉重、悠长的叹息
collocations.example: With a long sigh, he laid down his pen at last, the story that had haunted him for years finally set free upon the page. （读后续写·完成·释然）
Curling up by the fire with a warm cup of cocoa, she sighed with contentment as the storm raged harmlessly outside. （读后续写·温馨·安宁）
He gave a small sigh, folded the rejection letter neatly, and quietly resolved to try once more. （读后续写·失意·不屈）
There is little use sighing over yesterday's mistakes; wisdom lies in learning from them and moving on. （议论文·积极心态）
A sigh of resignation escaped him as he realised the last train had already gone, leaving him alone on the empty platform. （读后续写·失落·孤独）

synonyms.translation: 呻吟，哼哼（表痛苦或不满）
synonyms.example: The class let out a collective groan when the teacher announced yet another pop quiz. （读后续写·校园·抱怨）
synonyms.usage: groan 是低沉的呻吟声，多因身体痛苦或强烈不满；sigh 是缓缓吐气，表疲惫、释然、感伤等，情绪更柔和内敛

synonyms.example: The crowd gasped in astonishment as the acrobat leapt through the ring of fire. （读后续写·惊叹时刻）
synonyms.usage: gasp 是急促地吸气，多表震惊、恐惧或喘不上气；sigh 恰恰相反，是缓慢地呼气，表情绪的舒缓释放——一吸一呼，正好对举

synonyms.example: He moaned about the workload all week, yet never once thought to actually get started. （议论文·空谈误事）
synonyms.usage: moan 既可指痛苦的呻吟，也常指喋喋不休地抱怨（含贬义）；sigh 不带抱怨的负面色彩，更显无奈或释然

advancedExpressions.expression: a sigh of relief 松一口气｜heave/breathe a sigh 叹口气｜with a sigh 叹着气｜sigh with relief/contentment 宽慰/满足地叹息｜sigh over sth 为……感伤
advancedExpressions.example: 老师板书：'松一口气'固定说法 heave/breathe/let out a sigh of relief；'叹着气(做某事)'用 with a sigh 作状语。（课堂词块梳理）

advancedExpressions.expression: sigh 既是动词也是名词（v. sigh / n. a sigh），与 relief/contentment 搭配时用不同结构
advancedExpressions.example: 动词：She sighed with relief.（sigh with + 情绪名词）｜名词：She let out a sigh of relief.（a sigh of + 情绪名词）。两种都对，句式不同。（课堂句法辨析）

advancedExpressions.expression: with a sigh that seemed to carry ..., sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: With a sigh that seemed to carry the weight of a hundred sleepless nights, she finally let the tears fall — and in that release, something long broken began quietly to mend. （定语从句放大叹息重量+破折号转折，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: a sigh of relief spread through ... as ...
advancedExpressions.example: A sigh of relief spread through the whole community as news arrived that every trapped miner had been brought safely to the surface. （群体情绪句式，用于新闻报道/通讯类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: instead of sighing over ..., we ought to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of sighing over the doors that have closed, we ought to fix our eyes on the ones still open, for opportunity favours the resolute, not the wistful. （用 sigh 象征消极叹惋，反向立论倡导行动）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was tired and sighed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She let out a long, weary sigh, her shoulders sagging as the tension of the endless day finally drained from her body like water from a cracked jar. （读后续写·疲惫·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: let out a long, weary sigh 具象化 + her shoulders sagging 独立主格描身体语言 + like water from a cracked jar 明喻 + as 引导原因

sentenceUpgrade.original: People often regret lost chances and sigh.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far too often we squander our energy sighing over chances that have slipped through our fingers, forgetting that every sigh of regret is a moment stolen from the pursuit of the next. （议论文·把握机遇）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far too often 前置强调 + squander...sighing over 动名词搭配 + slipped through our fingers 习语化 + every...is a moment stolen 隐喻收束观点

classPractice.question: When the last child was found safe, the whole village heaved a ____ of relief.
classPractice.note: heave/breathe a sigh of relief 松一口气；sigh of relief 固定搭配

classPractice.question: ____ a heavy sigh, he closed the book and turned off the light.
classPractice.note: with a sigh 叹着气，作伴随状语置于句首

classPractice.question: 汉译英：与其为逝去的机会叹息，我们不如抓住眼前的机会。
classPractice.answer: Instead of sighing over the chances we have lost, we should seize the ones before us.
classPractice.note: sigh over sth 为某事叹息；instead of doing 与其……不如……

translation: 因此，由此
original_sentence: I shall be telling this with a sigh Somewhere ages and ages hence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I— I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
readingExamples: I shall be telling this with a sigh Somewhere ages and ages hence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I— I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. (formal) for this reason; that is why
(2) adv. (formal) from this time; from now (as in 'two years hence')
(3) adv. (literary or old use) from here; away from this place

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 从此（时）起；今后（表时间，如 ages hence = 许多年后）
uncommonMeanings.example: He wondered what the world would look like a century hence, when the saplings he planted today had grown into a towering forest. （读后续写·展望未来·时间跨度）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 从此地（离开）；离开这里（古旧文学用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: 'Get thee hence,' the old hermit murmured to the weary traveller, 'for a long road still lies between you and home.' （读后续写·古典叙事·旅途）

posExamples.sentence: The bridge had been weakened by years of flooding and was declared unsafe; hence, the villagers were forced to take a long detour through the mountains each morning. （议论文/记叙·因果·困境）
Our school library will undergo renovation next month; hence, all borrowed books must be returned before the end of this week. （应用文·通知）
Reading broadens the mind and sharpens the power of thought; hence, a nation that cherishes books is a nation forever young in spirit. （议论文·阅读的价值）
She had rehearsed the speech a hundred times and knew every pause by heart; hence, when she finally stepped onto the stage, not a trace of fear remained. （读后续写·厚积薄发·自信）

wordForms.other: henceforth / henceforward (adv. 今后，从此以后)

collocations.translation: 因此才有了这个名称/说法/问题（省略结构）
collocations.example: The little island is shaped exactly like a resting turtle — hence the name Turtle Rock, known to every fisherman along the coast. （读后续写/说明文·地名由来）
Regular exercise strengthens the heart and hence reduces the risk of many serious illnesses. （议论文·健康）
The seeds of kindness we sow today may not bloom until many years hence, in hearts we shall never even know. （读后续写/议论文·善意的回响）
Every action has consequences; hence it follows that even our smallest choices help to shape the person we become. （议论文·因果推理）
From that humbling defeat he learned a lasting lesson, and henceforth he never again underestimated an opponent. （读后续写·成长·教训）
The two experiments produced wildly different results, hence why the team decided to run the whole test a third time. （说明文·科研过程）

synonyms.example: The evidence was overwhelming; therefore, the committee reached its verdict without a moment's hesitation. （议论文·结论）
synonyms.usage: therefore 是最通用的'因此'，正式与半正式皆宜，最为常见；hence 更正式、更书面，常用于严谨的议论文或说明文

synonyms.example: He mastered the fundamentals first and thus found the advanced material surprisingly easy. （议论文·学习方法）
synonyms.usage: thus 与 hence 都偏正式，但 thus 还可表'以这种方式'；hence 除因果外还能表'今后'与'离开此地'，含义更广

synonyms.example: She had prepared thoroughly for every possible question; consequently, the interview went far more smoothly than she had dared to hope. （读后续写·准备·如愿）
synonyms.usage: consequently 强调'作为直接结果'，因果链条感更强；hence 更简洁凝练，语气也更学术

advancedExpressions.expression: hence / thus / therefore / consequently / as a result / accordingly（"因此"衔接词强度与正式度谱系）
advancedExpressions.example: The two experiments produced conflicting data; hence (= thus / therefore / consequently) the team decided to run the whole test once more.（hence/thus 最书面凝练，therefore 最通用，consequently/as a result 因果链条感最强；hence 后可直接接名词短语 hence the name）

advancedExpressions.expression: hence the name/term（因此才有此名，后接名词，非句子）; years/a week hence（若干年/一周之后，表时间）; hence it follows that...（由此可推出）; henceforth/henceforward（今后，从此以后）
advancedExpressions.example: The island is shaped like a resting turtle — hence the name Turtle Rock; a century hence, none of us will remember this quarrel.（hence 接名词=省略结构；时间名词 + hence=之后）

advancedExpressions.expression: hence 作副词=for this reason，本身不是连词，不能像 because 那样连接两个分句；须用分号/句号断句，或用 and hence
advancedExpressions.example: 误：It rained hence the match was cancelled. 正：It rained heavily; hence the match was cancelled. / It rained heavily, and hence the match was cancelled.（对比连词 so：It rained, so... 才合法）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., and years hence, sb. would ...
advancedExpressions.example: She could not know it then, but years hence she would look back on this ordinary afternoon as the very moment her whole life quietly changed course. （用 years hence 拉开时间纵深，制造宿命回望，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., hence + 通知事项
advancedExpressions.example: The sports meet has been rescheduled owing to the weather forecast; hence all participants are kindly asked to gather one hour earlier than originally planned. （因果连接通知句式，用于正式通知/告示）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., hence it becomes clear that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Talent without discipline seldom bears fruit; hence it becomes clear that perseverance, not raw ability, is the true architect of success. （用 hence 收束因果推理，凝练点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was raining, so the match was cancelled.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A fierce storm had swept in from the sea and shown no sign of easing; hence the long-awaited match was called off, to the bitter disappointment of players and supporters alike. （议论文/记叙·正式因果）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: hence 替 so 提升正式度 + shown no sign of easing 分句铺垫原因 + call off 短语替 cancel + to the disappointment of 结果状语渲染情绪

sentenceUpgrade.original: He worked hard, so he succeeded.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For years he had laboured in obscurity, refusing to let a single setback break his resolve; hence, when success finally came, no one who knew his story could call it luck. （读后续写/议论文·励志因果）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: For years...in obscurity 铺陈积累 + refusing to let...分词伴随 + hence 凝练收束 + no one could call it luck 反面强调必然性

classPractice.question: The little island is shaped exactly like a resting turtle — ____ the name Turtle Rock.
classPractice.note: hence + 名词短语="因此才有了……"的省略结构，后不接完整句子

classPractice.question: It had rained heavily all night; ____ (hence / because) the long-awaited match was called off.
classPractice.note: hence 是副词不是连词，用分号断句后引出结果；because 只能引导原因状语从句，此处不通

classPractice.question: 定期锻炼能强健心脏，从而降低患多种严重疾病的风险。（用 and hence）
classPractice.answer: Regular exercise strengthens the heart and hence reduces the risk of many serious illnesses.
classPractice.note: and hence 连接两个并列谓语，表"并因此"；hence 后省略主语直接接动词

translation: 敢于，胆敢；激（某人做某事）
original_sentence: But I dare not speak in a voice loud, For fear of scaring dwellers on high.
readingExamples: But I dare not speak in a voice loud, For fear of scaring dwellers on high.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to be brave enough to do something difficult or dangerous, or to be rude or silly enough to do something
(2) v. to challenge someone to do something dangerous or embarrassing, in order to prove how brave they are
(3) n. something dangerous or difficult that you try to persuade someone to do, to see if they are brave enough
(4) modal v. (used mainly in negatives and questions) to have the courage to do something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冒险的挑战；激将（做某事）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was only on a childish dare that he first climbed the forbidden wall, never dreaming that a single reckless afternoon would change the course of his summer. （读后续写·童年·鲁莽）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 激（某人做某事），以激将法怂恿
uncommonMeanings.example: His classmates dared him to speak up before the whole school, and to everyone's astonishment, the shy boy rose to his feet, trembling yet resolute. （读后续写·激将·突破自我）

posExamples.sentence: Though her voice shook and her knees felt like water, she dared to raise her hand and volunteer, refusing to let fear decide the kind of person she would become. （读后续写·勇气·突破胆怯）
I sincerely hope more young people will dare to step out of their comfort zones and take part in our volunteer programme, for growth always begins where fear ends. （应用文·倡议书）
History belongs to those who dare to dream beyond the limits of their age; every great leap forward began as an idea others were too timid to pursue. （议论文·创新与勇气）
He dared not look back at the burning house, for fear that the sight of his lost home would break the last of his crumbling courage. （读后续写·灾难·隐忍）

wordForms.other: daredevil (n. 天不怕地不怕的冒失鬼)

idioms.translation: 你/他/她怎么敢……（表愤怒或震惊）
idioms.example: 'How dare you speak to your mother like that!' she cried, her voice trembling somewhere between fury and heartbreak. （读后续写·冲突·情绪爆发）

idioms.translation: 你敢……试试（强烈警告、劝阻）
idioms.example: 'Don't you dare give up now,' the coach whispered fiercely, gripping the runner's shoulders, 'not when the finish line is this close.' （读后续写·激励·关键时刻）

idioms.translation: 我料想，我敢说（表推测，有把握）
idioms.example: I dare say she will be the first to arrive tomorrow, for in all these years she has never once been late. （读后续写·笃定推测·刻画品格）

idioms.translation: 激某人做某事
idioms.example: Grinning, he dared his younger brother to jump the widest stream, then held his breath, half proud and half afraid. （读后续写·手足之情·顽皮）

collocations.translation: 【课件】敢做（某事）（dare 作实义动词，to 可省）
collocations.example: Only a few journalists dare (to) cover the event. 只有少数记者敢报道这件事。（课件原句）
We'll dare any hardship and danger. 我们敢于面对任何艰难险阻。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: 【课件】dare not do sth（情态动词用法）
collocations.translation: 【课件】不敢做某事（dare 作情态动词，后跟动词原形，用于否定句）
collocations.example: She dared not go alone. 她不敢独自走。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: 【课件】Dare you do sth?（情态动词·疑问句）
collocations.translation: 【课件】你敢……吗？（dare 作情态动词，主要用于疑问句）
collocations.example: Dare you tell him the bad news? 你敢告诉他这个坏消息吗？（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: 【课件】If you dare do sth（情态动词·条件句）
collocations.translation: 【课件】如果你敢……（dare 作情态动词，用于条件句，后跟原形）
collocations.example: If you dare say that to our teacher, I would vote for you. 如果你敢把这告诉老师，我就给你投票。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】我料想，我敢说（表有把握的推测）
collocations.example: I dare say things will be improving. 我料想情况会好转的。（课件原句）
How dare you say that I was lying! 你胆敢说我在撒谎！（课件原句）
She was the only one who dared to challenge the unfair rule, and her quiet courage slowly gave others the strength to speak too. （读后续写·勇气·带动他人）
He dared not breathe a word of the secret, though the truth pressed against his silence like a rising tide. （读后续写·隐忍·煎熬）
How dare anyone claim that kindness is weakness, when it takes far more courage to be gentle than to be cruel? （议论文·善良与勇气）
Only those who dare to dream beyond the ordinary will ever reshape the world for the rest of us. （议论文·梦想·励志）
In a world that rewards conformity, it takes real courage to dare to be different and follow one's own quiet convictions. （议论文·个性）
The younger students wouldn't dare disturb the fierce old librarian, whose glare could silence an entire hall. （读后续写·校园·敬畏）

collocations.phrase: take a dare / accept a dare
collocations.example: Against his better judgement, he took the dare and plunged into the icy river, only to regret it the very next shivering second. （读后续写·冲动·后果）
Follow that shadowy path into the ancient forest, if you dare, and see what secrets its silence keeps. （读后续写·悬念·冒险）

synonyms.example: No one ventured to break the heavy silence, until a small voice at the back of the room finally spoke the truth. （读后续写·打破僵局）
synonyms.usage: venture 更书面，指冒着风险去尝试或斗胆开口，常含试探意味；dare 侧重'有胆量'面对危险或困难，口语与书面皆常用

synonyms.translation: 冒……的风险，敢于承担风险
synonyms.example: She was willing to risk everything she had built for the sake of a cause she believed in with all her heart. （读后续写·牺牲·信念）
synonyms.usage: risk 强调'甘冒损失或危险'，后接名词或动名词；dare 强调'有无勇气'，后接动词原形，重在心理层面的胆量

synonyms.translation: 勇敢面对，不畏（困难/风险）
synonyms.example: They braved the howling blizzard to bring medicine to the stranded villagers, their courage warmer than any fire. （读后续写·无畏·奉献）
synonyms.usage: brave 作动词指勇敢地面对、承受艰险，宾语是危险本身；dare 指敢不敢去做某事，二者侧重不同

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·dare 情态动词/实义动词双用
advancedExpressions.expression: 作情态动词（多用于否定/疑问）：dare not do sth / how dare you do? 后接原形、无 -s、无 to；作实义动词：dare (to) do sth、dares、dared、does not dare (to) do
advancedExpressions.example: He dare not tell the truth.（情态，无 to）= He does not dare to tell the truth.（实义，加 to）；How dare you speak to me like that?（情态，固定）

advancedExpressions.expression: dare (to) do sth（敢做）; dare not do sth（不敢做）; dare sb to do sth（激/怂恿某人做，激将法）; how dare you...（你怎么敢，表愤怒）; I dare say（我敢说，我料想，表推测）; don't you dare（你敢试试，强烈警告）
advancedExpressions.example: His classmates dared him to sing in front of the whole school.（激将）; I dare say she will be the first to arrive — she has never once been late.（笃定推测）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·dare say 特殊用法
advancedExpressions.expression: I dare say / I daresay = 我料想、我敢说（固定搭配，表有把握的推测，通常只用第一人称、一般现在时，不加 to）
advancedExpressions.example: I dare say you are tired after such a long journey — do come in and rest.（口语中软化语气的推测，相当于 I suppose/probably）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. dared to do what fear had long forbidden
advancedExpressions.example: In that trembling instant she dared to do what fear had long forbidden — she let go of the railing, closed her eyes, and trusted that the world would catch her. （破折号+连续动作，将'鼓起勇气'瞬间戏剧化，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I encourage every one of you to dare to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I encourage every one of you to dare to try, to fail, and to try again, for it is in daring greatly that we discover who we truly are. （号召句式，用于演讲稿/倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is those who dare ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is those who dare to question the accepted answer, rather than those who meekly accept it, that push the boundaries of human knowledge ever outward. （强调句 + dare，突出开拓者的胆识，创新类议题通用）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was brave enough to speak in front of everyone.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Summoning a courage she scarcely knew she possessed, she dared to step forward and speak before the entire hall, her voice steadying with every word until the trembling girl of moments ago had all but vanished. （读后续写·突破自我·成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Summoning a courage...分词开篇 + dare to 突出胆量 + her voice steadying 独立主格显变化 + until...had all but vanished 结果状语见成长弧线

sentenceUpgrade.original: Successful people are those who are not afraid to take risks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Behind almost every remarkable achievement stands a person who dared to venture where others hesitated, who treated failure not as a verdict but as a stepping stone toward something greater. （议论文·敢于冒险）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Behind...stands 倒装开篇造气势 + dare to venture 同义叠加强化 + who...who 并列定语从句排比 + not...but 对比重塑失败观

classPractice.type: 语境应用·情态/实义转换（课件）
classPractice.question: 改写：Do you dare (to) tell him the bad news? 用 dare 作情态动词改写为疑问句。
classPractice.answer: Dare you tell him the bad news?
classPractice.note: 课件语境应用。dare 作情态动词时后跟动词原形、无 to、无 -s，主要用于疑问句、否定句、条件句；实义动词则用 Do you dare (to) tell...?

classPractice.type: 翻译·情态动词否定句（课件）
classPractice.question: 她不敢独自走。（用 dare 作情态动词）
classPractice.note: 课件原句。情态动词 dare 的否定：dared not + 原形，无 to

classPractice.question: 如果你敢把这告诉老师，我就给你投票。
classPractice.answer: If you dare say that to our teacher, I would vote for you.
classPractice.note: 课件原句。情态动词 dare 用于条件句，dare 后跟动词原形 say

classPractice.question: "How ____ you speak to your mother like that!" she cried, her voice trembling with fury.
classPractice.note: how dare you 为固定情态结构，dare 后接原形动词，表愤怒或震惊

classPractice.question: 尽管声音发抖，她还是敢于举手做志愿者。Though her voice shook, she ____________ (敢于举手) and volunteer.
classPractice.answer: dared to raise her hand / dared raise her hand
classPractice.note: 作实义动词时 dare (to) do 均可；此处已用一般过去时 dared

classPractice.question: His friends ____ (dared / encouraged) him to jump into the icy river, and he foolishly took the dare.
classPractice.note: dare sb to do sth=激将、怂恿；后文 take the dare(接受激将)与之呼应，encourage 语义为鼓励，不含挑衅意味

translation: 居民，居住者
original_sentence: But I dare not speak in a voice loud, For fear of scaring dwellers on high.
readingExamples: But I dare not speak in a voice loud, For fear of scaring dwellers on high.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person or animal that lives in a particular type of place or environment (usually in compounds, e.g. city-dweller, cave-dweller)
(2) n. an inhabitant or resident of a specified area, especially one regarded in relation to their surroundings

posExamples.sentence: As a lifelong mountain dweller, old Grandpa Wu could read the mood of the clouds the way city folk read a newspaper, and he knew, long before the first drop fell, that a storm was coming. （读后续写·山村人物）

I am writing to appeal to my fellow city dwellers to spend at least one weekend a month in the countryside, reconnecting with the soil and the seasons that our concrete lives have made us forget. （应用文·倡议书）
Contrary to the romantic image of the carefree country dweller, rural residents today face challenges no less daunting than those of their urban counterparts. （议论文·城乡差异）

The cave dwellers of that remote valley had, over countless generations, carved their homes directly into the cliff face, so that at dusk the mountainside glowed like a honeycomb of firelight. （读后续写·环境描写）

collocations.example: For the average city dweller, the sudden silence of the countryside can feel less like peace and more like an unfamiliar kind of loneliness. （读后续写·进城/返乡）
Rural dwellers, long dismissed as being out of touch, have in fact preserved traditions and skills that our fast-paced society is only now learning to treasure. （议论文·乡村价值）
The exhibition vividly recreated the daily life of ancient cave dwellers, from the flickering fire pit to the crude tools scattered across the earthen floor. （应用文·参观报告）
Owls, foxes and countless other forest dwellers depend on this ancient woodland for their very survival. （应用文·环保倡议）
The charity aims to bring clean water and basic education to the slum dwellers on the outskirts of the sprawling city. （应用文·公益报道）
As high-rise dwellers, we rarely knew our neighbours' names — until a power cut one summer night gathered us all, candle in hand, on the shared stairwell. （读后续写·邻里温情）
Desert dwellers have devised ingenious ways of storing every precious drop of rainfall. （议论文·适应环境）
Generations of coastal dwellers had learned to live in rhythm with the tides, their whole way of life rising and falling with the sea. （读后续写·渔村）

synonyms.example: The islanders, the sole inhabitants of that windswept rock, greeted the shipwrecked sailor with a warmth he had not dared to hope for. （读后续写·孤岛救助）
synonyms.usage: 最正式、最通用的"居民"，人或动物皆可，常用于书面描述某地全体住户；dweller 更强调"与某种环境相依而居"，多用作复合词

synonyms.example: As a long-term resident of this community, I feel duty-bound to raise my voice against the proposed demolition of our beloved old library. （应用文·反对信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"合法长期居住于某处"，行政/法律色彩强，常与 community、area 搭配；dweller 更文学化、更强调生存环境

synonyms.example: When the new owners arrived, they found that the previous occupants had left behind nothing but a single, mysterious photograph on the mantelpiece. （读后续写·悬念）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"占据某一具体空间(房屋、座位、车辆)的人"，中性、临时性强；dweller 强调长期栖居于某类环境

advancedExpressions.expression: dwell（v. 居住，栖居，正式/文学）+ -er（表"人/生物"）→ dweller（居住者）；同族：dwelling（n. 住所，居所）；常构成复合名词 city-/cave-/forest-dweller
advancedExpressions.example: Owls, foxes and countless other forest dwellers depend on this ancient woodland; they have dwelt here for thousands of years, and it remains their only dwelling.（dwell/dweller/dwelling 同族串用）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·dwell 动词高频结构
advancedExpressions.expression: dwell in/on a place（居住于，正式）; dwell on/upon sth（老想着、反复琢磨、纠缠于某事，常指烦心事）; dwell on a point（详述某点）
advancedExpressions.example: Don't dwell on past mistakes; let them teach you and then let them go.（dwell on=反复回想，多含消极意味，是高考写作与阅读高频短语）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·复合名词 X-dweller 家族
advancedExpressions.expression: city/urban dweller（城市居民）、rural/country dweller（乡村居民）、cave dweller（穴居人）、forest/woodland dweller（林栖生物）、slum dweller（贫民窟居民）、desert/coastal/island dweller（沙漠/海边/海岛居民）
advancedExpressions.example: For the average city dweller, the sudden silence of the countryside feels less like peace and more like loneliness.（dweller 强调"与某类环境相依而居"，比 resident/inhabitant 更文学化）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境融入人物
advancedExpressions.expression: as a true dweller of ..., sb. could ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a true dweller of the wilderness, he could name every birdcall and foretell every shift of the wind — the forest was not his home; it was an extension of himself. （破折号补充+隐喻，人物与环境合一）

advancedExpressions.expression: I call upon my fellow ... dwellers to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I call upon my fellow city dwellers to reclaim our green spaces, for a city without living nature is merely a beautiful cage. （倡议信呼告+比喻收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: contrary to the popular image of the ... dweller, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Contrary to the popular image of the rural dweller as backward and isolated, today's villagers are increasingly connected, informed and ambitious. （contrary to 让步开篇，破除偏见）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The people who lived in the mountains knew the weather well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mountain dwellers, whose lives had been shaped by the moods of the peaks for generations, could sense a coming storm in the way the birds fell silent and the air grew suddenly still. （读后续写·环境预兆）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: compound noun(mountain dwellers)替换 people who lived + whose 定语从句补充背景 + 感官细节(birds fell silent, air grew still)营造预兆氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: We city people should go to the countryside more.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that we city dwellers, so long imprisoned by steel and glass, stepped out of our concrete forests and rediscovered the quiet wisdom of the land. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 过去式虚拟语气 + 同位插入(so long imprisoned...)营造对比 + concrete forests 比喻收尾

classPractice.question: There is no use ____ ____ past failures; what matters is what you do next.（老想着，用 dwell 的正确形式）
classPractice.note: dwell on sth=反复回想、纠缠于某事；There is no use doing 结构要求动名词 dwelling

classPractice.question: 作为一名城市居民，我呼吁大家每月至少去一次乡村。As a ____________ (城市居民), I appeal to everyone to visit the countryside at least once a month.
classPractice.note: city dweller 为固定复合名词，dweller 由 dwell + -er 构成，指"与某类环境相依而居的人"

classPractice.question: The exhibition recreated the daily life of ancient cave ____ (dwellers / occupants), from the fire pit to the crude tools on the earthen floor.
classPractice.note: dweller 强调长期栖居于某类环境(穴居)，occupant 侧重临时占据某具体空间，此处指史前穴居人用 dwellers

translation: 引人注目的，显著的；鲜明动人的，漂亮的
original_sentence: With striking imagination in expressions like “scaring dwellers on high”, this early poem already displayed signs of a romantic style, which was later to characterize Li Bai’s poetry.
readingExamples: With striking imagination in expressions like “scaring dwellers on high”, this early poem already displayed signs of a romantic style, which was later to characterize Li Bai’s poetry.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. very noticeable or unusual, so as to attract attention or make a strong impression
(2) adj. very attractive, impressive or beautiful in an unusual and eye-catching way
(3) adj. (of a difference or similarity) so clear or great that it is impossible to ignore

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (工人)正在罢工的
uncommonMeanings.example: The striking miners gathered outside the factory gates at dawn, their placards trembling in the cold wind, their faces set with a determination that no threat could shake. （读后续写·工人抗争·集体意志）

posExamples.sentence: The moment she removed her hood, a hush fell over the hall — there was something so striking about her calm, unflinching gaze that even the noisiest of the crowd fell silent. （读后续写·人物出场）
What impressed me most about the exhibition was the striking contrast between the ancient calligraphy and the modern digital installations displayed side by side. （应用文·参观报告）
The survey revealed a striking correlation between hours of sleep and academic performance, a finding that no responsible school can afford to overlook. （议论文·数据论证）
Against the grey monotony of the winter fields, the single red kite was a striking splash of colour, drawing every eye upward as if by an invisible thread. （读后续写·环境描写）

wordForms.other: striker (n. 罢工者/前锋)

idioms.translation: 在很近的距离内；即将达到，唾手可得
idioms.example: After months of relentless training, the young climber was at last within striking distance of the summit, and the thought alone sent a fresh surge of strength through her aching legs. （读后续写·登顶励志）

collocations.example: 课文原句：With striking imagination in expressions like "scaring dwellers on high", this early poem already displayed signs of a romantic style.（striking imagination=非凡的想象力，形容第一眼就抓住注意力的鲜明特征）
There was a striking contrast between his humble appearance and the extraordinary talent that poured out the instant his bow touched the strings. （读后续写·人物反差）
The detective was struck by the striking resemblance between the two portraits, separated by three centuries yet sharing the very same haunting smile. （读后续写·悬念推理）
The most striking feature of this ancient town is its perfectly preserved stone bridges, each one a silent witness to a thousand years of history. （应用文·景点介绍）
Tall, silver-haired and striking in appearance, the old professor commanded the lecture hall the moment he stepped through the door. （读后续写·人物刻画）
The play's minimalist stage produced a surprisingly striking effect, leaving the audience's imagination to fill the empty space. （应用文·观后感）
The lake at sunrise was strikingly beautiful, its surface a sheet of molten gold rippling gently in the morning breeze. （读后续写·风景描写）
As students, we must learn to strike a delicate balance between diligent study and adequate rest. （议论文·学习方法）

synonyms.example: The remarkable calm with which the boy faced the raging flood was something the whole village would speak of for years. （读后续写·勇气）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"值得注意、了不起"，褒义且较正式，可修饰成就/品质/进步；striking 更强调"第一眼就抓住注意力"的视觉或感官冲击

synonyms.example: The team put on an impressive display of teamwork that earned them a standing ovation. （应用文·活动报道）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"因规模、质量、技巧而令人钦佩"，偏向正面评价；striking 更中性，仅强调"醒目、抓眼"，未必是赞美

synonyms.example: In his conspicuous scarlet coat, the newcomer stood out awkwardly among the sea of dark uniforms. （读后续写·格格不入）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"因与周围格格不入而显眼"，常含尴尬/负面意味；striking 的显眼多带审美或印象上的积极冲击

synonyms.example: An eye-catching poster at the school gate announced the upcoming charity concert. （应用文·海报宣传）
synonyms.usage: 口语化、偏商业/设计语境，强调"设计得吸引目光"；striking 更文学、程度更深，也可形容抽象的差异或对比

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·strike 词族全家桶
advancedExpressions.expression: strike（v. 打击/罢工/使突然想到，struck-struck）→ striking（adj. 引人注目的，现在分词转形容词）/ strikingly（adv. 显著地）/ striker（n. 罢工者；足球前锋）/ strike（n. 罢工，敲击）；注意 striking 另有"正在罢工的"义
advancedExpressions.example: It suddenly struck me that the striking resemblance between them was no accident; the two were strikingly alike in both looks and temper.（strike sb=突然想到；striking 强调醒目冲击）

advancedExpressions.expression: strike a balance between（在…之间取得平衡）; it strikes sb that...（某人突然想到）; be struck by（被…打动/震撼）; within striking distance of（离…很近，唾手可得）; strike while the iron is hot（趁热打铁）
advancedExpressions.example: After months of training, the climber was at last within striking distance of the summit.（striking distance=近在咫尺）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"引人注目"程度谱系
advancedExpressions.expression: striking / remarkable / impressive / conspicuous / eye-catching（"醒目"辨析）
advancedExpressions.example: striking 强调第一眼的感官冲击(中性偏审美)；remarkable 侧重"了不起、值得注意"(褒义)；impressive 侧重"因规模技巧而钦佩"；conspicuous 常因"格格不入"而显眼(可含贬义)；eye-catching 偏设计/商业。

advancedExpressions.expression: there was something (so) striking about ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was something so striking about the stranger's stillness that the whole restaurant seemed to lower its voice around him. （something...that 结构 + 环境反应烘托人物气场）

advancedExpressions.expression: the striking contrast between A and B
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing captures the spirit of our campus better than the striking contrast between the century-old library and the gleaming new science hall standing shoulder to shoulder. （用对比呈现'传统与现代并存'的主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: the data / survey reveals a striking ...
advancedExpressions.example: The survey reveals a striking gap between what students claim to value and how they actually spend their time — a gap that deserves our serious reflection. （striking 强化数据的说服冲击力 + 破折号引出论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The girl was very beautiful and everyone noticed her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So striking was the girl's beauty that heads turned the instant she entered, and for a long moment the buzzing room forgot to breathe. （读后续写·人物出场）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: So + adj. + be 倒装强调 + so...that 结果状语 + 拟人夸张(the room forgot to breathe)增强画面冲击

sentenceUpgrade.original: There is a big difference between the two schools.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What is most striking is the difference between the two schools: one clings to rigid tradition, the other embraces bold innovation — and therein lies a debate worth having. （议论文·对比论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What is most striking 强调主语从句 + 冒号引出并列对照 + therein lies 正式收束引出论点

classPractice.question: The survey revealed a ____ (strike) correlation between hours of sleep and academic performance, a finding no school can afford to overlook.
classPractice.note: strike 的现在分词转形容词 striking=显著的、引人注目的，修饰名词 correlation

classPractice.question: The lake at sunrise was ____ (strikingly / strike) beautiful, its surface a sheet of molten gold.
classPractice.note: 修饰形容词 beautiful 须用副词 strikingly=格外地、显著地

classPractice.question: In his ____ (striking / conspicuous) scarlet coat, the newcomer stood out awkwardly among the sea of dark uniforms.
classPractice.note: conspicuous 强调因与周围格格不入而显眼、常含尴尬意味；striking 的醒目多带审美或印象上的积极冲击，此处"格格不入"用 conspicuous

translation: (also characterise) 是……的特征，以……为主要特点；使……具有特点；描写，刻画（美式拼写 characterise）
original_sentence: Given his personal experiences and the historical background, it is only natural to see that the majority of Li Bai’s poems are characterized by the romantic style.
readingExamples: Given his personal experiences and the historical background, it is only natural to see that the majority of Li Bai’s poems are characterized by the romantic style.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to be typical of a person, place or thing; to be a distinctive feature of
(2) vt. to describe or portray the distinctive character or qualities of someone or something (as being something)
(3) vt. (of a writer or actor) to create and give distinctive traits to a character in a story or play

posExamples.sentence: A quiet, unshakeable determination characterized everything the old craftsman did, from the way he chose his timber to the final, loving stroke of his brush. （读后续写·工匠精神）
It would be unfair to characterize our generation as lazy or indifferent, for behind every screen there beats a heart that longs to make a difference. （议论文·为青年辩护）
