I would characterize the volunteer trip as the most rewarding experience of my school life, one that reshaped how I see both hardship and hope. （应用文·经历分享）
The novel is characterized by long, winding sentences that mirror the restless wandering of its heroine's mind. （议论文·文学赏析）

collocations.phrase: 【课件】(事物) characterize (特征) = (事物) be characterized by (特征)
collocations.translation: 【课件】是……的特点（主动 characterize / 被动 be characterized by 可互换）
collocations.example: Bright colors and free brushwork characterize his paintings. 明亮的色彩和自由的笔法是他绘画的特点。（课件原句）
This modern city is characterized by tall buildings in steel and glass. 这座现代城市的特点是钢制和玻璃制的高楼大厦。（课件原句）
The play is characterized as a tragedy. 这部戏被界定为一出悲剧。 / She was characterized as (being) well-educated and diligent. 她被描述为受过良好教育且勤奋。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】塑造一个人的性格（character n. 品格，性格；人物，角色；特点）
collocations.example: Hardship in his early years helped shape his character. 早年的艰辛帮助塑造了他的性格。（character 义项·课件）

collocations.translation: 【课件】符合／不符合（某人）的个性
collocations.example: His behavior at the party was completely out of character. 他在聚会上的举止完全不符合他一贯的个性。（课件原句）
She spoke with characteristic enthusiasm. 她说话带着特有的热情。 / The two groups of children have quite different characteristics. 这两组儿童具有截然不同的特点。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be characterized by sth（课文原句）
collocations.example: 课文原句：Given his personal experiences and the historical background, it is only natural to see that the majority of Li Bai's poems are characterized by the romantic style.（be characterized by=以……为显著特点，最高频被动搭配）
History has often characterized him as a reckless dreamer, yet a closer look reveals a mind of remarkable discipline. （议论文·历史人物评价）
The reforms that characterized that golden age transformed a struggling nation into a beacon of prosperity. （议论文·时代变迁）
No single word could aptly characterize the mixture of pride, grief and relief that washed over her at the finish line. （读后续写·情感交织）
To characterize failure as the opposite of success is to misunderstand the very nature of growth. （议论文·成长观）

collocations.translation: 是某种关系/风格/方式的特点
collocations.example: Mutual trust and gentle honesty characterized the friendship between the two boys long before either could put it into words. （读后续写·友情）
With characteristic generosity, the old teacher slipped a few extra books into the poor student's bag. （读后续写·师恩）
Great leaders across the centuries share certain common characteristics: vision, courage and an unshakeable faith in others. （议论文·领导力）

synonyms.example: The tireless nurse typified the quiet heroism of all those who worked through the long nights of the crisis. （读后续写·致敬平凡英雄）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"作为典型代表而体现某类事物的本质"，主语常是"某个体"，宾语是"某类品质"；characterize 更强调"是……的显著特征"，主客关系更灵活

synonyms.example: It is not our failures but our response to them that defines who we truly are. （议论文·人格塑造）
synonyms.usage: 语气更强，指"根本性地决定某物的本质"；characterize 语气较轻，仅指"是显著特点之一"，未必是决定性的

synonyms.example: The film portrays the poet not as a distant legend but as a lonely, laughing man wandering under the moon. （议论文·影视评论）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"通过艺术手段(文字/影像)描绘形象"，对应 characterize 的"刻画"义；characterize 另有"客观上是……特征"的核心义，portray 无此用法

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·character 词族全家桶
advancedExpressions.expression: character（n. 性格/人物/字符）→ characterize/characterise（v. 是…特征；刻画）→ characteristic（adj. 特有的 / n. 特征）→ characteristically（adv. 一贯地，特有地）→ characterization（n. 人物塑造，刻画）；注意 -ize（英）/-ise（美）拼写
advancedExpressions.example: The novel's vivid characterization gives each figure a characteristic voice; a wry humour characterizes even its darkest scenes.（character 家族串用，一词多形）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be characterized by 被动结构
advancedExpressions.expression: sth be characterized by + 名词/名词短语（以…为特征，主语是被描述的事物）；主动 sth characterizes sb/sth（某特质是某物的特点）；characterize sb/sth as...（把…刻画为…）
advancedExpressions.example: Li Bai's poetry is characterized by bold imagination.（被动）= Bold imagination characterizes Li Bai's poetry.（主动，抽象名词作主语，写作高级句式）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"是…特征/刻画"
advancedExpressions.expression: characterize / typify / define / portray（辨析）
advancedExpressions.example: characterize=是…的显著特征(主客灵活)；typify=作为典型代表体现某类品质；define=根本性地决定本质(语气最强)；portray=通过文字影像描绘形象。四者可视语气强弱与"客观特征/艺术描绘"择用。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·概括人物特质
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., and this alone characterized everything sb. did
advancedExpressions.example: A stubborn refusal to give up — this alone characterized everything the boy did, on the running track and in life. （破折号提炼核心品质 + this alone 强调 + 由具体到抽象的升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would characterize ... as ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would characterize this exchange programme as a window rather than a mere activity — a window through which I glimpsed a wider, kinder world. （characterize...as 表明立场 + rather than 对比 + 比喻延展）

advancedExpressions.expression: what truly characterizes ... is not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What truly characterizes a mature society is not the absence of conflict, but the wisdom with which it turns conflict into progress. （not...but 辩证结构 + 抽象概括时代精神）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old man was always kind, and this was his main quality.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A gentle, unfailing kindness characterized the old man's every gesture — the way he greeted the postman, fed the strays, and paused to help a stranger read a map. （读后续写·人物品质）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词短语作主语(kindness characterized) + 破折号列举三个具体动作画面 + 三项排比(greeted, fed, paused)由抽象到具象

sentenceUpgrade.original: Li Bai's poems have a romantic style.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Li Bai's poetry is characterized by an unbridled romantic style, in which soaring imagination and a boundless yearning for freedom fuse into verses that seem to leap straight off the page. （议论文·诗歌赏析）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be characterized by 正式被动 + in which 定语从句展开 + fuse into 动词提升 + leap off the page 拟人比喻收尾

classPractice.type: 同义句转换·主动被动互换（课件）
classPractice.question: 改写为被动语态：Bright colors and free brushwork characterize his paintings. → His paintings ____________.
classPractice.answer: are characterized by bright colors and free brushwork
classPractice.note: 课件核心：(事物) characterize (特征) = (事物) be characterized by (特征)，主动与被动可互换

classPractice.question: 她被描述为受过良好教育且勤奋。She ____________ (being) well-educated and diligent.
classPractice.note: 课件句型 characterize sb/sth as sth/(being) adj.=把……描述成……，此处用被动 be characterized as

classPractice.question: She spoke with ____ (character) enthusiasm, just as she always did.
classPractice.note: 课件：characteristic adj.=典型的、特有的（=typical），修饰名词 enthusiasm；character 是名词，不能作定语

classPractice.question: The majority of Li Bai's poems are ____ (characterize) by a bold, romantic style that soars beyond the earthly world.
classPractice.note: be characterized by=以…为特征，主语 poems 是被描述对象，用被动语态

classPractice.question: 我愿把这次志愿之旅描述为我校园生活中最有意义的经历。I would ____________ (把…描述为) the volunteer trip ____ the most rewarding experience of my school life.
classPractice.note: characterize sb/sth as...=把…刻画/描述为…，as 后接对该事物的定性

classPractice.question: With ____ (character) generosity, the old teacher always slipped a few extra books into the poor student's bag.
classPractice.note: 此处需形容词 characteristic=特有的、一贯的，修饰名词 generosity；不可用动词 characterize

translation: 儒家，儒学，孔子学说
original_sentence: He started studying the classics when he was only five years old, and was reading ancient philosophers of different schools at the age of ten, including Confucianism and Taoism.
readingExamples: He started studying the classics when he was only five years old, and was reading ancient philosophers of different schools at the age of ten, including Confucianism and Taoism.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the system of ethical, philosophical and political thought developed from the teachings of Confucius, emphasising benevolence, ritual propriety, filial piety and social harmony
(2) n. the traditional Chinese school of thought that has profoundly shaped the moral and social values of East Asian civilisation

posExamples.sentence: Rooted in Confucianism, the values of respect for elders and devotion to learning still quietly shape the way many Chinese families live today. （议论文·传统文化影响）
During the cultural workshop, our foreign guests were fascinated to learn how Confucianism has, for over two thousand years, placed education at the very heart of Chinese life. （应用文·文化交流报道）
As a young boy, Li Bai steeped himself in the classics of Confucianism and Taoism, and the tension between the two would later breathe life into his poetry. （读后续写·人物成长背景）

collocations.example: The idea that a good ruler must first cultivate his own virtue is deeply rooted in Confucianism. （议论文·治国之道）
The influence of Confucianism can be felt in everything from classroom etiquette to the reverence shown to teachers. （议论文·文化影响）
Confucian values such as honesty, diligence and respect for others remain a compass for many young people navigating a fast-changing world. （议论文·青年与传统）
The teachings of Confucianism urge us to treat others as we ourselves wish to be treated. （应用文·文化介绍）
As a devoted follower of Confucianism, the scholar believed that lifelong learning was the truest path to virtue. （读后续写·古代学者）

synonyms.example: Confucian thought teaches that a harmonious society begins with a well-ordered family. （议论文·社会和谐）
synonyms.usage: 与 Confucianism 基本同义，作"思想体系"讲时更口语化、更侧重"观念内容"；Confucianism 是学术/正式的"学说、主义"总称

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·Confucius 专有名词家族
advancedExpressions.expression: Confucius（n. 孔子，人名）→ Confucianism（n. 儒家思想/儒学，-ism 表"主义、学说"）→ Confucian（adj. 儒家的 / n. 儒家学者）；同类 -ism：Taoism 道家、Buddhism 佛教、Marxism 马克思主义
advancedExpressions.example: Confucius taught that virtue can be learned; from his sayings grew Confucianism, and Confucian values still shape Chinese family life today.（人名→-ism 学说→-an 形容词，三形一族）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·文化介绍高频搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: rooted in Confucianism（植根于儒家）; the influence/teachings of Confucianism（儒家的影响/教诲）; Confucian values/ideals（儒家价值观/理想）; at the heart of Confucianism lies...（儒家的核心在于…）
advancedExpressions.example: Confucian values such as respect for elders and love of learning remain a compass for many young people.（专有名词首字母恒大写，介绍中华文化写作常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: rooted in Confucianism, the belief that ... continues to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rooted in Confucianism, the belief that learning ennobles the soul continues to inspire generation after generation of Chinese students. （过去分词短语开篇点明思想源头 + 抽象升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: at the heart of Confucianism lies ...
advancedExpressions.example: At the heart of Confucianism lies a simple yet profound idea: that to better the world, one must first better oneself. （倒装 lies 引出核心思想 + 冒号解释，适合文化介绍信）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Confucianism is important in Chinese culture.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Confucianism is not merely a chapter in Chinese history but a living current that still runs beneath the surface of everyday life, shaping how we learn, how we treat our elders, and how we imagine a good society. （议论文·文化传承）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not merely...but 递进对比 + living current 比喻 + 三个 how 引导的宾语从句排比，将抽象影响具象化

classPractice.question: Values such as respect for elders and devotion to learning, rooted in ____ (Confucius), still shape many Chinese families today.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词"儒家思想"Confucianism（Confucius=孔子本人）；-ism 表学说，首字母大写

classPractice.question: The scholar was a devoted follower of ____ (Confucianism / Confucian) values, believing lifelong learning to be the path to virtue.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 values 须用形容词 Confucian=儒家的；Confucianism 是名词，不能直接作定语

classPractice.question: 儒家思想的影响体现在从课堂礼仪到尊师重道的方方面面。（用 the influence of Confucianism）
classPractice.answer: The influence of Confucianism can be felt in everything from classroom etiquette to the reverence shown to teachers.
classPractice.note: the influence of Confucianism 为固定搭配；专有名词 Confucianism 首字母大写

translation: 道教，道家
original_sentence: He started studying the classics when he was only five years old, and was reading ancient philosophers of different schools at the age of ten, including Confucianism and Taoism.
readingExamples: He started studying the classics when he was only five years old, and was reading ancient philosophers of different schools at the age of ten, including Confucianism and Taoism.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an ancient Chinese philosophy and way of life founded on the teachings of Laozi, centred on living in harmony with the Tao (the natural way of the universe) and the ideal of effortless action (wu wei)
(2) n. the religious tradition that developed from this philosophy, with its own deities, rituals and pursuit of longevity

posExamples.sentence: Taoism teaches that, like water, the wise soul yields yet endures, flowing around every obstacle instead of shattering against it. （议论文·处世智慧）
Wandering alone among the misty peaks, Li Bai seemed to embody the very spirit of Taoism — free, boundless, and utterly at one with nature. （读后续写·诗人漫游）
In my presentation on Chinese thought, I explained how Taoism, with its love of simplicity and stillness, offers a gentle antidote to the restless pace of modern life. （应用文·演讲/汇报）

wordForms.other: Tao / Dao (道)

collocations.example: The philosophy of Taoism invites us to slow down and rediscover the quiet wisdom hidden in ordinary things. （议论文·生活哲学）
In the spirit of Taoism, the old gardener never forced his plants but simply gave them light, water and time. （读后续写·顺应自然）
Taoist thought, with its reverence for nature, feels strikingly relevant in an age of environmental crisis. （议论文·生态智慧）
Deeply influenced by Taoism, Li Bai's poems overflow with rivers, moons and a longing to dissolve into the vastness of nature. （议论文·诗歌赏析）

collocations.phrase: harmony with nature (a core idea of Taoism)
collocations.translation: 与自然和谐(道家核心思想)
collocations.example: Living in harmony with nature, a core idea of Taoism, is no longer a distant ideal but an urgent necessity for our planet. （议论文·环保）

synonyms.example: Whether spelled Daoism or Taoism, this ancient philosophy urges us to flow with the natural rhythm of life. （应用文·文化介绍）
synonyms.usage: 与 Taoism 完全同义，只是拼写不同：Daoism 依据现代汉语拼音，Taoism 是较早的威妥玛式旧拼法，学术界二者通用

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·Taoism 专有名词家族与拼写
advancedExpressions.expression: Tao/Dao（n. 道）→ Taoism/Daoism（n. 道家/道教，-ism 表学说，两种拼写通用）→ Taoist/Daoist（adj. 道家的 / n. 道士）；Taoism 为威妥玛旧拼法，Daoism 依现代汉语拼音，学术界二者互通
advancedExpressions.example: Whether spelled Taoism or Daoism, this ancient philosophy, built on the idea of the Tao, urges us to flow with the natural rhythm of life.（Tao→Taoism→Taoist 同族，且 T-/D- 拼写并存）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·文化介绍高频搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: the philosophy of Taoism（道家哲学）; in the spirit of Taoism（本着道家精神）; Taoist ideals/thought（道家理想/思想）; influenced by Taoism（受道家影响）; harmony with nature（与自然和谐，道家核心）
advancedExpressions.example: Deeply influenced by Taoism, Li Bai's poems overflow with rivers, moons and a longing to dissolve into nature.（介绍中华思想、赏析李白诗歌写作常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the manner of Taoism, sb. learned to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the manner of Taoism, she learned at last to stop fighting the current and simply let the river carry her home. （借道家'顺应'哲思收束续写 + let the river carry 隐喻）

advancedExpressions.expression: the wisdom of Taoism reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The wisdom of Taoism reminds us that true strength often lies not in resistance but in the quiet art of yielding. （引古代智慧论证观点 + not...but 辩证收尾）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Taoism tells people to live with nature.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Taoism whispers a truth our hurried age has all but forgotten: that we do not stand above nature but belong within it, and that peace begins the moment we stop struggling against its gentle flow. （议论文·人与自然）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人(whispers a truth) + 冒号引出观点从句 + not...but 对照 + gentle flow 呼应道家"水"意象收尾

classPractice.question: Wandering among the misty peaks, Li Bai seemed to embody the very spirit of ____ (Tao) — free, boundless and at one with nature.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词"道家/道教"Taoism；Tao 单独指"道"这一概念，作"学说"讲要加 -ism

classPractice.question: ____ (Taoist / Taoism) thought, with its reverence for nature, feels strikingly relevant in an age of environmental crisis.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 thought 须用形容词 Taoist=道家的；Taoism 是名词，不能直接作定语

classPractice.question: 李白的诗深受道家思想影响，充满江河、明月与融入自然的渴望。（用 influenced by Taoism）
classPractice.answer: Deeply influenced by Taoism, Li Bai's poems overflow with rivers, moons and a longing to dissolve into nature.
classPractice.note: influenced by Taoism 为固定搭配，作过去分词状语；专有名词 Taoism 首字母大写

translation: 传说，传奇故事；传奇人物
original_sentence: The moon and stars in the sky, the natural landscape and the figures in legends all become a vehicle for his imagination.
readingExamples: The moon and stars in the sky, the natural landscape and the figures in legends all become a vehicle for his imagination.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an old, traditional story, often about heroes or extraordinary events, that many people believe but which may not be entirely true
(2) n. a very famous person, especially in a particular field, who is admired by many people
(3) n. the explanatory words accompanying a map, chart or illustration; a key
(4) n. an inscription, especially on a coin, medal or under a picture

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 传奇人物（尤指某领域极受崇敬、名声极大者，如 a living legend）
uncommonMeanings.example: On behalf of the whole school, I would like to invite Mr. Zhang, a living legend of Chinese table tennis, to share his inspiring journey. （应用文·邀请信；此义常与 living/sporting/screen 连用）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (地图、图表的)图例，说明文字
uncommonMeanings.example: Squinting at the faded map, the boy finally found the tiny cross in the legend that marked the buried treasure, and his heart began to pound. （读后续写·寻宝·图例线索）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (硬币、纪念碑等上的)题词，铭文
uncommonMeanings.example: The worn silver coin bore a barely readable legend around its rim — a single Latin phrase that would, decades later, unlock the mystery of her family's origins. （读后续写·家族秘密·铭文伏笔）

posExamples.sentence: According to an ancient legend, whoever drank from the hidden spring would never grow old, and it was this whispered promise that drew the weary traveller deep into the forbidden forest. （读后续写·传说驱动情节）
On behalf of the whole school, I would like to invite Mr. Zhang, a living legend of Chinese table tennis, to share his inspiring journey at our sports festival. （应用文·邀请信）
Whether a hero becomes a mere footnote or a lasting legend depends less on the scale of their deeds than on the values those deeds embody. （议论文·英雄与传承）
The moon, the stars and the figures of ancient legends all became a vehicle for the poet's soaring imagination, carrying his lonely dreams across a thousand years. （读后续写/赏析·诗歌意象）

idioms.idiom: a legend in one's own lifetime / time
idioms.translation: 在世时已成传奇的人物
idioms.example: By the age of thirty, the young inventor had become a legend in her own lifetime, her name spoken in the same breath as those she had once only read about. （读后续写·励志成名）

idioms.translation: 堪称传奇的素材；极不寻常的
idioms.example: His comeback in the final ten seconds of the match was truly the stuff of legend, retold by fans for years to come. （读后续写/体育报道·传奇时刻）

collocations.example: An ancient legend held that the mountain would weep tears of stone whenever an innocent soul was wronged. （读后续写·奇幻传说）
According to legend, the West Lake was formed from a pearl dropped by a dragon and a phoenix from the heavens. （应用文·景点介绍）
To thousands of young athletes, the veteran coach was nothing less than a living legend. （应用文·人物报道）
He did not set out to become a legend; he simply refused, day after day, to give up on a dream everyone else had abandoned. （读后续写·坚持成就传奇）
The legend of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl has moved Chinese hearts for centuries, especially on the night of the Qixi Festival. （应用文·传统节日介绍）
Legend has it that a wise old fox once guarded this village, warning the people of every coming flood. （读后续写·民间传说）
Their heroic stand at the bridge soon passed into legend, inspiring songs and stories long after the war had ended. （议论文/叙事·英雄传颂）
Li Bai remains a legendary figure whose verses still light up the night sky of Chinese poetry. （议论文·文学地位）

synonyms.example: The myth of the moon goddess Chang'e has enchanted Chinese children for generations. （应用文·文化介绍）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"关于神明、创世的神圣故事"，宗教/超自然色彩更浓，也可指"广为流传的错误观念"；legend 多讲"半真半假的英雄/历史传说"，往往有现实原型

synonyms.example: Rich in folklore, the old town seemed to have a story hiding behind every stone bridge and willow tree. （读后续写·古镇氛围）
synonyms.usage: folklore 是集合名词，泛指一个民族口耳相传的"传说、习俗、歌谣"总和，不可数；legend 指具体的"某一个传说"，可数

synonyms.example: The singer had become a cultural icon, her image printed on posters in bedrooms across the country. （议论文·流行文化）
synonyms.usage: 指"象征某种精神/时代的标志性人物或符号"，强调象征意义与广泛认同；legend(人物义)更强调"因非凡成就而被传颂"，含时间沉淀感

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·legend 词族与一词多义
advancedExpressions.expression: legend（n.）四义：①传说、传奇故事 ②传奇人物 ③图例、说明文字 ④(硬币/碑上)铭文；→ legendary（adj. 传奇的，著名的）；固定 a living legend=在世的传奇人物
advancedExpressions.example: According to legend, a fox once guarded this village; the veteran coach, a living legend, still checks the tiny legend on the trail map before every hike.（一句串联"传说/传奇人物/图例"三义）

advancedExpressions.expression: according to legend / legend has it that...（据传说）; a living legend（在世传奇人物）; become a legend / pass into legend（成为传奇，被传颂）; the stuff of legend（堪称传奇的素材）; a legend in one's own lifetime（在世即成传奇）
advancedExpressions.example: His comeback in the final ten seconds was truly the stuff of legend, retold by fans for years.（这些短语在读后续写、应用文介绍名人、议论文"何以成传奇"中都极高频）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"传说/传奇"辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: legend / myth / folklore / icon（辨析）
advancedExpressions.example: legend=半真半假、常有现实原型的英雄/历史传说(可数)；myth=神明创世的神圣故事、也指广传的错误观念；folklore=一个民族口耳相传的传说习俗总和(不可数);icon=象征时代精神的标志性人物。

advancedExpressions.expression: according to (an) ancient legend, ...
advancedExpressions.example: According to an ancient legend, a single act of kindness could awaken the sleeping spirit of the mountain — and that night, trembling, the boy decided to test whether the old tale was true. （以传说开篇设置悬念 + 破折号转入人物行动）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., a living legend of ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are deeply honoured to welcome Professor Lin, a living legend of marine biology, whose lifelong devotion to the oceans has inspired a whole generation. （同位语介绍嘉宾身份 + whose 定语从句烘托贡献）

advancedExpressions.expression: what turns an ordinary person into a legend is ...
advancedExpressions.example: What turns an ordinary person into a legend is rarely sheer talent, but an unyielding will to keep rising each time life knocks them down. （主语从句设问 + not...but 结构揭示论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was an old story about the mountain, and the boy believed it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There was an ancient legend clinging to the mountain like the mist around its peak, and the boy, wide-eyed and breathless, believed every trembling word of it. （读后续写·传说氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: legend 替换 old story + clinging to...like the mist 明喻营造氛围 + 形容词插入语(wide-eyed and breathless)刻画人物神态

sentenceUpgrade.original: He worked hard and became famous.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Through years of quiet, stubborn effort — the kind no one applauds until it is over — he rose from an unknown apprentice to a legend whose name would outlive him by centuries. （议论文/叙事·成就传奇）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入语强调"无人喝彩的坚持" + rise from...to 对比句式呈现蜕变 + whose 定语从句延展传奇的永恒性

classPractice.question: To thousands of young athletes, the veteran coach was nothing less than a living ____ (legend / legendary).
classPractice.note: a living legend=在世的传奇人物(名词)；legendary 是形容词，不能跟在 a living 之后作名词中心词

classPractice.question: Li Bai remains a ____ (legend) figure whose verses still light up the night sky of Chinese poetry.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 figure 须用形容词 legendary=传奇的、著名的

classPractice.question: 据传说，西湖是由龙凤从天上落下的一颗珍珠形成的。____________ (据传说), the West Lake was formed from a pearl dropped by a dragon and a phoenix.
classPractice.answer: According to legend / Legend has it that
classPractice.note: according to legend 与 legend has it that... 均为"据传说"固定表达；后者须接完整从句

translation: vt. 遭遇，遇到，意外地遇到；邂逅，遇到 | n. 相遇，邂逅，交锋
original_sentence: During his travels, he visited famous mountains and great rivers, encountering different customs and practices.
readingExamples: During his travels, he visited famous mountains and great rivers, encountering different customs and practices.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to experience something, especially problems or opposition, unexpectedly
(2) vt. to meet someone without having planned to, or to meet an enemy in a fight or contest
(3) n. an occasion when you meet someone, especially unexpectedly
(4) n. a fight or competition between people or groups

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (尤指双方力量悬殊的)交锋，对峙
uncommonMeanings.example: Their first encounter on the court was hardly a contest — the veteran champion toyed with the trembling rookie, though something in the boy's fierce eyes hinted that the next meeting would tell a different story. （读后续写·体育竞技·伏笔）

posExamples.sentence: The moment I stepped off the train into that unfamiliar town, I encountered a warmth I had never expected — a stranger, seeing my confusion, gently took my suitcase and led me toward the address scrawled on my crumpled note. （读后续写·陌生善意）

translation: 滋养，助长；培养，养育

definitionEn:
(1) vt. to give a person, animal, or plant the food and other substances they need to live, grow, and stay healthy
(2) vt. to allow a feeling, idea, or belief to grow stronger over a period of time; to foster and cultivate
(3) vt. to keep a plan or feeling in your mind, especially for a long time

uncommonMeanings.example: For twenty long years, in the cramped attic where rain leaked through the roof, he had quietly nourished a single dream: to see his poems printed and read by strangers who would never know his face. （读后续写·理想坚守·困境中的执念）

posExamples.sentence: Kneeling by the withered seedling each dawn, the little girl nourished it with water carried from the distant well, whispering encouragement as though the tiny plant could hear every word of her stubborn hope. （读后续写·坚持与希望）
I firmly believe that reading widely nourishes the mind just as good food nourishes the body, which is why I am proposing that our school set aside a quiet hour for reading each afternoon. （应用文·建议信）
A society that nourishes curiosity and rewards independent thinking will, in the long run, produce far more innovators than one that merely drills its young into obedience. （议论文·教育与创新）

translation: 许多的，很多的

(1) adj. existing in large numbers; many
(2) adj. consisting of a great number of separate people or things

definitionEn:
(1) n. a period of sudden economic growth, especially one that results in a lot of money being made
(2) n. a loud deep sound, as of an explosion, thunder, or a large drum
(3) vi. to grow or develop rapidly and successfully

posExamples.sentence: The poet came of age during an economic boom, when the streets of the capital hummed with merchants, music, and the restless energy of a confident empire. （读后续写·时代背景）

collocations.translation: 蓬勃发展的经济 / 产业 / 市场

synonyms.example: Under the wise governance of the age, arts and commerce flourished side by side. （议论文·文化繁荣）

translation: 稳定(性)，稳固(性)
original_sentence: Li Bai grew up in the most glorious period of the Tang Dynasty, Exploring poetry 5 10 15 20 53 a time of economic boom and social stability.
readingExamples: Li Bai grew up in the most glorious period of the Tang Dynasty, Exploring poetry 5 10 15 20 53 a time of economic boom and social stability.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a situation in which something is not likely to change or fail suddenly
(2) n. a calm, steady, and dependable quality in someone's character or emotional life
(3) n. the ability of an object to remain firmly fixed, balanced, and not likely to fall over or move

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (情绪/心理的)沉稳，坚定，泰然
uncommonMeanings.example: In the chaos that followed the accident, it was her quiet stability — the steady voice, the unhurried hands — that kept everyone from falling apart. （读后续写·危机时刻·沉稳品格）

posExamples.sentence: Only after the storm had passed did the old sailor return to steady the mast, and slowly, a fragile sense of stability crept back into the trembling hearts of the crew. （读后续写·风暴后的安定）
I am writing to propose several measures that would bring greater stability to our class schedule, so that every student can plan their revision with peace of mind. （应用文·建议信）
History repeatedly demonstrates that lasting economic prosperity is built upon the foundation of social stability, without which even the boldest reforms are doomed to crumble. （议论文·社会发展）
The poet spent his childhood in an age of remarkable stability, when peace and prosperity gave ordinary people the rare luxury of dreaming beyond mere survival. （读后续写·时代背景）

collocations.translation: 社会 / 政治 / 经济稳定（课文语境）
collocations.example: It was a time of economic boom and social stability. 那是一个经济繁荣、社会稳定的时代。（课文原句节选）

collocations.translation: 政局稳定（高考高频搭配）
collocations.example: Political stability laid the foundation for the nation's rapid growth. 政局稳定为国家的快速发展奠定了基础。
The new policies are intended to maintain price stability during the festival season. （应用文·公告）
A steady job gave the young family the financial stability they had longed for. （读后续写·生活）
Returning to her grandmother's cottage always restored in her a deep sense of stability. （读后续写·归属感）
Emotional stability, far more than raw talent, is what carries an athlete through the pressure of a final. （议论文·心理素质）
A regular daily routine can bring much-needed stability to a child's life. （应用文·家教建议）
Sustainable growth depends on long-term stability rather than short-lived booms. （议论文·经济）
Rumours spreading online can quietly undermine the stability of an entire community. （议论文·舆论）

synonyms.example: The steadiness of her gaze told the frightened child that everything would be all right. （读后续写·安抚）
synonyms.usage: 更口语、更具体，常指动作、目光、脾性的平稳沉着；stability 更抽象正式，多用于社会、经济、心理状态

synonyms.example: After weeks of turmoil, she finally regained her inner equilibrium. （读后续写·心境恢复）
synonyms.usage: 强调各方力量或情绪达到的动态平衡状态，书面语；stability 强调不易改变、不会崩塌的稳固性

synonyms.example: A loving home gives children the security they need to explore the world with confidence. （议论文·家庭）
synonyms.usage: 侧重免于危险、匮乏的安全与保障感；stability 侧重稳定、不动摇、不突变

advancedExpressions.expression: stability / steadiness / security / equilibrium / firmness 稳定，稳固，均衡
advancedExpressions.example: Her calm steadiness brought a sense of security to the frightened crowd. 她沉着的稳定感给受惊的人群带来了安全感。

advancedExpressions.expression: a fragile sense of stability crept / settled back into ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Amid the panic, her unshakable stability — a steady voice, a reassuring hand on each trembling shoulder — spread through the crowd like warmth through frozen limbs, and one by one, people began to breathe again. （读后续写·危机领导力）

translation: 宽容的，容忍的；能耐……的
original_sentence: This open and tolerant atmosphere allowed Li Bai the liberty to develop a free and unconstrained personality, which, in turn, had a huge impact on his poetic production.

definitionEn:
(1) adj. willing to accept behaviour, beliefs or opinions that are different from your own, even if you disagree with them
(2) adj. able to accept or deal with something unpleasant or difficult without being harmed
(3) adj. (of a plant, animal or machine) able to survive or work well in difficult conditions

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】能耐……的，能在困难条件下存活/运转的（尤指植物、动物或机器）be tolerant of frost 耐霜冻

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （植物、动物、机器）耐……的，抗……的
uncommonMeanings.example: The hardy little seedlings my grandfather planted proved surprisingly tolerant of drought, thrusting up green shoots even after weeks without a single drop of rain. （读后续写·祖辈与土地·坚韧）

posExamples.sentence: Watching his rival stumble over the very lines he himself had once forgotten, the seasoned actor merely smiled — a tolerant, knowing smile that carried no trace of mockery, only the quiet patience of one who understood how failure feels. （读后续写·人物气度）

translation: 自由
original_sentence: This open and tolerant atmosphere allowed Li Bai the liberty to develop a free and unconstrained personality, which, in turn, had a huge impact on his poetic production.
readingExamples: This open and tolerant atmosphere allowed Li Bai the liberty to develop a free and unconstrained personality, which, in turn, had a huge impact on his poetic production.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the freedom to live, think or act as you want, without being unfairly controlled or restricted
(2) n. the state of being free rather than in prison or under the control of another person
(3) n. a legal right or permission to do something

I am writing to urge that students be granted greater liberty in choosing their own optional courses, since freedom of choice is the surest way to kindle genuine enthusiasm for learning. （应用文·建议信）
History teaches us that the liberty to think, to speak and to dissent is never freely given but hard-won, and must be guarded by each generation as jealously as the last. （议论文·自由的代价）

This open and tolerant atmosphere allowed Li Bai the liberty to develop a free and unconstrained personality, a liberty that flowed straight from his brush into some of the boldest poetry ever written. （读后续写·历史文化）

translation: 不受约束的，自由的

definitionEn:

classPractice.question: 不受传统束缚，这位年轻艺术家创造出全新的风格。____ ____ tradition, the young artist created a brand-new style.
classPractice.note: 过去分词短语作状语前置；unconstrained by sth = 不受……约束

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（unconstrained / unrestrained）：李白的个性是自由不羁的（中性褒义）。Li Bai's ____ personality shone through in his poems.
classPractice.note: unconstrained 中性，侧重不受外在规则限制；unrestrained 多含'情感放纵、毫无节制'色彩

translation: 生命力，活力，热情
original_sentence: Equally impressive is Li Bai’s free expression of strong feelings, which breathes vitality into the lifeless objects he describes, and which distinguishes him from other landscape poets.
readingExamples: Equally impressive is Li Bai’s free expression of strong feelings, which breathes vitality into the lifeless objects he describes, and which distinguishes him from other landscape poets.
definitionEn:
(1) n. energy and enthusiasm; the state of being full of life and spirit
(2) n. the power or ability of something to continue to exist, grow or develop
(3) n. the quality in something that makes it feel alive, vivid or full of energy

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （事物）持久的生命力、存续能力
uncommonMeanings.example: That a language spoken in a remote mountain village has survived a thousand years is proof of a cultural vitality that no empire could ever stamp out. （议论文·文化存续）

posExamples.sentence: Though well past seventy, my grandmother moved through the garden with a vitality that put the rest of us to shame, humming an old tune as she coaxed the last roses into bloom. （读后续写·长辈·活力）
I am confident that the new sports festival will inject fresh vitality into campus life and draw even our shyest classmates out into the sunshine. （应用文·活动倡议）
A nation's true vitality lies not in the height of its buildings but in the boldness of its young people, who dare to dream and dare to fail. （议论文·青年与国家）
Li Bai's free expression of strong feeling breathes vitality into the lifeless objects he describes, so that even a distant mountain or a lonely moon seems to stir and speak. （读后续写·文学赏析）

wordForms.noun: vitality (活力) / vitalization (激活) / revitalization (复兴)
wordForms.adjective: vital (至关重要的；生命的，充满活力的)
wordForms.other: 词根 vit-/viv- = life 生命：vital（生命的→至关重要的）、vitality（活力）、revitalize（重获生机）、survive（幸存）、vivid（生动的）；注意 vital 高频义为'至关重要的'（= essential），一词两义

collocations.phrase: breathe / inject vitality into sth（课文搭配）
collocations.translation: 为……注入活力，使……焕发生机
collocations.example: Li Bai's free expression of feeling breathes vitality into the lifeless objects he describes. 李白对情感的自由抒发，为他笔下无生命的景物注入了活力。（选必一U4课文原句词块）
The moment the freshmen poured in, the sleepy old campus was full of vitality. 新生一涌入，沉睡的老校园便充满了活力。（读后续写·校园开学）
Their performance overflowed with a youthful vitality. 他们的表演洋溢着青春活力。（读后续写·演出）
The old town's cultural vitality was reborn once young artists arrived. 年轻艺术家一到来，老城的文化活力便重生了。（应用文·城市复兴）
After a summer by the sea, the doctor slowly regained her vitality. 在海边度过一夏后，医生慢慢恢复了活力。（读后续写·康复）
A community that stops welcoming newcomers will lose its vitality. 不再欢迎新人的社区终将失去活力。（议论文·社会）
The spring meadow brimmed with vitality. 春天的草地洋溢着勃勃生机。（读后续写·自然·季节）
The bright colours filled the market with a sense of vitality. 明亮的色彩让市集充满活力感。（读后续写·市集）

synonyms.example: Somehow the children still had the energy to race up the hill. 孩子们竟然还有精力冲上山坡。（读后续写·孩童）
synonyms.usage: 最常用词，指做事的体力或精力，可数不可数皆有；vitality 更强调蓬勃、鲜活、充满生命感的整体气质，多不可数

synonyms.example: He tackled the project with such vigour that colleagues could scarcely keep pace. 他干劲十足地投入项目，同事几乎跟不上。（议论文·干劲）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，侧重强健有力、干劲十足，常 with vigour 作状语；vitality 更含'生命力、生气'，可用于人、地方、文化

synonyms.example: The liveliness of her storytelling kept every child spellbound. 她讲述的生动活泼让每个孩子入迷。（读后续写·讲述）
synonyms.usage: 侧重活泼、生动、有趣的外在表现；vitality 更深层，指内在的生命活力，格更高

advancedExpressions.expression: breathe / inject / instil vitality into sth；be full of / brim with vitality
advancedExpressions.example: A single passionate teacher can breathe vitality into a dull subject. 一位充满热情的老师能为枯燥的学科注入活力。（一组'注入/充满活力'高分搭配，应用文议论文皆宜）

advancedExpressions.expression: vit-（生命）+ -al → vital；+ -ity → vitality；re-+vital+-ize → revitalize
advancedExpressions.example: 由 vital（至关重要的/生命的）派生 vitality（活力）、revitalize（使复兴），同根 vivid、survive、revive 都含'生命/活'之义。（词根串记）

advancedExpressions.expression: a fresh vitality surged through ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the first sunlight spilled over the ridge, a fresh vitality surged through the whole village. 当第一缕阳光漫过山脊，一股新的活力涌遍整个村庄。（as时间状语+拟人化的活力涌动，营造清晨生机）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... will inject new vitality into ...
advancedExpressions.example: This reading marathon will inject new vitality into our campus culture. 这场阅读马拉松将为校园文化注入新的活力。（宣传句式，突出活动意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: the vitality of ... depends on ...
advancedExpressions.example: The vitality of any civilization depends less on its wealth than on its willingness to keep learning. 任何文明的活力，与其说取决于财富，不如说取决于持续学习的意愿。（'depends less on...than on...'比较结构）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old man was still very energetic.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Age had bent his back but never dimmed his spirit; at eighty he still radiated a vitality so infectious that the young men beside him seemed, by comparison, half asleep. （读后续写·老者·活力）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'bent...but never dimmed'转折对照 + 'so...that...'结果状语 + 与年轻人对比反衬

sentenceUpgrade.original: New ideas gave the company life again.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A stream of daring new ideas breathed fresh vitality into the ageing company, transforming what had been a fading giant into a nimble pioneer that the whole industry now raced to imitate. （议论文／应用文·企业复兴）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'breathe vitality into'固定搭配 + 现在分词状语(transforming) + 'what had been...into...'对比句式凸显转变

classPractice.question: Li Bai's free expression of strong feelings breathes ____ (vital) into the lifeless objects he describes.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；breathe vitality into sth 为……注入活力，此处 vital 的名词形式作宾语

classPractice.question: 用 vitality 的固定搭配填空：The new sports festival will ____ fresh vitality ____ campus life. 新体育节将为校园生活注入新活力。
classPractice.note: inject / breathe vitality into sth = 为……注入活力，介词固定用 into

classPractice.question: 选词填空（vital / vitality / vitally）：A good night's sleep is ____ to health, and it keeps you full of ____ all day long.
classPractice.note: vital adj.至关重要的（be vital to）；vitality n.活力（be full of vitality）；辨清同族词性

translation: 成为……的特征，使有别于；区分，辨别；认出；使出名
original_sentence: Equally impressive is Li Bai’s free expression of strong feelings, which breathes vitality into the lifeless objects he describes, and which distinguishes him from other landscape poets.
readingExamples: Equally impressive is Li Bai’s free expression of strong feelings, which breathes vitality into the lifeless objects he describes, and which distinguishes him from other landscape poets.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to recognize or understand the difference between two or more things or people
(2) vt. to be a feature that makes one person or thing clearly different from another
(3) vt. to manage to see or hear something with difficulty
(4) vt. (distinguish oneself) to do something so well that people notice and admire you

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使出名，使杰出（distinguish oneself 使自己声名鹊起、脱颖而出）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the final round she distinguished herself with an answer so daring and precise that the judges rose to applaud. 决赛中她凭一个大胆而精准的回答脱颖而出，评委们起立鼓掌。（读后续写·比赛·脱颖而出）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （费力地）看清，辨认出（视觉/听觉勉强分辨）
uncommonMeanings.example: Peering through the rain, he could barely distinguish the outline of the lighthouse. 透过雨幕，他勉强辨认出灯塔的轮廓。（读后续写·风雨归途）

posExamples.sentence: Peering through the thick curtain of rain, he could barely distinguish the outline of the lighthouse, yet that faint grey shape was enough to steer his little boat safely home. （读后续写·风雨归途）
I would like to remind every applicant that what distinguishes a truly memorable essay is not fancy vocabulary but sincere, original thought. （应用文·征稿说明）
The ability to distinguish reliable information from clever falsehood has never been more crucial than in this age when a lie can circle the globe before the truth has laced up its shoes. （议论文·信息素养）
It is Li Bai's fearless expression of emotion that distinguishes him from all other landscape poets, for while they painted the mountains, he made the mountains feel. （读后续写·文学评析）

wordForms.adjective: distinguished (杰出的，卓越的) / distinguishable (可区分的) / distinct (清晰的，截然不同的)
wordForms.other: 易混三兄弟：distinguished 杰出的（a distinguished scientist 杰出科学家）/ distinct 明显的、截然不同的（two distinct types）/ distinctive 独特的（a distinctive style）；反义 indistinguishable 难以区分的

collocations.phrase: 【课件】distinguish A from B = distinguish between A and B
collocations.translation: 【课件】把 A 和 B 区分出来（区分，辨别；两式等值）
collocations.example: This breathes vitality into the lifeless objects he describes and distinguishes him from other landscape poets. 这使他所描写的无生命之物焕发活力，也使他有别于其他山水诗人。（课件原句词块）
At what age are children able to distinguish right from wrong? 孩子到什么年龄才能辨别是非？（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: 【课件】be distinguished from sth by sth（成为……的特征，使有别于）
collocations.example: The male bird is distinguished from the female bird by its colorful tail. 雄鸟凭借其色彩斑斓的尾巴而有别于雌鸟。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】作为……脱颖而出，使自己出名
collocations.example: She has already distinguished herself as an athlete. 作为运动员她已脱颖而出。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: 【课件】distinguish sb's words（看清、认出、听出）
collocations.translation: 【课件】听清/辨认出某人的话（义3：看清；认出；听出）
collocations.example: I could not distinguish her words, but she sounded agitated. 我听不清她说的话，但听得出她很激动。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: distinguish sb / sth from sth（课文原句）
collocations.example: Li Bai's free expression of feeling distinguishes him from other landscape poets. 李白对情感的自由抒发使他有别于其他山水诗人。（选必一U4课文原句词块）
A good historian must distinguish solid evidence from comfortable myth. 优秀的史学家须把确凿证据与舒服的传说区分开。（议论文·历史研究）
Only with time did the young doctor learn to distinguish between real fear and mere impatience. 唯有时日让年轻医生学会区分真正的恐惧与单纯的不耐烦。（读后续写·成长）
He was determined to distinguish himself through work honestly done. 他决心靠踏实的工作使自己出众。（议论文·奋斗）
The ancient town is distinguished by its winding stone lanes. 这座古镇以蜿蜒的石巷为特色。（应用文·景点介绍）
The first duty of education is to help the young distinguish right from wrong. 教育的首要职责是帮助年轻人明辨是非。（议论文·教育目的）
The twins were so alike that even their teacher found them hard to distinguish. 这对双胞胎太像了，连老师都难以分辨。（读后续写·趣事）
Its bright red crest is the bird's most distinguishing feature. 鲜红的冠子是这种鸟最显著的特征。（应用文·科普说明）
In the fading dusk she could at last clearly distinguish a figure waving at the far end of the platform — her father. （读后续写·重逢）

synonyms.example: It takes a trained ear to differentiate the calls of these two birds. 需受过训练的耳朵才能区分这两种鸟的叫声。（议论文·专业辨识）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、偏学术，强调找出或造成差别，常 differentiate between；distinguish 更通用，还可表'认出''使出众'

synonyms.example: They looked so alike that only their mother could tell them apart. 他们太像了，只有母亲能分辨。（读后续写·口语场景）
synonyms.usage: 口语化短语，多用于人或物长得像、难以分辨的情境，常 tell A and B apart；distinguish 更书面、含义更广

synonyms.translation: 看出，辨别出（需努力或洞察）
synonyms.example: Beneath his calm words she discerned a flicker of anxiety. 在他平静的话语下，她察觉出一丝焦虑。（读后续写·察言观色）
synonyms.usage: 强调凭观察或洞察力费力地看出、觉察，较文雅；distinguish 侧重区分不同事物或使有别

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·distinguish A from B = distinguish between A and B（课件核心）
advancedExpressions.expression: distinguish A from B = distinguish between A and B（区分，辨别）；两种介词结构等值，务必记全 from 与 between...and
advancedExpressions.example: This distinguishes him from other landscape poets. = We can distinguish between his style and theirs. 这使他有别于其他山水诗人。／我们能区分他的风格与他们的风格。（课件语法点：把 A 和 B 区分出来）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·distinguished 作形容词（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: distinguished adj. 卓越的，杰出的，著名的；be distinguished for 因……而出名，be distinguished as 作为……而出名（≠ distinguish 的过去分词'被区分的'）
advancedExpressions.example: He was the most distinguished scholar in physics. 他是物理学界最杰出的学者。（课件原句）

advancedExpressions.expression: distinguish A from B / distinguish between A and B / distinguish oneself / be distinguished by
advancedExpressions.example: What distinguishes him from others is not talent but discipline. 使他有别于他人的不是天赋而是自律。（一组'区分/使出众'核心结构，务必记全介词 from、between...and）

advancedExpressions.expression: distinguished adj. 杰出的（≠ distinguish 的过去分词'被区分的'）
advancedExpressions.example: a distinguished professor 一位杰出的教授；He is distinguished in his field. 他在领域内很杰出。（形容词化，重音与用法都与动词区分）

advancedExpressions.expression: through ..., sb. could barely distinguish ...
advancedExpressions.example: Through the swirling snow, he could barely distinguish the warm glow of a window ahead. 透过纷飞的雪，他勉强辨认出前方一扇窗温暖的光。（感官动词+破折号补充，渲染绝境中的希望）

advancedExpressions.expression: what distinguishes ... is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What distinguishes an outstanding volunteer is not the hours logged but the sincerity poured into each one. 优秀志愿者的与众不同不在于时长，而在于每一小时倾注的真诚。（'what...is not...but...'强调句）

advancedExpressions.expression: the capacity to distinguish ... is what makes ...
advancedExpressions.example: The capacity to distinguish genuine knowledge from persuasive noise is what makes an educated mind. 把真知从蛊惑人心的噪音中辨别出来的能力，正是受过教育的头脑之所在。（主语从句+强调）

sentenceUpgrade.original: In the dark he could not see who it was.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the smothering darkness he strained to distinguish the figure ahead, but only when a stray beam of moonlight fell across that weathered face did his heart leap — it was the father he had not seen in ten long years. （读后续写·黑暗·重逢）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'strained to distinguish'刻画努力 + 'only when...did'部分倒装 + 破折号揭示身份，制造情感高潮

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good students can tell true facts from false ones.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age drowning in information, the students who will truly thrive are those who can distinguish solid fact from seductive fiction, weighing every claim before they let it settle as belief. （议论文·信息辨别）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'drowning in'现在分词状语渲染背景 + 定语从句(who can distinguish...) + 现在分词状语(weighing...)延展方法

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 你能区别出这辆车和那辆车吗？Can you _________ _________ this car and that one?
classPractice.note: 课件原题。distinguish between A and B=辨别 A 与 B 的区别；此处 this car and that one 为并列宾语

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 语言把人和动物区别开来。Speeches __________ man ________ animals.
classPractice.note: 课件原题。distinguish A from B=把 A 与 B 区分开；man 与 animals 分列 from 两侧

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 她年轻的时候因头脑冷静、敢做敢为而出众。She ___________ __________ by her coolness and bravery at an early age.
classPractice.note: 课件原题。distinguish oneself=使自己出众、脱颖而出；已用过去时 distinguished + 反身代词 herself

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 我们能看到三个人正在走来，但是看不清他们的脸。We could see three men approaching but could not _________ ________ ________.
classPractice.note: 课件原题。distinguish=（费力地）看清、辨认出；此处宾语为 their faces

classPractice.question: It is his fearless expression of emotion that ____ (distinguish) him from all other landscape poets.
classPractice.note: 课文考点；强调句 It is...that... 强调主语，谓语随被强调主语 expression 用第三人称单数

classPractice.question: 在这个信息时代，我们必须学会区分事实与谣言。In this age, we must learn to ____ fact ____ rumour. (也可用 between...and 结构)
classPractice.answer: distinguish; from / distinguish between fact and rumour
classPractice.note: distinguish A from B = distinguish between A and B，两种介词结构都要会写

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（distinguished / distinct / distinctive）：As a ____ scientist with a ____ style of his own, he made two ____ contributions to the field.
classPractice.note: distinguished 杰出的（修饰人/成就）；distinctive 独特的（style）；distinct 清晰/截然不同的（two distinct）；本词族高频易混点

translation: 夸张，夸大
original_sentence: These features are inseparable from Li Bai’s wide use of exaggeration, metaphor and other artistic techniques.
readingExamples: These features are inseparable from Li Bai’s wide use of exaggeration, metaphor and other artistic techniques.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a statement or description that makes something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is
(2) n. the act of making something seem more than it really is
(3) n. (in art or writing) the deliberate use of overstatement as a technique for effect

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文学、绘画中的）夸张手法
uncommonMeanings.example: Through bold exaggeration — rivers that leap from the sky, mountains that touch the clouds — Li Bai lifts ordinary scenery into the realm of the magnificent. （读后续写·文学赏析·修辞手法）

posExamples.sentence: 'The whole school was watching!' he groaned, burying his face in his hands, though we all knew this was pure exaggeration born of a boy's wounded pride. （读后续写·青春·尴尬）
I must point out, with respect, that the advertisement's claim of 'instant fluency in a week' is a gross exaggeration likely to mislead honest customers. （应用文·投诉信）
It is no exaggeration to say that reading has shaped who I am, for every book I have opened has quietly rewritten some corner of my mind. （议论文·阅读的力量）
These vivid features are inseparable from Li Bai's wide use of exaggeration and metaphor, techniques that turn a simple waterfall into a river flung down from the Milky Way itself. （读后续写·历史文化）

wordForms.noun: exaggeration (夸张) / exaggerator (夸大其词的人)
wordForms.other: 构词：exaggerate（动词）→ exaggerat + -ion → exaggeration（名词）；注意双写 g、双写 er 前的拼写：ex-a-gg-e-r-a-tion；动词 exaggerate 后接名词或 that 从句，如 exaggerate the difficulty / He exaggerated how hard it was.

idioms.idiom: it is no exaggeration to say (that) ...
idioms.translation: 毫不夸张地说……
idioms.example: It is no exaggeration to say that that one encouraging word changed the course of my life. 毫不夸张地说，那一句鼓励改变了我一生的轨迹。（读后续写·师恩·升华）

collocations.phrase: the use of exaggeration（课文原句）
collocations.example: These features are inseparable from Li Bai's wide use of exaggeration and metaphor. 这些特点与李白对夸张、隐喻等手法的广泛运用密不可分。（选必一U4课文原句词块）
Without exaggeration, it was the finest meal I had eaten in my life. 毫不夸张地说，那是我这辈子吃过最好的一餐。（读后续写·美食体验）
To call the minor delay a 'disaster' was a gross exaggeration. 把小小的延误称作'灾难'是严重夸大。（议论文·理性看待）
Grandpa was rather prone to exaggeration, and with every retelling the fish grew longer. 爷爷颇爱夸大其词，每讲一遍那条鱼就更长一些。（读后续写·幽默·长辈）
There was an element of exaggeration in his tale, yet the courage at its heart was real. 他的故事有几分夸张，但其核心的勇气是真实的。（读后续写·故事）
Skilful poets use exaggeration not to deceive but to reveal a deeper truth. 高明的诗人运用夸张不是为骗人，而是为揭示更深的真理。（议论文·文学手法）
'Waves as high as mountains' is poetic exaggeration. '浪高如山'是诗意的夸张。（议论文·修辞）
By exaggeration and vivid imagery, the storyteller held the children spellbound. 借助夸张和生动意象，讲述者让孩子们入迷。（读后续写·讲述）

synonyms.example: To describe the small setback as a catastrophe was a clear overstatement. 把小挫折说成大灾难显然是言过其实。（议论文·理性）
synonyms.usage: 较中性、书面，单指'说得过头'；exaggeration 更常用，还可指文学艺术中的夸张手法

synonyms.example: 'I've told you a thousand times' is a familiar hyperbole. '我告诉过你一千遍'是常见的夸张修辞。（议论文·语言修辞）
synonyms.usage: 专业修辞术语，特指为强调效果而有意夸张的修辞格；exaggeration 含义更宽，日常与文学皆可用

synonyms.example: The sailor's tales grew richer with a little harmless embellishment. 水手的故事因些许无害的添枝加叶而愈发精彩。（读后续写·故事美化）
synonyms.usage: 侧重为使故事更动听而添加细节、加以润色；exaggeration 侧重把事物说得比实际更大更强

advancedExpressions.expression: without exaggeration / it is no exaggeration to say that / a gross exaggeration / use exaggeration
advancedExpressions.example: It is no exaggeration to say that he saved the whole team. 毫不夸张地说，他拯救了整个团队。（一组'夸张'高分词块，续写升华与议论辩证皆可用）

advancedExpressions.expression: 动词 exaggerate + 名词后缀 -ion → exaggeration（注意双写 gg）
advancedExpressions.example: 由动词 exaggerate（夸大）派生名词 exaggeration、形容词 exaggerated；类似 imagine→imagination、admire→admiration。（动词变名词的 -ion 规律）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is no exaggeration to say that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is no exaggeration to say that in that silent moment I understood, for the first time, what it meant to belong. 毫不夸张地说，在那一刻的寂静里，我第一次懂得了归属的含义。（固定强调句式，续写结尾拔高情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: with all due respect, this claim is an exaggeration
advancedExpressions.example: With all due respect, the promise of 'guaranteed success' is a clear exaggeration. 恕我直言，'保证成功'的承诺显然是夸大其词。（投诉／建议信中礼貌而坚定的措辞）

advancedExpressions.expression: though not without exaggeration, ... nevertheless ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though not without exaggeration, the warning nevertheless points to a real danger. 尽管不无夸张，这一警告仍指向一个真实的危险。（让步状语+nevertheless转折，呈现辩证态度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He often said things bigger than they really were.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every story that passed my uncle's lips gathered a fresh layer of exaggeration, until the modest hill he had once climbed became, by the tenth retelling, a snow-capped peak he had conquered against all odds. （读后续写·幽默·夸张成性）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'gathered a fresh layer of'具象化夸张的累积 + 'until...became'结果推进 + 前后对比(modest hill/snow-capped peak)制造幽默

sentenceUpgrade.original: Poets use exaggeration to make things more powerful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being mere falsehood, the exaggeration a great poet employs serves a higher purpose: it strips away the dull surface of the ordinary and lays bare the fierce emotion pulsing beneath. （议论文·文学手法辩护）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'Far from being...'否定前置澄清 + 冒号引出核心论点 + 'strips away...lays bare...'并列动词递进+隐喻(pulsing beneath)

classPractice.question: These features are inseparable from Li Bai's wide use of ____ (exaggerate) and metaphor.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；介词 of 后需名词，动词 exaggerate 变名词 exaggeration（注意 gg 双写）

classPractice.question: 毫不夸张地说，这本书改变了我的一生。It is ____ ____ ____ say that this book changed my whole life.
classPractice.note: 固定句型 It is no exaggeration to say that... 毫不夸张地说，续写/议论高分收尾句

classPractice.question: 选词填空（exaggerate / exaggeration / exaggerated）：Don't ____ the difficulty; his ____ account gave everyone a needless fright.
classPractice.note: 第一空需动词 exaggerate（don't 后动词原形）；第二空需形容词 exaggerated 修饰 account

translation: 隐喻，暗喻
original_sentence: There are a lot of poetic devices employed in poems, such as rhyme and metaphor.
readingExamples: There are a lot of poetic devices employed in poems, such as rhyme and metaphor.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a way of describing something by referring to it as something else that has similar qualities, without using the words 'like' or 'as'
(2) n. something that is used or considered to represent or stand as a symbol of something else
(3) n. (as a literary device) the use of figurative language to make an implicit comparison and evoke vivid imagery

posExamples.sentence: As the old fisherman spread his weather-beaten hands, Grandpa smiled and said the sea was a metaphor for life itself — sometimes calm, sometimes cruel, but always worth setting sail for. （读后续写·祖孙对话·人生哲思）
In my speech, I will use the marathon as a metaphor for our three years of hard study, reminding my classmates that the finish line is merely the beginning of another race. （应用文·演讲稿）

A well-chosen metaphor does more than decorate an argument; it compresses a complex idea into a single vivid image, allowing readers to grasp in an instant what pages of explanation might obscure. （议论文·语言的力量）

wordForms.noun: metaphor (隐喻，暗喻) / simile (明喻，构成对照记忆)
wordForms.adverb: metaphorically (比喻地；metaphorically speaking 打个比方说)
wordForms.other: 构词：meta-（超越、变换）+ -phor（源自希腊 pherein '携带'）→ metaphor '把意义搬移到别处'；对照 simile（源自 similis '相似'）；派生 metaphorical adj.、metaphorically adv.

idioms.translation: 混合隐喻（把互不搭配的意象混用而显得荒谬）
idioms.example: The essay collapsed into a mixed metaphor when he wrote his dreams had 'sailed off and taken root in fertile soil'. 当他写下梦想'扬帆远去并在沃土扎根'时，文章沦为荒谬的混合隐喻。（议论文·写作评点·反面例证）

collocations.phrase: a metaphor for sth（课文核心）
collocations.example: The old fisherman said the sea was a metaphor for life itself. 老渔夫说大海是人生本身的隐喻。（选必一U4主题·隐喻手法）
The poet employed a striking metaphor, likening loneliness to an unlit lamp. 诗人运用了一个惊人的隐喻，把孤独比作一盏不亮的灯。（读后续写·诗意描写）
'A river never runs backward' proved an apt metaphor for his message. '河水永不倒流'成了他那句话贴切的隐喻。（应用文·感谢信·引用格言）
Throughout the novel the author extends the metaphor of the journey. 全书作者不断延展'旅程'这一隐喻。（议论文·文学赏析）
When we call someone the 'backbone' of a team, we speak in a metaphorical sense. 当我们称某人是团队的'脊梁'，用的是比喻义。（议论文·语言现象）
The old teacher spoke in metaphors, hoping the child would decode his kindness. 老教师说话含蓄用隐喻，盼孩子有天读懂其中善意。（读后续写·人物刻画）

collocations.translation: 超越比喻（形容真实到无需比喻）
collocations.example: The exhaustion after the final exam was beyond metaphor — it settled into my very bones. （读后续写·状态描写）

synonyms.example: In the story, the lighthouse stands as a symbol of hope. 故事中灯塔象征希望。（读后续写·意象象征）
synonyms.usage: symbol 以具体事物长期代表抽象概念，是固定象征关系；metaphor 强调把甲直接说成乙的比喻手法，是语言修辞

synonyms.example: The professor drew an analogy between the brain and a vast library. 教授把大脑类比作一座巨大的图书馆。（议论文·说理类比）
synonyms.usage: analogy 通过两事物的相似点进行说理/说明，重在推理论证；metaphor 是文学修辞，重在形象化表达

synonyms.example: The poem's imagery of falling leaves and greying light lingered long after I closed the book. （读后续写·氛围营造）
synonyms.usage: imagery 指作品中整体的形象/画面感，是集合概念；metaphor 是构成 imagery 的一种具体手法

advancedExpressions.expression: metaphor 暗喻（A is B，不用 like/as）↔ simile 明喻（A is like B / as ... as）
advancedExpressions.example: Simile: Life is like a journey. Metaphor: Life is a journey. 明喻'人生像旅程'，暗喻'人生是旅程'。（诗歌赏析必考的两种修辞对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth. became a metaphor for ... , ...ing ...
advancedExpressions.example: The single candle became a metaphor for my mother's love, flickering against the darkness yet refusing to go out. 那支孤烛成了母爱的隐喻，在黑暗中摇曳却固执地不肯熄灭。（用具体意象象征抽象情感，结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: if I may borrow a metaphor, ... is like ...
advancedExpressions.example: If I may borrow a metaphor, our friendship is like an old oak — the more storms it weathers, the deeper its roots grow. 打个比方，我们的友谊像一棵老橡树——历经的风暴越多，根扎得越深。（借比喻收束演讲）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being mere decoration, metaphor ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being mere decoration, metaphor is the very engine of human thought. 隐喻远非单纯的装饰，它正是人类思维的引擎。（提出并强化核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her smile made me feel warm.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her smile was a metaphor for the sun itself — it broke through the grey morning of my anxiety and, in a single instant, thawed a coldness I had carried for weeks. （读后续写·心理+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: sth. was a metaphor for...直接比喻 + 破折号补充意象 + thaw a coldness 抽象具体化 + 时间对比(a single instant / for weeks)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Metaphors are useful in writing.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely because a well-forged metaphor can turn the invisible into the vivid that skilled writers treat it not as ornament but as the sharpest tool in their craft. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is precisely because...that 强调句强化因果 + turn the invisible into the vivid 对照结构 + not as...but as 对比递进

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（metaphor / simile）：'The moon is a silver plate' is a ____, while 'The moon is like a silver plate' is a ____.
classPractice.note: 本单元核心：不带 like/as 直接说'是'的是暗喻 metaphor；带 like/as 的是明喻 simile

classPractice.question: 在诗中，落叶成了时光流逝的隐喻。In the poem, the falling leaves became a ____ ____ the passing of time.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 a metaphor for sth ……的隐喻/象征，介词用 for

classPractice.question: When we call someone the 'backbone' of a team, we are speaking ____ (metaphor), not describing anatomy.
classPractice.note: 此处需副词修饰 speaking，metaphor 的副词形式 metaphorically 比喻地

translation: 典型的，
original_sentence: The poem below, written in his fifties, is representative of his romantic style: My silver hair is three thousand feet long, Because my sorrow is deep and strong.
readingExamples: The poem below, written in his fifties, is representative of his romantic style: My silver hair is three thousand feet long, Because my sorrow is deep and strong.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. typical of a particular group or kind; serving as a good example of something
(2) adj. containing or including examples of all the different types within a larger group
(3) n. a person who has been chosen to act, speak, or make decisions on behalf of another person or group
(4) n. a person whose job is to sell a company's products or services, especially by travelling to different places

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 代表（人）；代表委员；（美）众议院议员
uncommonMeanings.example: As the class representative, I am writing on behalf of all forty students to express our thanks. 作为班级代表，我谨代表全班四十名同学致谢。（应用文·感谢信）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 销售代表，业务员（sales representative）
uncommonMeanings.example: A sales representative from the publisher offered our reading club a generous discount. 出版社的一位销售代表给我们阅读社提供了大幅折扣。（应用文）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有代表性的，典型的；（样本）能反映整体的
uncommonMeanings.example: For a survey to be trustworthy, its sample must be genuinely representative of the whole population. 调查要可信，样本须真正能代表整个总体。（议论文·调查方法）

posExamples.sentence: The dusty little teahouse, with its wooden benches and steaming kettles, was representative of a way of life that the roaring new city had all but forgotten. （读后续写·环境·怀旧氛围）
I have enclosed three essays that are representative of my writing over the past year, so that you may fairly judge whether I deserve a place in your summer programme. （应用文·申请信）
As the class representative, I am writing to convey, on behalf of all forty students, our heartfelt gratitude for the unforgettable field trip you organised. （应用文·感谢信）
For a survey to be trustworthy, its sample must be genuinely representative of the whole population; otherwise, sweeping conclusions rest on a foundation of sand. （议论文·调查方法·论证）

wordForms.noun: representation (代表；表现，描绘) / representative (代表人)
wordForms.verb: represent (vt. 代表；表现，描绘；象征)
wordForms.other: 构词：re-（一再、回）+ present（呈现）→ represent 再度呈现→代表/表现；+ -ative → representative（形/名同形）；+ -ation → representation；反义/派生 misrepresent v. 歪曲、误传；注意 representative 一词身兼形容词（典型的）和名词（代表），做题先辨词性

collocations.phrase: be representative of sth（课文原句）
collocations.example: The poem, written in his fifties, is representative of his romantic style. 这首写于他五十多岁时的诗，是其浪漫主义风格的代表。（选必一U4课文原句词块）
Elected as the student representative, I felt the weight of every classmate's trust. 当选学生代表，我感到每位同学信任的分量。（读后续写·心理描写）
The researchers drew a representative sample of two hundred students. 研究者抽取了两百名学生的代表性样本。（议论文·调查报告）
A courteous sales representative came to explain the discount. 一位彬彬有礼的销售代表前来说明折扣。（应用文·活动通知）

collocations.phrase: on behalf of / as a representative of
collocations.example: As a representative of our volunteer team, I would like to share our story. 作为志愿队的代表，我想分享我们的故事。（应用文·演讲稿）
Each dormitory was asked to elect a representative. 每间宿舍被要求选出一名代表。（应用文·通知）
The committee was broadly representative, drawing members from every grade. 委员会广泛具有代表性，成员来自各个年级。（应用文·组织说明）

collocations.translation: 典型而有代表性的例子
collocations.example: Her rise from a shy village girl to a national champion is a typical and representative case of what perseverance can achieve. （议论文·励志论证）

synonyms.example: It was a typical autumn afternoon — golden light and drifting leaves. 那是个典型的秋日午后——金光与飘叶。（读后续写·环境描写）
synonyms.usage: typical 泛指某类事物的常见特征，日常口语常用，be typical of；representative 更正式，强调可作为整体的合格样本/代表，be representative of

synonyms.example: As a delegate to the youth conference, she prepared her speech carefully. 作为青年大会的代表，她认真准备发言。（读后续写·人物）
synonyms.usage: delegate 特指被派往会议/组织行使职权的代表，正式且带授权色彩；representative 用法更宽，可指代表、样本或销售人员

synonyms.example: The spokesperson stepped forward and addressed the anxious crowd. 发言人上前，向焦急的人群讲话。（读后续写·公众场景）
synonyms.usage: spokesperson 专指代表组织公开发言的人；representative 侧重代表身份本身，不一定负责发言

advancedExpressions.type: 多义·adj.典型的 vs n.代表
advancedExpressions.expression: be representative of sth（典型/代表某物）↔ a representative of sth（某物的代表人）
advancedExpressions.example: adj.: This poem is representative of his style. 这首诗代表其风格。 n.: I am a representative of the class. 我是班级代表。（同一词，形容词看'be ...of'，名词看'a ...of'）

advancedExpressions.expression: be representative of / a representative sample / on behalf of, as a representative of
advancedExpressions.example: His calm reply was representative of years of training. 他镇定的回答体现了多年的训练。（一组'代表/典型'高分搭配，应用文议论文皆宜）

advancedExpressions.expression: standing there as a representative of ..., sb. felt ...
advancedExpressions.example: Standing there as a representative of every child once told to give up, she felt the medal grow heavy with meaning. 作为每个曾被劝放弃的孩子的代表站在那里，她觉得奖牌因意义而沉重。（赋予人物象征意义，升华主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: on behalf of ..., as your representative, I ...
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of the graduating class, and as your representative, I extend our deepest thanks. 我谨代表毕业班，作为你们的代表，致以最深的谢意。（代表致谢，庄重得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: a representative example of this is ...
advancedExpressions.example: A representative example of this quiet heroism is the country doctor who walked mountain paths for thirty years. 这种默默英雄气概的典型例子是那位三十年翻山越岭的乡村医生。（举典型例证支撑论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was chosen to be the representative.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the vote was announced and her name rang out across the classroom, she realised that being chosen as the representative was not a reward but a promise — one she intended to keep. （读后续写·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: when 时间状语铺垫场景 + 感官动词 rang out + not a reward but a promise 否定对比 + 破折号补充升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: This example is typical of the problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This case is not an isolated mishap but a representative symptom of a far deeper problem that our education system can no longer afford to ignore. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not...but 否定对比强化 + representative symptom 术语化表达 + can no longer afford to ignore 呼吁式收束

classPractice.question: The poem, written in his fifties, is ____ (represent) of his romantic style.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；be representative of sth 是……的典型，represent 变形容词 representative

classPractice.question: 作为全班的代表，我谨代表四十名同学表达谢意。As a ____ ____ the class, I express our thanks on behalf of forty students.
classPractice.note: 此处 representative 作名词'代表'，a representative of the class；辨清与形容词用法的区别

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（representative / typical）：For a survey to be reliable, the sample must be ____ of the whole group, not just a ____ classroom.
classPractice.note: 调查样本能'代表整体'用 representative（更正式、术语化）；泛指'典型的一间教室'用 typical

translation: n. 霜，霜冻；严寒天气
original_sentence: 1 What is Robert Frost’s writing style like?
readingExamples: 1 What is Robert Frost’s writing style like?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a thin white layer of ice that forms on surfaces, especially outdoors, when the temperature is very cold
(2) n. an occasion when the temperature falls below freezing point; very cold weather with such conditions
(3) v. to cover, or become covered, with frost or a frost-like layer
(4) v. (chiefly American English) to cover a cake with a sweet coating of sugar and butter (= icing)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 严寒天气，霜冻天（an occasion of freezing temperature）
uncommonMeanings.example: A single late frost can destroy months of patient labour. 一场晚来的严寒霜冻就能毁掉几个月的辛勤劳作。（议论文·人与自然）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冷淡，冷若冰霜的态度（比喻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: A frost had settled over the dinner table ever since the quarrel. 争吵之后，饭桌上便笼罩着一层冷冰冰的气氛。（读后续写·家庭矛盾·冷战氛围）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 给（蛋糕）浇糖霜、裹糖衣（美式，= ice）
uncommonMeanings.example: She frosted the birthday cake with trembling care. 她小心翼翼、双手微颤地给生日蛋糕浇上糖霜。（读后续写·亲情·细节描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （使）结霜，（使）蒙上白霜（frost over 结满霜）
uncommonMeanings.example: By dawn the windowpanes had frosted over. 黎明时分，窗玻璃已结满了霜。（读后续写·环境·拟人）

posExamples.sentence: The first frost of the year had silvered every blade of grass, and the boy's breath hung in the still air like small, fleeting ghosts as he trudged to the bus stop. （读后续写·冬日清晨·画面感）
We regret to inform members that, due to a severe frost expected overnight, the outdoor astronomy session has been postponed until next Saturday. （应用文·通知）
By dawn the windowpanes had frosted over, and delicate patterns of ferns and feathers spread across the glass as though winter itself had turned artist. （读后续写·环境·拟人）
Farmers know only too well that a single late frost can destroy months of patient labour, a reminder that human effort is forever at the mercy of nature. （议论文·人与自然）

wordForms.adjective: frosty (结霜的；冷淡的) / frostbitten (冻伤的)
wordForms.other: 文化点：Jack Frost 是英语里拟人化的'霜神/冬爷爷'，传说他在窗上画出霜花；诗人 Robert Frost（罗伯特·弗罗斯特）姓氏正是 frost；派生 frostbite n. 冻伤、defrost v. 除霜/解冻

collocations.example: A hard frost had gripped the valley overnight. 一夜严霜笼罩了山谷。（读后续写·环境）
The first frost sent the villagers scrambling to gather the last pumpkins. 初霜一至，村民急忙抢收最后的南瓜。（读后续写·乡村生活）
Frost had settled on the abandoned bicycle. 霜已凝结在那辆废弃的自行车上。（读后续写·物象描写）
The playing field was white with frost when we arrived. 我们到时，操场已白霜遍布。（读后续写·场景）
On that frosty morning, the old man's greeting warmed me. 那个霜冻的清晨，老人的问候温暖了我。（读后续写·温情对比）
My apology was met with a frosty silence. 我的道歉换来冷冰冰的沉默。（读后续写·人物关系）
The unexpected frost had killed the young seedlings. 意外的霜冻冻死了幼苗。（读后续写·挫折）

synonyms.example: A sheet of ice had formed across the lake. 湖面结了一层冰。（读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: ice 指成块或成层的冻结的水；frost 特指低温时在物体表面凝结的白色薄冰晶，二者厚度与形态不同

synonyms.example: A sudden chill ran through the empty corridor. 一阵寒意穿过空荡的走廊。（读后续写·悬疑氛围）
synonyms.usage: chill 强调侵入身体的寒冷感觉，也可比喻恐惧/冷漠；frost 是具体的霜，或比喻明显外露的冷淡态度

synonyms.example: There was a coldness in her voice that no smile could disguise. 她声音里有种笑容也掩不住的冷漠。（读后续写·人物心理）
synonyms.usage: coldness 是抽象名词，泛指低温或情感上的冷漠；frost 作比喻时更形象、更有画面感，多形容气氛

advancedExpressions.expression: a hard/heavy frost / the first frost / be white with frost / a frosty silence
advancedExpressions.example: A hard frost had silvered every blade of grass. 一场严霜给每片草叶都镀上了银。（一组'霜'的写景搭配 + 比喻义 frosty silence，续写写景写人两用）

advancedExpressions.expression: frost → frosty (adj.) → frostily (adv.)；frost + bite → frostbite (冻伤)；de- + frost → defrost (除霜)
advancedExpressions.example: 由 frost 派生 frosty（结霜的/冷淡的）、frostbite（冻伤）、defrost（解冻），并联想拟人形象 Jack Frost 与诗人 Robert Frost。（一词带出词族与文化）

advancedExpressions.expression: frost had ...ed everything, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Frost had silvered the whole garden, and in that hushed white world even my heartbeat seemed to grow quiet. 霜给整座花园镀了银，在那寂静洁白的世界里，连我的心跳都仿佛静了下来。（以景写心，营造静谧氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: in view of the expected frost, please ...
advancedExpressions.example: In view of the expected frost, please dress warmly for tomorrow's early hike. 鉴于预计有霜冻，请为明早的徒步穿暖。（应用文·温馨提示）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a single frost can ..., so too ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a single frost can undo a season of growth, so too can one thoughtless act erode years of trust. 正如一场霜冻能毁掉一季生长，一个欠考虑的举动也能侵蚀多年的信任。（由自然现象类比说理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was very cold and there was frost everywhere.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The cold had crept in overnight, and by dawn a delicate frost lay over everything — fence, field and forgotten spade — as if the world had been dipped in silver while it slept. （读后续写·环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人 crept in + 三名词并列(fence, field, spade)增强画面 + 破折号补充 + as if 明喻(dipped in silver)

sentenceUpgrade.original: A frost can ruin the crops.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That a single unforeseen frost can lay waste to an entire harvest reminds us, with humbling clarity, how fragile the fruits of human labour remain before the indifferent power of nature. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That 引导主语从句 + lay waste to 高级动词短语 + with humbling clarity 插入语升格 + before the indifferent power of nature 拟人化收束

classPractice.question: 选词填空（frost / frosty / frostbite）：A hard ____ had covered the field overnight, and after an hour on that ____ morning my fingers ached with the first sting of ____.
classPractice.note: 名词 frost（霜）/形容词 frosty（霜冻的，修饰 morning）/名词 frostbite（冻伤）；本词族一网打尽

classPractice.question: By dawn the windowpanes had ____ (frost) over, tracing delicate ferns across the glass.
classPractice.note: frost 作动词'结霜'，frost over 结满霜；此处 had + 过去分词，构成过去完成时

classPractice.question: 自那场争吵后，饭桌上便笼罩着一层冷冰冰的气氛（比喻）。Ever since the quarrel, a ____ had settled over the dinner table.
classPractice.note: frost 的比喻义'冷淡、冷若冰霜的气氛'；a frost settled over... 一层冷淡气氛笼罩

translation: vt. (cast, cast) 投射；向……投以(视线、笑容等)；投，抛；选派角色 | n. 全体演员；投，抛
original_sentence: How can the autumn frost white Be cast into the mirror bright?
readingExamples: How can the autumn frost white Be cast into the mirror bright?
definitionEn:
(1) v. to throw something, especially with force, in a particular direction
(2) v. to direct or send something such as a look, a smile, a shadow, or light towards someone or something
(3) v. to choose an actor to play a particular part in a film or play; to allocate roles
(4) n. all the actors in a film, play, or show
(5) v. to shape metal or another material by pouring it hot and liquid into a mould

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 浇铸，铸造（金属等，cast-cast-cast 不规则动词）
uncommonMeanings.example: The great bell had been cast from bronze centuries ago and still rang clear. 那口大钟数百年前用青铜铸成，至今声音清越。（读后续写·历史·工艺）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 全体演员，演员阵容（the cast of a play/film）
uncommonMeanings.example: On behalf of the drama club, I invite you to see our talented cast perform. 我谨代表戏剧社，邀您来观赏我们才华横溢的全体演员演出。（应用文·邀请信）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 投（票）；提出（意见、疑问）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the moment came to cast his vote, the boy hesitated. 到了投票那一刻，男孩犹豫了。（读后续写·抉择时刻·心理描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （打了石膏的）固定绷带，石膏模
uncommonMeanings.example: With his arm in a plaster cast, the young violinist could only listen. 手臂打着石膏，年轻的小提琴手只能旁听。（读后续写·挫折·渴望）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使脱落；蜕（皮）；使摆脱
uncommonMeanings.example: The snake cast its old skin among the rocks and slithered away renewed. 蛇在岩石间蜕去旧皮，焕然一新地游走了。（读后续写·象征·蜕变主题）

posExamples.sentence: The setting sun cast long shadows across the empty schoolyard, and for a moment the swing still swayed, as if some invisible child had only just let go. （读后续写·环境·怅惘氛围）
As the fisherman cast his net one final time into the darkening sea, he whispered a quiet prayer that today, of all days, the water would not send him home empty-handed. （读后续写·人物·希望与坚持）
On behalf of the drama club, I warmly invite you to our year-end performance, where the entire cast has rehearsed for months to bring this classic tale to life. （应用文·邀请信）
We should be cautious not to cast doubt on others' motives without evidence, for a hasty accusation, once made, can seldom be fully withdrawn. （议论文·观点论证）

wordForms.adjective: cast (铸造的，如 cast iron 铸铁)
wordForms.other: 不规则动词三态同形：cast - cast - cast（对照 read-read-read、cost-cost-cost、put-put-put、cut-cut-cut）；派生/合成 outcast n.被抛弃者、broadcast v.广播、forecast v.预报、overcast adj.阴天的、cast-iron adj.铸铁的/坚不可摧的

idioms.translation: 阐明，使清楚
idioms.example: The old letters cast unexpected light on a family secret buried for half a century. 那些旧信意外地揭示了一个埋藏半个世纪的家族秘密。（读后续写·揭示真相）

idioms.translation: 给……蒙上阴影
idioms.example: The news of his illness cast a shadow over our happiest summer. 他患病的消息给我们最快乐的夏天蒙上阴影。（读后续写·情感转折）

idioms.translation: 使人对……产生怀疑
idioms.example: A single rumour was enough to cast doubt on years of hard-won trust. 一条谣言就足以使人怀疑多年积累的信任。（议论文·论证）

idioms.translation: 回想，追忆
idioms.example: Casting his mind back to that rainy platform, the old man still heard the whistle. 老人回想起那个多雨的站台，仿佛仍听见汽笛声。（读后续写·回忆）

collocations.phrase: cast a smile / a welcoming smile in one's direction
collocations.example: She cast a welcoming smile in his direction. 她向他投去一个欢迎的微笑。

collocations.phrase: cast one's eyes down / cast one's eyes over sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】垂下目光 / 快速看一眼、浏览
collocations.example: I cast my eyes down briefly. Could you just cast your eyes over this report? 我短暂地垂下了目光。你能把这份报告扫一眼吗？

collocations.phrase: cast a shadow / an orange glow over sth
collocations.example: The setting sun cast an orange glow over the mountains. The sad news cast a shadow over the proceedings. 落日给群山投上一层橙色的光晕。这个坏消息给整个活动蒙上了阴影。
Discoveries in atomic science cast (a) new light on old questions. 原子科学的发现给一些老问题带来了新的认识。
This latest evidence casts serious doubt on his version of events. 这一最新证据使人严重怀疑他对事件的说法。

collocations.phrase: cast wood / sth on the fire（cast=throw 扔，抛）
collocations.example: Sparks leapt as he cast more wood on the fire. 他把更多的木头扔进火里，火星四溅。

collocations.phrase: cast sb in the (male) lead / in a role
collocations.translation: 【课件】选派某人扮演（主角、某角色）
collocations.example: The director eventually cast Dirk in the male lead. 导演最终选了德克出演男主角。
The show is very amusing and the whole cast perform brilliantly. 这场演出很有趣，全体演员表演得非常出色。
The fisherman got nothing in his first cast. 渔夫第一次撒网/抛线一无所获。

collocations.phrase: be cast into sth（课文原句）
collocations.example: How can the autumn frost white Be cast into the mirror bright? 秋霜般的白发怎会映入明镜之中？（选必一U4李白诗译·课文原句词块）
The setting sun cast long shadows across the empty schoolyard. 落日在空荡的校园投下长长的影子。（读后续写·环境·怅惘氛围）
A single unverified rumour was enough to cast doubt on his reputation. 一条未经证实的谣言就足以使人怀疑他的声誉。（议论文·论证）

collocations.phrase: be cast as / cast sb as
collocations.translation: 被选/选某人扮演（某角色）
collocations.example: To everyone's surprise, the shy new student was cast as the lead. 出人意料，那位腼腆的新生被选为主角。（读后续写·成长·意外）

collocations.phrase: cast a glance / look / smile at sb
collocations.translation: 向某人投以一瞥/目光/微笑
collocations.example: She cast a nervous glance at the clock before the interview. 面试前她紧张地瞥了一眼时钟。（读后续写·心理描写）
Every citizen who casts a vote adds a thread to a shared future. 每一位投票的公民都为共同的未来添上一线。（议论文·公民责任）
Patiently he cast his line again and again into the darkening sea. 他一次次耐心地把钓线抛入渐暗的海里。（读后续写·祖孙）
The moment she cast aside her fear, the words flowed onto the page. 她一抛开恐惧，文字便涌上纸面。（读后续写·突破自我）
The entire cast had rehearsed for months to bring the tale to life. 全体演员排练了数月，只为让这个故事鲜活起来。（应用文·邀请信）
Her cast-iron determination carried her through the hardest months. 她钢铁般的决心带她熬过最艰难的岁月。（议论文·意志力）

synonyms.example: He threw the stone across the still pond, watching the ripples widen. 他把石子投过平静的池塘，望着涟漪扩散。（读后续写·动作描写）
synonyms.usage: throw 是最普通的'投掷'，对象具体；cast 更书面、更文学，常用于抽象搭配（cast a glance/doubt/shadow）或撒网、铸造等特定场合

synonyms.example: In a fit of fury he hurled the letter into the fire. 一怒之下他把信猛地掷进火里。（读后续写·情绪爆发）
synonyms.usage: hurl 强调用力、猛烈地投掷，带情绪色彩；cast 力度不定，且多用于视线、笑容等无形之物

synonyms.example: She flung open the curtains, letting the morning flood the room. 她一把拉开窗帘，让晨光涌满房间。（读后续写·转变）
synonyms.usage: fling 强调迅速、随意或带情绪地一甩；cast 更正式、克制，且能搭配抽象宾语

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·cast 高频搭配（一词多义）
advancedExpressions.expression: cast a shadow over（蒙阴影）/ cast doubt on（使怀疑）/ be cast as（被选演）/ cast light on（阐明）/ cast aside（抛弃）
advancedExpressions.example: The scandal cast a shadow over the club and cast doubt on its future. 丑闻给俱乐部蒙上阴影，也使人怀疑其前景。（一组 cast 高分搭配，务必连义项一起背）
