advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·cast 三态同形+合成词
advancedExpressions.expression: cast-cast-cast（不规则动词）；broadcast / forecast / outcast / overcast / cast-iron
advancedExpressions.example: cast 三态同形，如 The bell was cast in 1800（被动仍用 cast）；合成 broadcast 广播、forecast 预报、outcast 弃儿、overcast 阴天的。（不规则动词+构词一起记）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... light cast ... over ..., and ...
advancedExpressions.example: The dying firelight cast trembling shadows over her face, and in that glow I glimpsed how tired my mother truly was. 将熄的炉火在她脸上投下颤动的阴影，在那微光里我瞥见母亲有多疲惫。（以光影烘托情感发现）

advancedExpressions.expression: our entire cast has cast every effort into ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our entire cast has cast every ounce of effort into this production. 我们全体演员为这场演出倾注了全部心血。（诚挚邀请，双关点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: we must be careful not to cast doubt / blame without ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must be careful not to cast blame without first weighing the evidence, for justice hurried is justice betrayed. 我们切不可未权衡证据就妄加指责，因为仓促的公正即是被背叛的公正。（提醒理性，警句收束）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The sun made shadows on the ground.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the sun sank behind the hills, it cast long, wavering shadows across the courtyard, stretching them like fingers reaching after a day that would never come again. （读后续写·环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: cast 替换 make 提升文采 + long/wavering 双形容词 + like fingers reaching 明喻 + 隐喻收束(a day that would never come again)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not doubt others without proof.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before we cast the slightest doubt upon another's integrity, we would do well to remember that suspicion, once voiced, leaves a stain that no later apology can wholly wash away. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: cast doubt upon 高级搭配 + Before...we would do well to remember 委婉劝诫结构 + suspicion 拟人 + 比喻(stain...wash away)

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 他很不耐烦地看了哥哥一眼，然后冲出了房间。
classPractice.answer: He cast an impatient look / glance at his brother and rushed out of the room.
classPractice.note: 【课件】cast a look / glance at sb 向某人投以一瞥；cast 三态同形，此处一般过去时仍为 cast。

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 她被选中扮演主角 Annie 公主。
classPractice.answer: She was cast in the lead role of Princess Annie.
classPractice.note: 【课件】be cast in the lead role 被选派出演主角；cast 表'选派角色'义，被动仍用 cast。

classPractice.question: The great bronze bell was ____ (cast) hundreds of years ago and still rings clear today.
classPractice.note: cast 是不规则动词，三态同形 cast-cast-cast；被动语态 was cast 仍用 cast，不加 -ed，此为高频陷阱

classPractice.question: 用 cast 的搭配填空：Without any proof, you should not ____ ____ ____ his honesty. 没有证据你不该使人怀疑他的诚实。
classPractice.note: cast doubt on sth = 使人对……产生怀疑；固定搭配介词用 on

classPractice.question: 选义填空：请为下列 cast 选择义项（A投射 B选派角色 C全体演员 D铸造）。(1) The tree cast a long shadow. ____ (2) She was cast as the heroine. ____ (3) The whole cast bowed. ____
classPractice.note: cast 一词多义：cast a shadow 投射(A)、be cast as 被选演(B)、the cast 全体演员(C)；结合语境判断义项

translation: vt. 欠(情)；欠(债)
original_sentence: Generations of poets, both in China and abroad, owe a debt to his inspirational poems.
readingExamples: Generations of poets, both in China and abroad, owe a debt to his inspirational poems.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to have to pay someone money that you have borrowed or that you have not yet paid for something
(2) v. to feel that you should do something for someone or give them something, because they have helped you or done something for you
(3) v. (owe sth to sb/sth) to have or achieve something because of the help or influence of someone or something
(4) v. to have a particular feeling or attitude, such as loyalty, respect, or gratitude, towards someone

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】人情，情义，恩情（debt 除'借款、债务'外的义项：因受人恩惠而应感激之情）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was so good to me that I can never repay the debt I owe him. 他对我太好了，我永远报答不了欠他的这份恩情。（debt 表'恩情'，与 owe sb a debt of gratitude 连用）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把……归功于；归因于（owe sth to sb/sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Whatever little success I have achieved, I owe entirely to the patient teacher who once refused to let a stubborn boy give up on himself. （读后续写·感恩·归功）

posExamples.sentence: Kneeling beside his hospital bed, she finally confessed that she owed him not only her career but her very life, for it was he who had pulled her from the icy river years ago. （读后续写·感恩·情感高潮）
I am writing to say that we owe you an immense debt of gratitude, for without your generous donation our library could never have opened its doors to the children of this village. （应用文·感谢信）
We owe it to future generations to protect the environment today, for the earth we so carelessly borrow is not ours to spend but ours to safeguard. （议论文·环保·责任论证）
He never forgot that he owed his first chance to a stranger's kindness, and so he made it his life's mission to pass that kindness on. （读后续写·善的传递）

wordForms.other: owing to (prep. 由于，因为，= because of／due to)｜易混辨析：owe 是动词(欠)，owing 只出现在介词短语 owing to 中，勿写成 *oweing；owe 与 own(拥有)、owl(猫头鹰) 拼写形近勿混｜句法特例：owe 常带双宾语 owe sb sth，或改写为 owe sth to sb，两者可互换但介词一律用 to

idioms.idiom: owe sb a debt of gratitude
idioms.translation: 欠某人一份感激之情
idioms.example: We owe our coach a debt of gratitude that no trophy, however golden, could ever fully repay. （读后续写·感恩）

idioms.translation: 该向某人道歉/解释
idioms.example: Realising how his silence had wounded her, he knew at once that he owed her not just an apology but a full and honest explanation. （读后续写·和解）

idioms.idiom: owe it to sb to do sth
idioms.translation: 有义务为某人做某事
idioms.example: You owe it to yourself to try, she whispered, and those six words gave me the courage I had been searching for all along. （读后续写·鼓励）

idioms.translation: 由于，因为（介词短语）
idioms.example: Owing to the sudden storm, the outdoor ceremony had to be moved indoors at the very last minute. （应用文·通知）

collocations.phrase: owe a debt to sb / sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】亏欠……；受……的恩泽（课文：owe a debt to his inspirational poems 感激他富有启发的诗歌）
collocations.example: Generations of poets, both in China and abroad, owe a debt to his inspirational poems. 中外历代诗人都受益于他富有启发的诗篇。

collocations.phrase: owe sb sth = owe sth to sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】欠某人某物；把……归功于/归因于某人
collocations.example: The island's present economy owes a good deal to whisky sales. 这个岛现在的经济在很大程度上得益于威士忌的销售。

collocations.phrase: owe sb a debt of gratitude
collocations.example: I owe a debt of gratitude to my teachers. 我欠老师们一份恩情。

collocations.translation: 【课件】欠某人一笔债；欠某人恩情
collocations.example: He was so good to me that I can never repay the debt I owe him. 他对我太好了，我永远无法报答欠他的这份恩情。

collocations.phrase: I owe you one / a favour
collocations.example: Thanks for covering my shift — I owe you one. 谢谢你替我值班——我欠你一个人情。
He was out of work owing to a physical injury. 由于身体受伤，他失业了。

collocations.phrase: owe a debt to sb / sth（课文原句）
collocations.translation: 亏欠……；受益于、蒙受……的恩泽
collocations.example: Generations of poets, both in China and abroad, owe a debt to his inspirational poems. （课文原句·历代诗人受益于李白诗篇）
You still owe me ten yuan and, more importantly, an honest explanation. （双宾语结构·先物后情）

collocations.phrase: owe sth to sb / sth（把……归功于）
collocations.translation: 把某物归功于／归因于某人某物
collocations.example: She owes her success to years of quiet, unglamorous effort. （owe A to B·归功句式，B 由 to 引出）

collocations.phrase: owe it to sb to do sth
collocations.translation: 有义务／应当为某人做某事（it 为形式宾语）
collocations.example: We owe it to future generations to protect this fragile planet. （it 形式宾语真宾语是 to do·道义责任）

collocations.translation: 由于，因为（介词短语，= because of，可放句首作状语）
collocations.example: Owing to the heavy fog, the flight was delayed for three hours. （owing to = due to／because of，注意不与 owe 的时态混）

collocations.phrase: owe sb sth / owe sth to sb
collocations.translation: 欠某人某物；把某物归功于某人
collocations.example: I owe my parents everything — every book I read, every dream I dared to chase, began with a sacrifice they never once mentioned. （读后续写·亲情）
Though he owed a considerable debt, the honest shopkeeper insisted on repaying every last coin before the year was out. （读后续写·诚信）

collocations.phrase: owe one's success / life to sb
collocations.translation: 把成功/生命归功于某人
collocations.example: The champion humbly declared that she owed her success to the countless people who had believed in her when she could not believe in herself. （读后续写·领奖·谦逊）
You once helped me when no one else would, and I have owed you a favour ever since. （读后续写·人情）
A true friend owes loyalty not to your every word, but to your better self. （议论文·友谊论）

collocations.phrase: how much do I owe you?
collocations.translation: 我该付你多少钱？（日常表达）
collocations.example: 'How much do I owe you?' the boy asked, emptying his pockets, but the old baker only smiled and waved him away. （读后续写·善意）
This flourishing garden owes its existence to years of quiet, unnoticed devotion. （议论文·坚持的力量）

synonyms.example: She attributed her calm under pressure to years of playing chess with her grandfather. （议论文·归因论证）
synonyms.usage: attribute A to B 侧重理性地把某结果归因于某原因，常用于分析说理；owe sth to sb 更含情感色彩，强调感激与亏欠

synonyms.example: I remain deeply indebted to the mentor who saw promise in me long before I saw it in myself. （应用文·感谢信）
synonyms.usage: be indebted to 更正式、书面，强调道义上的亏欠与感激；owe 用法更广，既可指金钱债务，也可指情义

synonyms.example: History credits the discovery to a single scientist, yet it was built on the quiet work of hundreds. （议论文·功过论）
synonyms.usage: credit sth to sb 强调把功劳归于某人，语气客观；owe sth to sb 从受惠者角度表达感激，情感更浓

advancedExpressions.expression: owe sb sth（欠某人）｜owe sth to sb（归功于）｜owe it to sb to do（有义务做）｜owing to（由于）
advancedExpressions.example: I owe you an apology; I owe my calm to your advice; and I owe it to you to make things right — owing to your patience, I finally can. （一句串起 owe 的四种高频用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·把成功归功于
advancedExpressions.expression: owe sth to sb ≈ attribute sth to sb ≈ credit sth to sb ≈ be indebted to sb for sth
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever I have achieved, I owe to / attribute to / credit to my mentor, to whom I remain forever indebted. （四种归功表达，语气由情到理递进）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·owe it to sb to do 的形式宾语
advancedExpressions.expression: owe it to sb to do sth 中 it 是形式宾语，真正宾语是后面的不定式
advancedExpressions.example: We owe it to those who come after us to leave the world kinder than we found it. （it 指代 to leave...，切勿漏 it 或误用 that）

advancedExpressions.expression: whatever ... I have, I owe to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever courage I now possess, I owe entirely to a grandmother who taught me that fear is only a door waiting to be opened. （结尾段点明恩情，升华主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: we owe you a debt of gratitude that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We owe you a debt of gratitude that words can scarcely repay, for your kindness has changed the course of many young lives. （感谢信核心句）

advancedExpressions.expression: we owe it to ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We owe it to those who come after us to leave the world greener, kinder and fairer than we found it. （提出道义责任，呼吁行动）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I am thankful to my teacher for helping me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Whatever small light I now carry within me, I owe to a teacher who refused to look away when I was ready to give up on myself. （读后续写·感恩升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Whatever...I now carry 让步结构升格 + 隐喻(small light) + owe to 归功句式 + who 定语从句补充细节

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect the environment for our children.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We owe it to the generations not yet born to guard this fragile earth, for the world is not a possession we inherit but a trust we are bound to pass on. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: owe it to sb to do 道义责任句式 + generations not yet born 庄重表达 + not...but 对比递进 + inherit/pass on 呼应结构

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 我认为他们得向我们道歉。
classPractice.answer: I think they owe us an apology. / I think they owe an apology to us.
classPractice.note: 【课件】owe sb sth = owe sth to sb（双宾语可互换，介词用 to）；此处 owe sb an apology 该向某人道歉。

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 我欠你多少钱？
classPractice.answer: How much do I owe you?
classPractice.note: 【课件】日常表达 How much do I owe you? 我该付你多少钱？owe sb + 金额。

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 由于身体受伤，他失业了。
classPractice.answer: He was out of work owing to a physical injury.
classPractice.note: 【课件】owing to = because of，作状语引出原因；勿与动词 owe 的形式混淆。

classPractice.question: ____ (owe) to the heavy fog, the ferry service was suspended for the entire afternoon.
classPractice.note: owing to = because of，作句首状语；此处不能用 owe 的其他形式，固定搭配

classPractice.question: 他谦逊地表示把自己的成功归功于老师的鼓励。He modestly said that he ____ ____ ____ ____ his teacher's encouragement.
classPractice.answer: owed his success to / attributed his success to
classPractice.note: 考 owe sth to sb 归功句式；四空填 owed his success to（或 attributed his success to），介词一律用 to

classPractice.question: 我们有责任为子孙后代保护好这颗星球。（owe it to）
classPractice.answer: We owe it to future generations to protect this planet.
classPractice.note: owe it to sb to do sth，it 为形式宾语，真宾语是 to protect

translation: n. 人情债，情义，恩情；借款，欠款，债务
original_sentence: Generations of poets, both in China and abroad, owe a debt to his inspirational poems.
readingExamples: Generations of poets, both in China and abroad, owe a debt to his inspirational poems.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a sum of money that a person or organization owes to another and is required to pay back
(2) n. the state of owing money, especially when you cannot pay it back
(3) n. a feeling of gratitude or obligation for a favour, kindness, or help that someone has given you
(4) n. something (such as an achievement or idea) that exists or was made possible because of the influence of someone or something else

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 恩情，人情债；亏欠（非金钱的道义之债）
uncommonMeanings.example: The debt she felt towards the old woman who had raised her could never be measured in money — it was written instead in every kindness she now offered strangers. （读后续写·感恩·反哺）

posExamples.sentence: Standing at his grandfather's grave, the young man vowed to repay the debt of love he had never found the words to acknowledge while the old man still lived. （读后续写·遗憾·感恩）
I am writing to express our profound debt of gratitude to the volunteers whose tireless efforts turned a bare classroom into a home of hope for these children. （应用文·感谢信）
Every generation stands upon the shoulders of the last, and the wisest among us never forget the intellectual debt they owe to those who thought and struggled before them. （议论文·传承·论证）
Buried in debt after the failed harvest, the farmer refused to sell his only cow, for some promises, he believed, mattered more than money. （读后续写·困境·尊严）

wordForms.other: debtor (n. 债务人，反义 creditor 债权人)；indebted (adj. 负债的；感激的，be indebted to sb for sth)｜易错拼写：debt 中 b 不发音(silent b)，勿漏写 b，同类还有 doubt, subtle, thumb｜辨析：debt 可数(a debt/debts)，指具体债务或人情；in debt 中不加冠词，是固定短语

idioms.translation: 负债；欠某人的情
idioms.example: I shall remain forever in debt to the stranger who guided me home through that blinding storm. （读后续写·感恩）

idioms.translation: 负债，陷入债务
idioms.example: Rather than run into debt for a single glittering night, the sensible girl chose a simple dress and a clear conscience. （读后续写·价值观）

idioms.translation: 还清债务；报恩
idioms.example: Years later, when he quietly paid off the debt his father had left behind, he felt at last that the family name was clean. （读后续写·担当）

idioms.idiom: owe sb a debt of gratitude
idioms.translation: 欠某人一份感激
idioms.example: We owe our teachers a debt of gratitude that no examination result could ever fully express. （应用文·教师节致谢）

collocations.phrase: owe a debt to sb / sth（课文原句）
collocations.example: Generations of poets, both in China and abroad, owe a debt to his inspirational poems. （课文原句·debt 喻指文学上的传承之恩）

collocations.translation: 感激之情，恩情（一份需要偿还的感激）
collocations.example: We owe our teachers a debt of gratitude no examination could ever repay. （固定搭配·庄重致谢）

collocations.phrase: in debt / be in sb's debt
collocations.example: After the flood, half the village fell into debt, yet I remain forever in the old doctor's debt for his selfless care. （in debt 负债／be in sb's debt 欠某人人情，一词双关）
It took him ten years to pay off the debt his father had left behind. （pay off 强调彻底清偿）
He worked three jobs that winter, determined to settle every debt before he allowed himself to dream again. （读后续写·奋斗）
After ten hard years, the family was finally out of debt, and for the first time the New Year lanterns felt truly bright. （读后续写·苦尽甘来）
Warn young people how easily one can fall into debt through careless spending, and you may save them years of quiet anxiety. （议论文·理财教育）
The essay examined how rising public debt could weigh upon the shoulders of the very generation meant to inherit prosperity. （议论文·经济）
One phone call cleared the debt entirely, and the relief in her father's eyes was something the boy would never forget. （读后续写·亲情）
Every writer of our language owes an unspoken debt to the poets who first taught it how to sing. （议论文·文化传承）

synonyms.example: She felt a deep obligation to repay the community that had once taken her family in. （议论文·责任论证）
synonyms.usage: obligation 侧重道义或法律上必须履行的责任；debt 更具体，可指金钱之债，也可比喻情义之债，情感更浓

synonyms.example: Words could not contain the gratitude that welled up in her chest as she watched the rescuers walk away. （读后续写·情感高潮）
synonyms.usage: gratitude 指感激的情感本身；a debt of gratitude 则把这份感激说成一种需要'偿还'的亏欠，更显庄重

synonyms.example: The company's mounting liabilities finally forced its ambitious founder to confront the cost of his recklessness. （议论文·商业·代价）
synonyms.usage: liability 是正式/法律与财经术语，指须承担的债务或责任；debt 用法更普遍，且可用于情义层面的比喻

advancedExpressions.expression: in debt（负债）｜pay off a debt（还清）｜a debt of gratitude（感激之情）｜be in sb's debt（欠某人人情）
advancedExpressions.example: Though no longer in debt to any bank, he knew he was forever in the debt of the stranger who had once paid off his family's debt — a debt of gratitude money could not touch. （四大搭配一句尽览，金钱之债与情义之债对照）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·亏欠与感激
advancedExpressions.expression: a debt of gratitude ≈ deep gratitude ≈ a profound obligation to sb ≈ be indebted to sb
advancedExpressions.example: We owe a debt of gratitude to / are deeply indebted to / feel a profound obligation to those who came before us. （由具象债务喻到抽象感恩，语体渐正式）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·silent b 与派生
advancedExpressions.expression: debt → debtor(债务人) / creditor(债权人，反义) / indebted(负债的、感激的)
advancedExpressions.example: The debtor bowed to the creditor, indebted not only in coin but in kindness. （一组同源与反义词，注意 debt 的 b 不发音）

advancedExpressions.expression: a debt that no ... could ever repay
advancedExpressions.example: As she watched her mother's tired hands, she understood she carried a debt that no fortune, no success, no lifetime could ever fully repay. （三重排比强化亏欠之深，升华亲情）

advancedExpressions.expression: we owe a profound debt of gratitude to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We owe a profound debt of gratitude to every teacher who lit our way, and we promise to carry that light to others. （感谢信收束，庄重有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: we stand in debt to those who ...
advancedExpressions.example: We stand in debt to those who dreamed before us, and the only true repayment is to dream, in turn, for those who will follow. （提出传承责任，警句收尾）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I am very grateful to my parents.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The debt I owe my parents cannot be counted in years or repaid in words; it lives, instead, in every choice I make to become the person their sacrifices imagined. （读后续写·感恩升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词 debt 作主语 + not...cannot be counted/repaid 否定强化 + 分号转折 + lives in every choice 具象化收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: People today owe a lot to past thinkers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Whatever heights our civilisation has reached, it owes to a long, unbroken chain of thinkers whose debt we can never repay but must forever honour. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Whatever...has reached 让步结构 + owe to 归功句式 + an unbroken chain 隐喻 + never repay but forever honour 对比收束

classPractice.question: For years the family lived ____ debt, but after the good harvest they finally cleared every loan and slept soundly at last.
classPractice.note: in debt 固定短语意为'负债中'，不加冠词；反义 out of debt

classPractice.question: 我们欠这些志愿者一份感激之情。We owe these volunteers ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: a debt of gratitude 感激之情，庄重致谢固定搭配

classPractice.question: 他花了十年才还清父亲留下的债务。（pay off）
classPractice.answer: It took him ten years to pay off the debt (his father had) left behind.
classPractice.note: pay off a debt 还清债务；注意 debt 的 b 不发音但不可漏写

translation: vt. & vi. 深深吸引，迷住
original_sentence: He was fascinated by Li Bai’s poems and translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay.
readingExamples: He was fascinated by Li Bai’s poems and translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to attract or interest someone very strongly, so that all of their attention is held
(2) vt. to hold someone motionless or spellbound, as if by a magic power
(3) vi. to have a powerful, almost hypnotic appeal that draws people in

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （旧义）使呆住，使动弹不得（如蛇迷惑猎物般）
uncommonMeanings.example: The cobra swayed slowly, its cold eyes seeming to fascinate the little bird into utter stillness — the poor creature could not so much as flutter a wing. （读后续写·自然界·猎手与猎物）

posExamples.sentence: The first time she pressed her ear against the ancient grandfather clock, its steady heartbeat of ticks and chimes fascinated her so completely that she forgot the world outside had turned to dusk. （读后续写·童年好奇心）

I am writing to recommend our school's astronomy club, whose telescope nights never fail to fascinate newcomers and awaken in them a lifelong curiosity about the boundless universe overhead. （应用文·推荐信）
What truly fascinates about traditional Chinese calligraphy is not merely its visual grace, but the way each brushstroke preserves the breathing rhythm and inner spirit of the artist. （议论文·文化传承）
As the old craftsman folded the paper crane before our eyes, his nimble fingers fascinated the entire class into a hushed, wide-eyed silence. （读后续写·手工艺·课堂场景）

wordForms.other: -ed / -ing 分词形容词辨析：fascinated 形容人'感到着迷'(be fascinated by/with sth)，fascinating 形容物'令人着迷'(a fascinating film)；同类还有 interested/interesting, bored/boring, amazed/amazing｜fascination (n.)常用 hold/have a fascination for sb, in fascination(着迷地)

collocations.phrase: be fascinated by sth（课文原句）
collocations.example: He was fascinated by Li Bai's poems and translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay. （课文原句·庞德被李白诗歌所倾倒）
From boyhood he had been fascinated by the migration of birds, spending whole autumns with a battered notebook, charting the shifting arrows across the sky. （读后续写·人物志趣）

collocations.translation: 引人入胜的……（fascinating 修饰事物）
collocations.example: The lecture on ancient astronomy was so fascinating that no one noticed the time. （fascinating 令事物着迷；fascinated 描述人的感受，勿混）

collocations.translation: 对某人有着强烈的吸引力（fascination 名词）
collocations.example: The starry sky had always held a fascination for the boy. （fascination 常与 hold/have 搭配）
The storyteller's hushed voice fascinated the children into forgetting the lateness of the hour. （读后续写·夜晚讲故事）
We watched in fascination as the master potter coaxed a shapeless lump of clay into a vase of astonishing symmetry. （读后续写·技艺展示）
For generations, the night sky has remained a source of endless fascination, luring dreamers and scientists alike toward its silent mysteries. （议论文·科学探索）

collocations.phrase: have a lifelong fascination with sth
collocations.example: Her lifelong fascination with the sea eventually led her to become one of the country's foremost marine biologists. （读后续写·梦想成真）
The documentary offered a fascinating account of how ancient artisans built structures that still stand today. （应用文·观后感）
Many exchange students find the delicate art of Chinese paper-cutting utterly fascinating, marvelling at the patience each pattern demands. （应用文·文化交流）

synonyms.example: Her voice captivated the audience the instant she began to sing, and not a soul dared to breathe too loudly. （读后续写·舞台表演）
synonyms.usage: 语气比 fascinate 更强，强调瞬间俘获人心、令人陶醉；常用于人的魅力、表演、美景

synonyms.translation: 激起……的好奇心，使产生兴趣
synonyms.example: The unsigned letter on his desk intrigued him — who could have known his secret? （读后续写·悬念）
synonyms.usage: 侧重因神秘、费解而勾起好奇心与探究欲，含'想弄明白'之意，未必是纯粹的喜爱

synonyms.example: The moonlit garden enchanted the weary traveller, and for a moment all his troubles melted into the silver mist. （读后续写·环境描写）
synonyms.usage: 带有魔力、梦幻般的色彩，多用于美景、音乐、氛围，情感更柔和浪漫

advancedExpressions.expression: be fascinated by sth（人着迷）｜a fascinating + n.（物迷人）｜hold a fascination for sb（吸引某人）｜watch in fascination（着迷地看）
advancedExpressions.example: Fascinated by the fascinating shadow play, the children watched in fascination — the flickering figures had always held a strange fascination for them. （动词、-ed／-ing 形容词、名词一句全用）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ed / -ing 分词形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: fascinate → fascinated(人感到着迷) / fascinating(物令人着迷)，规律同 interest/bore/amaze
advancedExpressions.example: I was fascinated because the topic was fascinating. （主语是人用 -ed，主语是物用 -ing，高考高频考点）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·使着迷（强度递进）
advancedExpressions.expression: attract < fascinate < captivate / enchant / mesmerize（吸引 → 使痴迷 → 令人陶醉／神魂颠倒）
advancedExpressions.example: The melody first attracted, then fascinated, and at last utterly captivated the whole hall. （三词递进渲染沉醉程度）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境/心理烘托
advancedExpressions.expression: so fascinated was sb. by ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: So fascinated was the boy by the fireflies drifting over the pond that he stood frozen, his supper forgotten, his heart pounding with a joy he could not name. （前置倒装强调 + 心理描写，续写渲染沉醉之情）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., which is bound to fascinate anyone who ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our calligraphy exhibition features works spanning a thousand years, which is bound to fascinate anyone who cherishes the beauty of the written word. （which 非限制性定语从句 + be bound to 强调必然性）

advancedExpressions.expression: what fascinates us about ... is ultimately ...
advancedExpressions.example: What fascinates us about great literature is ultimately not the plot itself but the mirror it holds up to our own unspoken longings. （主语从句 + not...but... 强调结构，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The children were interested in the magician's tricks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The children were utterly fascinated by the magician, their eyes widening in unison as the dove burst from an empty hat, a collective gasp rippling through the tent like wind across a field of wheat. （读后续写·动作+群体反应+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: interested 升级为 fascinated 强化程度 + 眼神动作特写(eyes widening) + 群体反应(collective gasp) + 明喻(like wind across a field of wheat)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The subject is very interesting and attracts many students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The subject possesses an enduring fascination that draws students from every corner of the campus, kindling in them a curiosity no textbook alone could ever ignite. （议论文·正式文体）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: possess an enduring fascination 名词化正式表达 + draws...from every corner 空间夸张 + kindling...curiosity 现在分词状语 + no...could ever 强调句式

classPractice.question: The children were completely ____ (fascinate) by the magician, whose ____ (fascinate) tricks kept them spellbound for a full hour.
classPractice.note: 人感到着迷用 fascinated，物令人着迷用 fascinating，-ed/-ing 分词形容词高频对比

classPractice.question: 从童年起他就对天上的星星着迷。Ever since childhood he ____ ____ ____ ____ the stars overhead.
classPractice.note: be fascinated by/with sth 对……着迷；ever since 引导现在完成时

classPractice.question: 在括号中选择正确的词：Everyone found the documentary utterly (fascinated / fascinating).
classPractice.note: find sth + adj.，宾语 documentary 是物，用 fascinating

translation: vt. (usually passive) 给……命名；使享有权利，使符合资格
original_sentence: He was fascinated by Li Bai’s poems and translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay.
readingExamples: He was fascinated by Li Bai’s poems and translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. (usually passive) to give a title to a book, film, poem, painting, etc.
(2) vt. to give someone the official right to have or do something
(3) vt. to qualify a person for a particular privilege or treatment

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 给（书、诗、画等）命名，题名为（常用被动 be entitled = 名为）
uncommonMeanings.example: The painting, entitled 'Homecoming', shows a lone traveller at the village gate. （'命名'义与'赋予权利'义为 entitle 的两大义项，须辨清语境）

posExamples.sentence: Trembling with pride, the young poet held up the slim volume he had entitled 'Whispers of the North Wind', the very first words he had ever dared to send out into the world. （读后续写·梦想实现·作品命名）
I am writing to remind all members that your annual membership entitles you to free entry to every workshop and a generous discount at the campus bookstore. （应用文·通知）
Hard work alone does not automatically entitle one to success; without a clear direction, even the most tireless effort may lead nowhere. （议论文·奋斗与方向）
She proudly showed us the painting entitled 'Homecoming', in which a lone traveller stands at the gate as the whole village runs to greet him. （读后续写·艺术作品）

wordForms.other: 构词法：en-(使…) + title(标题／头衔) → entitle 字面'使有标题→命名'，引申'使有资格'；同类 en- 构词：enable(使能够), enrich(使富有), enlarge(使扩大)｜entitled 双义：a book entitled X(名为)／be entitled to X(有权)，靠 to 判别｜entitlement(n.)权利、津贴资格

collocations.translation: 【课件】一部/一首名为……的作品（entitle 表'命名，题名'，常用被动）
collocations.example: He translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay. 他把其中一些译入了他1915年的诗集《华夏集》中。

collocations.translation: 【课件】有资格做某事，有权（拥有或做）某事
collocations.example: Full-time employees are entitled to receive health insurance. 全职雇员都有资格享受医疗保险。

collocations.phrase: entitle sb to do sth / entitle sb to sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】使某人有资格/有权（享有或做）某事
collocations.example: There are 23 Clubs throughout China, and your membership entitles you to enjoy all of them. 全中国有23家俱乐部，你的会员资格让你有权享用它们全部。

collocations.phrase: a collection / poem entitled ...（课文原句）
collocations.translation: 一部名为……的作品（entitle 表'命名，题名'，常用被动）
collocations.example: He was fascinated by Li Bai's poems and translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay. （课文原句·诗集名为《华夏集》）

collocations.translation: 有权（做）某事，有资格获得（另一核心义：赋予权利）
collocations.example: Every citizen is entitled to a fair hearing. （be entitled to + n./do，'有权'义，与'命名'义并列的高频多义）
The scholarship entitles top students to a full waiver of tuition. （主动语态，主语是给予权利的事物）

collocations.translation: 一本／一首／一部名为……的作品
collocations.example: He handed me a worn notebook entitled 'Letters I Never Sent', and I understood at once the depth of the sorrow he had carried alone. （读后续写·情感揭示）
Everyone is entitled to his own opinion, yet an opinion unsupported by evidence carries little weight in serious debate. （议论文·理性讨论）

collocations.translation: 自认为有权得到（常含贬义）
collocations.example: Having won once, he felt entitled to victory again — an arrogance that would soon cost him dearly. （读后续写·人物弱点）
The reform clarified every worker's entitlement to paid leave and safe working conditions. （应用文·报告）
The exhibition, entitled 'Threads of Time', traces the evolution of silk weaving across a thousand years. （应用文·展览介绍）

synonyms.example: They named the newborn foal 'Storm', for it had come into the world on the wildest night of the year. （读后续写·命名场景）
synonyms.usage: 最普通的'命名'，口语书面皆宜；entitle 多用于书籍、艺术作品等的正式题名，且常用被动

synonyms.example: The headmaster authorized the club to use the auditorium for its charity concert. （应用文·许可）
synonyms.usage: 侧重官方正式的'授予权力／许可去做某事'；entitle 侧重赋予'有资格得到某物'的资格或权利

synonyms.example: Passing this examination qualifies you to apply for the advanced programme. （应用文·资格说明）
synonyms.usage: 强调达到某种标准／条件后获得资格；常接 for sth 或 to do sth，与 entitle 意义相近但更强调'条件达标'

advancedExpressions.expression: a work entitled ...（名为·被动）｜be entitled to (do) sth（有权做）｜entitle sb to sth（使某人有权）｜entitlement to sth（资格）
advancedExpressions.example: In the book entitled 'Rights and Duties', the author argues that being entitled to a benefit never entitles one to forget the duties that come with it. （'命名'与'赋权'两义同句对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: en- + title → entitle（使有头衔／命名）；enable, enrich, enlarge, encourage 同理
advancedExpressions.example: The prefix en- turns a noun or adjective into a verb of 'making': title→entitle, rich→enrich, large→enlarge. （用构词法记忆 entitle 的'使…'内核）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be entitled to 后接名词或动词
advancedExpressions.expression: be entitled to + n. / to do sth（此处 to 可作介词也可作不定式记号）
advancedExpressions.example: Members are entitled to free entry (n.) and to attend every workshop (to do). （to 后既可跟名词又可跟动词原形，区别于 look forward to 只接名词/动名词）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·作品/情感呼应
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., a work she had entitled ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: She placed in my hands a battered manuscript, a work she had entitled 'Second Chances', and in that title lay the whole story of the years we had lost and found again. （同位语插入 + 标题双关点题，续写升华主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a ..., you are entitled to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a registered volunteer, you are entitled to professional training, a certificate of service, and the priceless reward of a grateful smile. （身份状语 + 三项并列，末项由实转虚，情理兼备）

advancedExpressions.type: 议论文·权利与责任辩证
advancedExpressions.expression: being entitled to ... does not exempt one from ...
advancedExpressions.example: Being entitled to freedom does not exempt one from responsibility; true liberty is always bound by respect for others. （动名词主语 + 抽象思辨，深化观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He wrote a book and gave it a name.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: After three long winters bent over his desk, he at last completed the novel and, with a hand that would not stop shaking, entitled it 'The Long Way Home'. （读后续写·创作艰辛+动作细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语铺垫艰辛(three long winters) + entitle 替代 'give a name' 显文采 + with a hand that would not stop shaking 独立动作细节渲染激动

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students who pass the test can join the programme.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Students who successfully pass the qualifying examination shall be entitled to enrol in the advanced programme free of charge. （应用文·正式通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: shall be entitled to 正式公文情态 + qualifying examination 术语化 + free of charge 补充福利，符合通知文体规范

classPractice.question: 判断 entitled 的含义（命名／有权）：He showed me a slim volume ____ 'Whispers of the North Wind'.（entitle 适当形式）
classPractice.note: 此处为'命名'义，作 volume 的后置定语(过去分词)，= named；靠无 to、后接标题判断

classPractice.question: 作为注册会员，你有权免费参加每一场工作坊。As a registered member, you ____ ____ ____ ____ every workshop free of charge.
classPractice.note: be entitled to do sth 有权做某事，此为 entitle 的'赋权'义

classPractice.question: Passing the exam does not automatically ____ (entitle) one to a place; a strong interview still matters.
classPractice.note: entitle sb to sth 使某人有资格得到；情态动词 does 后用原形

translation: vt. 把……归咎于，责怪，指责 | n. 责任，责备，指责
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad that has happened
(2) vt. to consider someone as the cause of a fault or wrong
(3) n. responsibility for something bad that has happened; criticism directed at the person held responsible

posExamples.sentence: When the vase lay shattered on the floor, little Tom instantly blamed the cat, though his guilty, downcast eyes betrayed the truth to everyone in the room. （读后续写·童年·推卸责任）
Rather than pointing fingers, our captain quietly shouldered the blame for the lost match, and in that single act he won the undying loyalty of the whole team. （读后续写·领导力·担当）
We should not blame technology itself for the decline of face-to-face communication; the fault lies not in the tool but in how we choose to use it. （议论文·科技反思）
I am writing to accept full blame for the misunderstanding at last week's meeting and to assure you that such an oversight will never occur again. （应用文·道歉信）

wordForms.other: blame 名动同形：v. 责备(blame sb for sth) / n. 责任、责备(take the blame)｜派生：blameless(adj. 无可指责的) / blameworthy(adj. 该受责备的)｜句法特例：be to blame 用主动表被动，意为'该受责备'，勿加 -d 或写成被动 be blamed

idioms.translation: （对某事）负有责任，应受责备
idioms.example: Deep down, he knew he alone was to blame for the rift that had torn the two brothers apart. （读后续写·悔恨心理）

idioms.idiom: shift / lay the blame on sb
idioms.translation: 把责任推给某人
idioms.example: It is all too easy to lay the blame on circumstances; it takes real courage to look inward and admit one's own faults. （议论文·自省）

collocations.translation: 因某事责怪某人（宾语是人，for 引出原因）
collocations.example: Don't blame yourself for what happened; no one could have foreseen the storm. （blame + 人 + for + 事，最常考结构）

collocations.translation: 把某事归咎于……（宾语是事，on 引出被归咎者）
collocations.example: For years he blamed all his failures on bad luck. （blame + 事 + on + 人；与 blame sb for sth 互为改写，介词随宾语变）

collocations.translation: （对某事）负有责任，应受责备（主动形式表被动义）
collocations.example: Deep down, he knew he alone was to blame for the rift. （be to blame 用主动表被动，切勿写成 be to be blamed）
A true leader takes the blame when things go wrong and gives the credit when things go right. （the blame 为名词，承担责任）

collocations.phrase: put / place / lay the blame on sb
collocations.translation: 把责任推／加到某人身上
collocations.example: It is far easier to put the blame on others than to look honestly at oneself. （put/place/lay the blame on sb，介词固定用 on）
The youngest child always seemed to get the blame, whether or not he had done anything wrong. （读后续写·家庭）
Both sides must share the blame for the breakdown of the talks, and both must now share the work of rebuilding trust. （议论文·和解）
In this tangled affair, hardly anyone could claim to be entirely free from blame. （读后续写·道德困境）
Instead of wasting time apportioning blame, the team focused every ounce of energy on finding a solution. （议论文·务实态度）

collocations.phrase: put / place the blame on sb
collocations.example: It would be unfair to place the entire blame on a single student for a project that we all worked on together. （应用文·说明）

synonyms.example: The teacher criticized the essay not to wound the boy, but to show him how much sharper his thinking could become. （读后续写·师生）
synonyms.usage: 侧重指出缺点、给出评判，未必牵涉'过错归属'；blame 强调'把坏结果的责任归到某人身上'

synonyms.example: She accused him of stealing the manuscript, her voice cold and unwavering. （读后续写·冲突）
synonyms.usage: 语气更重，常指公开控告某人做了错事／坏事，多接 of sth；blame 侧重归责，语气可轻可重

synonyms.example: 'How could you forget?' she reproached him softly, and the disappointment in her eyes cut deeper than any anger. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: 带温和而痛心的责备，多因失望而非愤怒，情感细腻，适合续写刻画亲密关系间的责怪

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·blame 归责三件套
advancedExpressions.expression: blame sb for sth（责怪某人）｜blame sth on sb（把事归咎于人）｜be to blame（该受责备）｜take / put the blame（承担／推卸责任）
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than blaming his teammates for the loss or blaming the loss on bad luck, the captain admitted he alone was to blame and quietly took the blame before the whole team. （四种归责表达一句串联，凸显担当）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·责备（语气由轻到重）
advancedExpressions.expression: criticize(批评) < blame(归责) < reproach(痛心责备) < accuse(指控) < condemn(谴责)
advancedExpressions.example: She did not condemn or accuse him; she merely reproached him with a look, though many would have blamed him outright. （多词并置，体现责备的强度谱系）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be to blame 主动表被动
advancedExpressions.expression: be to blame = deserve blame（该受责备）；同类还有 be to let(待租) / be to seek(欠缺)
advancedExpressions.example: Who is to blame for the accident? — 该结构永远用主动，不可说 *be to be blamed。（高考易错点）

advancedExpressions.expression: the blame, sb. realized, lay not with ... but with ...
advancedExpressions.example: The blame, he slowly realized, lay not with the friend who had failed him, but with the pride that had prevented him from asking for help. （插入语 + not...but... 转折，续写心理觉醒的经典句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: I take full responsibility and accept whatever blame ...
advancedExpressions.example: I take full responsibility for the delay and accept whatever blame may follow, for the fault was mine and mine alone. （道歉信 + for the fault was... 补充强调，显真诚与担当）

advancedExpressions.expression: before we rush to blame ..., let us first ask ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we rush to blame the younger generation for their obsession with screens, let us first ask what kind of world we adults have handed them. （祈使反问句式，引导读者理性反思，深化论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was his fault, and he knew it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He alone was to blame, and the knowledge sat like a stone in his chest, heavier with every passing hour, refusing to be argued away. （读后续写·心理+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be to blame 习语替代 'his fault' + 明喻(like a stone in his chest)具象化愧疚 + heavier with every passing hour 时间推进强化重压 + refusing to be argued away 拟人化

sentenceUpgrade.original: We shouldn't blame others for our own mistakes.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than shifting the blame onto circumstances beyond our control, we would do far better to look inward, for the courage to admit one's own faults is the first true step toward growth. （议论文·正式说理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than shifting the blame 现在分词状语对比 + we would do far better to 委婉建议 + for 引导原因 + 抽象升华(the first true step toward growth)

classPractice.question: No one but the driver himself was ____ blame for the crash, since he had ignored every warning sign.
classPractice.note: be to blame 该受责备，用主动表被动，固定不加 be blamed

classPractice.question: 改写：They blamed the delay on the heavy traffic. → They ____ the heavy traffic ____ the delay.
classPractice.note: blame sth on sb ⇄ blame sb/sth for sth，介词随宾语位置变化

classPractice.question: 队长没有推卸责任，而是默默承担了失利的责任。The captain did not shift the blame; instead, he quietly ____ ____ ____ for the defeat.
classPractice.note: take the blame 承担责任；与 shift/put the blame on sb（推卸）相对

translation: n. 津贴，补助；限额；零花钱
definitionEn:
(1) n. an amount of money given regularly, especially to a child by parents, or for a particular purpose
(2) n. an amount of something that is permitted or officially allowed
(3) n. a reduction in an amount or price; an official sum granted to meet expenses

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （体谅、酌情考虑的）宽容余地〔常用于 make allowance(s) for〕
uncommonMeanings.example: The old teacher made every allowance for the boy's rough temper, knowing full well the hardships that had shaped him. （读后续写·师者仁心·体谅背后的苦衷）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 限额，配额（允许的量），如 baggage / duty-free allowance
uncommonMeanings.example: Each passenger's baggage allowance is limited to twenty kilograms. （'限额'义，源自 allow'允许'）

posExamples.sentence: Every Sunday morning her father would press a small allowance into her palm, and she learned early to divide it carefully: a little for sweets, a little for books, and always a little saved for a rainy day. （读后续写·成长·金钱观养成）
I am writing to inform all participants that the travel allowance for the exchange programme has been raised, so that no student need worry about the cost of the journey. （应用文·通知）
A wise society makes generous allowance for honest mistakes, for it understands that fear of failure kills innovation far more surely than failure itself. （议论文·包容与创新）
The airline's baggage allowance was strict, yet the young traveller could not bear to leave behind the worn photo album that held her whole childhood. （读后续写·离别·取舍）

wordForms.other: 构词法：allow(允许) + -ance(名词后缀) → allowance，字面'被允许的量'→引申'津贴、限额、宽容余地'｜同类 -ance 名词：appearance, importance, performance｜辨析：allowance(定期给付/限额/体谅) ≠ allow(v.允许)；短语 make allowance(s) for 中 for 后接被体谅的人或情况

idioms.translation: 体谅；考虑到，估计到（某种情况）
idioms.example: Even making allowances for his youth and inexperience, the judges agreed that his performance showed rare and dazzling promise. （读后续写·比赛评判）

collocations.translation: 每月／每周的津贴、零花钱
collocations.example: Out of her modest monthly allowance, she quietly set aside a few coins for the stray cats. （monthly/weekly allowance 定期发放的零用钱）

collocations.translation: 体谅；把……考虑在内，予以酌情宽容
collocations.example: When judging a first-time speaker, we ought to make allowances for nervousness. （核心习语，单复数皆可，for 引出被体谅的对象）
The scholarship covers tuition and a living allowance too. （各类专项津贴，前加用途名词）
Her grandmother gave her a small allowance not merely as pocket money, but as a first, gentle lesson in the value of thrift. （读后续写·家庭教育）
On such a meagre allowance, he had to weigh every purchase, yet he never once complained. （读后续写·清贫励志）
Exceeding the baggage allowance, she had no choice but to leave the heavy encyclopaedia behind. （读后续写·旅途取舍）
As long as your daily spending stays within the allowance, the rest is yours to save. （应用文·理财建议）
Wise planners always build in an allowance of time for the unexpected. （议论文·规划）
Out of her modest monthly allowance, she quietly set aside a few coins each week for the stray cats behind the school. （读后续写·善良细节）
The scholarship covers not only tuition but also a living allowance, freeing gifted students from the burden of part-time work. （应用文·奖学金）
When judging a first-time speaker, we ought to make allowances for nervousness and focus instead on the courage it took to stand up at all. （议论文·包容）

synonyms.example: He spent his pocket money on a second-hand kite and flew it until the string cut red lines across his palms. （读后续写·童年）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，专指给孩子的小额零用钱；allowance 更正式，可指定期发放的各类津贴、补助，用途更广

synonyms.example: Government subsidies made it possible for rural children to attend school free of charge. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: 多指政府或机构为特定目的（农业、教育、能源等）发放的补贴，规模大、政策性强；allowance 更个人化、日常化

synonyms.example: The research grant enabled the young scientist to pursue an idea that everyone else had dismissed. （应用文·科研）
synonyms.usage: 指为特定项目、学业或研究一次性拨给的款项，常需申请；allowance 多为定期、经常性的给付

advancedExpressions.expression: a monthly allowance（零花钱）｜a baggage allowance（限额）｜make allowance(s) for（体谅、考虑到）
advancedExpressions.example: Even on his small monthly allowance and a strict baggage allowance, the boy travelled far — and wise friends always made allowance for his youthful recklessness. （津贴、限额、体谅三义同句呈现）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·体谅/考虑在内
advancedExpressions.expression: make allowance(s) for ≈ take ... into account ≈ allow for ≈ be lenient with sb
advancedExpressions.example: We should make allowance for / take into account / allow for the difficulties beginners face. （三种表达可替换，语体由习语到中性）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ance 抽象名词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: allow → allowance；appear → appearance；perform → performance；important 与 importance
advancedExpressions.example: The suffix -ance turns a verb into an abstract noun: allow→allowance, perform→performance. （借词缀记忆拼写）

advancedExpressions.expression: making allowance for ..., sb. chose to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Making allowance for the exhaustion etched into the old man's face, she chose to say nothing of the broken window and simply helped him to a chair. （现在分词状语 + 体谅动机，续写刻画善解人意）

advancedExpressions.expression: in order to ..., a ... allowance will be provided
advancedExpressions.example: In order to ensure that no volunteer is left out of pocket, a modest transport allowance will be provided for every session. （目的状语 + be provided 被动，通知文体正式得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: while we make allowances for ..., we must not lower ...
advancedExpressions.example: While we make allowances for the difficulties young people face, we must not lower the standards that alone can help them rise. （while 让步 + must not 强调，辩证平衡宽容与要求）

sentenceUpgrade.original: His parents gave him money every week.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every Saturday his parents pressed a small allowance into his hand, and with it came an unspoken lesson: that money, like trust, was something to be earned, treasured, and never squandered. （读后续写·家教主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: allowance 替代 'money' 更具体 + press into his hand 动作细节 + 破折号引出抽象升华 + 三动词递进(earned, treasured, squandered) + 明喻(like trust)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should understand that beginners make mistakes.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We would be wise to make generous allowance for the stumbles of beginners, for every master, without exception, was once a fumbling novice too afraid to try. （议论文·包容说理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: make generous allowance for 习语化表达 + for 引导原因论证 + without exception 强调普遍性 + 对比(master / fumbling novice)增强说服力

classPractice.question: 用 allowance 的相关表达填空：Every month his parents give him a small ____, from which he saves a little for books.
classPractice.note: monthly allowance 零花钱／津贴，'定期给付'义

classPractice.question: We must ____ ____ for his inexperience; after all, this is his very first day on the job.
classPractice.note: make allowance(s) for 体谅、考虑到，单复数皆可，for 后接被体谅对象

classPractice.question: 每位乘客的行李限额为二十公斤。（allowance）
classPractice.answer: Each passenger's baggage allowance is (limited to) twenty kilograms.
classPractice.note: baggage allowance 行李限额，'允许的量'义，源自 allow

translation: 体谅；考虑到，估计到
original_sentence: Make a list of them.
readingExamples: Make a list of them.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to take a particular fact or circumstance into consideration when making a judgement or plan
(2) phr. to be understanding and lenient toward someone because of a difficulty they face
(3) phr. to leave extra room, time, or resources for something that might happen

posExamples.sentence: As the trembling boy stumbled over his lines, the kind old judge made allowance for his nerves and leaned forward with an encouraging smile that seemed to say, 'Take your time.' （读后续写·比赛·善意评判）
I would be grateful if you could make allowance for the delay in my application, as I was caring for my sick grandmother throughout that difficult week. （应用文·请求信）
A fair assessment of history must make allowance for the limited knowledge of the age, judging the past not by our standards but by its own. （议论文·历史评价）
Even making allowance for the terrible weather and the muddy track, the young runner's time was nothing short of astonishing. （读后续写·体育励志）

wordForms.other: 短语构成：make + allowance(s) + for + sb/sth；allowance 在此取'宽容余地'义，源自 allow(允许)｜可用单数或复数(make allowance / make allowances)，意义相同｜常以现在分词形式 making allowance for 作让步状语，多与 even 连用

collocations.translation: 体谅某人；把某情况考虑在内（单复数皆可）
collocations.example: The kind judge made allowance for the boy's nerves and gave him a second chance. （核心用法，for 后可接人或事）
The veteran captain made allowance for the rookie's inexperience, guiding him through each mistake with unfailing patience. （读后续写·师徒）
When judging others, a generous heart always makes allowance for the circumstances they cannot control. （议论文·包容）
A careful traveller always makes allowance for delays, setting off long before the train is due. （应用文·出行建议）
His mother made every allowance for his moods that year, sensing the storm of grief he could not yet put into words. （读后续写·亲情）

collocations.translation: 即便把……考虑在内（让步状语）
collocations.example: Even making allowance for the terrible weather, the runner's time was astonishing. （现在分词作让步状语，续写/议论高频）
Good teaching makes allowance for individual differences, meeting each learner where he is. （议论文·因材施教）
Any well-designed system must make allowance for human error, for even the most careful person occasionally slips. （议论文·制度设计）

synonyms.example: In grading the essays, the teacher took into account not only accuracy but also the courage each student had shown in tackling a difficult topic. （应用文·评价）
synonyms.usage: 最常用的中性替换，纯指'把某因素纳入考量'；make allowance for 额外含'因此予以宽容、放宽标准'的意味

synonyms.example: Allow for a little extra time, and you will never have to run for a train again. （应用文·建议）
synonyms.usage: 与 make allowance for 意义几乎相同且更简洁，尤指为可能情况'预留余地'；可互换，口语中 allow for 更常见

synonyms.example: The coach chose to be lenient with the exhausted players, cutting the evening session short. （读后续写·体谅）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'从宽处理、不严厉对待'某人，情感更直接；make allowance for 侧重因客观原因而在判断上放宽

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·make allowance for 的两层意思
advancedExpressions.expression: 体谅某人（对人的宽容）｜把某情况估计在内（对事的预留）——for 后接人则'体谅'，接事则'考虑到'
advancedExpressions.example: Making allowance for both his youth and the storm that night, the coach neither blamed nor praised him, but simply nodded. （for 后同时接人与事，兼两层含义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·考虑到/体谅
advancedExpressions.expression: make allowance for ≈ take ... into account / consideration ≈ allow for ≈ be lenient with sb ≈ factor in
advancedExpressions.example: We must make allowance for / take into account / allow for the hardships they have faced. （由习语到中性到简洁，可按语体择用）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·making allowance for 作让步状语
advancedExpressions.expression: Even making allowance for ..., sb. + 主句（现在分词短语前置作让步/条件状语）
advancedExpressions.example: Even making allowance for his lack of training, his failure was hard to excuse. （= Even if we make allowance for...；前置分词让步，书面感强）

advancedExpressions.expression: even making allowance for ..., sb. could hardly ...
advancedExpressions.example: Even making allowance for his youth, they could hardly believe that a boy of twelve had crossed such treacherous mountains alone. （even + 现在分词让步 + could hardly 反衬，续写渲染惊叹之情）

advancedExpressions.expression: I trust you will make allowance for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I trust you will make allowance for the exceptional circumstances I have described and grant me a brief extension. （I trust you will 委婉恳请 + and grant 承接诉求，请求信礼貌得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: true fairness lies in making allowance for ...
advancedExpressions.example: True fairness lies not in treating everyone identically, but in making allowance for the very different burdens each of us must carry. （not...but... 定义式论断，深化对'公平'的理解）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The teacher understood that the new student was nervous.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Sensing the fear behind the boy's stammer, the teacher made allowance for his nerves, and with a single warm nod turned a moment of dread into one of quiet courage. （读后续写·师生·心理转折）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: make allowance for 短语替代 'understood' + Sensing... 现在分词状语铺垫 + with a single warm nod 动作细节 + turn A into B 对比结构点出转变

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should consider the difficulties people face before judging them.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before we pass judgement on anyone, we would do well to make allowance for the unseen struggles they carry, for behind every hasty step there often lies a story we have never troubled to hear. （议论文·换位思考）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Before... 时间状语引导 + make allowance for 习语化 + for 引导原因论证 + there lies 倒装 + 抽象升华(a story we have never troubled to hear)

classPractice.question: We should ____ ____ ____ his nervousness, for this is the first time he has ever spoken in public.
classPractice.answer: make allowance for / make allowances for
classPractice.note: make allowance(s) for 体谅、考虑到；单复数皆可，for 后接被体谅对象

classPractice.question: 改写：We should take the difficulties they face into account before judging them. → We should ____ ____ ____ the difficulties they face before judging them.
classPractice.note: make allowance for ⇄ take ... into account，均表'把……考虑在内'

classPractice.question: 即便把恶劣天气考虑在内，他的成绩依然令人惊叹。____ ____ ____ ____ the terrible weather, his result was still astonishing.
classPractice.note: making allowance for 作让步状语，常与 even 连用，相当于 even if we make allowance for

translation: n. 巨大成功，重大成就，伟大胜利 | vi. 打败，战胜，成功
definitionEn:
(1) n. a great and important victory, success, or achievement
(2) n. a feeling of great satisfaction and pride resulting from a success or victory
(3) vi. to gain a victory or achieve success, especially after a difficult struggle; to defeat an opponent

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （古罗马的）凯旋式，凯旋游行
uncommonMeanings.example: The victorious general was granted a triumph, and the whole of Rome poured into the streets to hail his gilded chariot as it wound toward the Capitol. （读后续写·历史场景·凯旋游行）

posExamples.sentence: As she crossed the finish line, arms flung wide and tears streaming down her dusty cheeks, the crowd erupted — this was not merely a race won, but the triumph of a girl who had once been told she would never walk again. （读后续写·体育励志·逆袭）
History has shown, time and again, that courage and perseverance will ultimately triumph over the darkest of adversities. （议论文·意志的力量）
I am writing to share the wonderful news that our school choir's performance at the national contest was a resounding triumph, earning us the gold medal and warm praise from every judge. （应用文·喜讯分享）
Against all the odds, the tiny mountain village triumphed in its struggle against poverty, transforming barren slopes into terraces heavy with golden fruit. （读后续写·乡村振兴）

idioms.translation: 得意洋洋地，凯旋地
idioms.example: The young inventor held his working model aloft in triumph, and for one shining moment all the sleepless nights were forgotten. （读后续写·成功时刻）

collocations.translation: 战胜、克服（困难/对手）【课堂核心：作动词，后接 over】
collocations.example: With patience and grit, she finally triumphed over her fear of failure. 凭着耐心与毅力，她终于战胜了对失败的恐惧。

collocations.translation: 得意洋洋地；凯旋地【课堂核心：介词短语作状语】
collocations.example: The champion raised the trophy in triumph. 冠军得意洋洋地高举奖杯。
Her recovery was a triumph over both a cruel illness and the doubts of everyone who had given up on her. （读后续写·战胜疾病）
The film tells the moving story of a blind pianist who triumphs over adversity to fill the world's grandest halls with music. （读后续写·励志人物）
The launch of the nation's first deep-space probe was hailed as a resounding triumph of science and unyielding determination. （议论文·科技成就）
A quiet sense of triumph washed over him as he watched the seedlings he had planted push, at last, through the stubborn soil. （读后续写·耕耘有成）
Few had believed the underdog could triumph in a contest so heavily stacked against her. （读后续写·爆冷夺冠）

collocations.phrase: the triumph of good over evil
collocations.example: For centuries, folk tales have celebrated the triumph of good over evil, planting hope in the hearts of the young. （议论文·文学价值）
Finishing the marathon was, for him, less a competition than a personal triumph over years of self-doubt. （读后续写·自我超越）
The team returned in triumph, the championship trophy gleaming above a sea of cheering faces. （读后续写·载誉归来）

synonyms.translation: 胜利（尤指竞赛、战斗中击败对手）
synonyms.example: The victory came at a heavy cost, yet not a single soldier regretted the price they had paid for peace. （读后续写·代价）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：中性，指竞赛/战斗/争斗中'击败对手'的胜利，与 defeat 相对；典型搭配 win a victory over sb / a narrow victory 险胜；triumph 语气更强，突出重大、辉煌、令人振奋，且常含'历经艰难后'的成就感与情绪高潮

synonyms.example: Landing on the moon remains one of humanity's greatest achievements. （议论文·人类成就）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：泛指通过努力取得的成果，情感色彩较平、可大可小；典型搭配 a great achievement / a sense of achievement 成就感；triumph 更强调胜利的喜悦与荣耀，且暗含'战胜了对手或逆境'

synonyms.example: The concert was a huge success, praised by every critic in the city. 音乐会大获成功，全城评论家交口称赞。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：最常用、最中性的'成功'，可数(a success 一件成功的事)/不可数皆可；triumph 语气更隆重、更有画面感与情绪，常用于'历经艰难'后的辉煌胜利，正式书面色彩更浓

synonyms.example: She finally conquered her fear of the stage and sang as though the spotlight had been made for her alone. （读后续写·克服恐惧）
synonyms.usage: 辨析④：作及物动词，直接跟宾语，侧重'征服、攻克'困难/对手/领土，力度强；triumph (vi.) 为不及物，侧重'获得胜利、大获成功'，后常接 over sth/sb，不可直接跟宾语（不能说 triumph the enemy）

advancedExpressions.expression: triumph over sth 战胜 | in triumph 得意洋洋地/凯旋地 | a triumph of A over B | triumph in sth | triumphant(adj.) 得意的/凯旋的 | triumphantly(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: After years of struggle, he triumphed over every obstacle, and returned home in triumph with a triumphant smile. 历经多年奋斗，他战胜了一切障碍，带着得意的微笑凯旋而归。（一句串起动词/状语/形容词三种形式）

advancedExpressions.expression: triumph (n./vi. 胜利/战胜) → triumphant (adj. 得意的；凯旋的；成功的) → triumphantly (adv. 得意洋洋地) → triumphal (adj. 庆祝胜利的，triumphal arch 凯旋门)
advancedExpressions.example: 注意区分：triumphant 形容'人/情绪'得意的、成功的(a triumphant grin)；triumphal 形容'纪念胜利的事物'(a triumphal procession 凯旋游行)。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'战胜/取得胜利'
advancedExpressions.expression: triumph over = overcome / conquer / get the better of / prevail over / rise above（逆境）
advancedExpressions.example: 背写作时可替换升级：Instead of 'win over difficulties', write 'triumph over adversity' or 'rise above every setback'. 把'战胜困难'升级为更有力的表达。

advancedExpressions.expression: in that moment of triumph, sb. understood that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that moment of triumph, standing breathless beneath a storm of applause, she understood that the true prize had never been the medal, but the person she had become in reaching for it. （时间状语 + 独立分词 + not...but... 主题升华，续写结尾金句）

advancedExpressions.expression: our ... proved a triumph, and it reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our charity concert proved a triumph beyond all expectation, and it reminds us that when young hearts unite for a good cause, no goal is beyond our reach. （评价 + and it reminds us that 引申哲理，感染力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ultimate triumph of ... lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The ultimate triumph of education lies not in the grades we win, but in the curiosity and character it awakens within us. （not...but... 递进 + lie in 抽象化，收束全文、点明立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She won the competition and felt very happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the final whistle blew, a wave of pure triumph surged through her; she sank to her knees on the wet grass, laughing and weeping at once, scarcely able to believe that the impossible had, after all, come true. （读后续写·夺冠瞬间）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: triumph 名词替代 'happy' + surged through her 动态比喻 + sink to her knees 动作细节 + laughing and weeping at once 矛盾修辞写激动 + the impossible had come true 呼应逆袭主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: In the end, good people always win over bad people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History teaches us, again and again, that righteousness will in the end triumph over tyranny, however long and dark the road between may prove to be. （议论文·正式说理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: triumph over 短语替代 'win over' + History teaches us 权威引入 + again and again 强调普遍规律 + however...may prove 让步状语从句增强思辨深度

classPractice.question: Courage and perseverance will help you ____ (triumph) over even the darkest of adversities.
classPractice.note: help sb (to) do 后接动词原形；triumph over sth 战胜某事，此处 triumph 为不及物动词

classPractice.question: The crowd cheered as the champion held the golden cup high ____ ____, tears of joy in his eyes.
classPractice.note: in triumph 得意洋洋地/凯旋地，作状语；对应'高举奖杯、喜极而泣'的语境

classPractice.question: In the end, justice always wins over evil. → In the end, justice always ____ ____ evil.
classPractice.note: 用 triumph over 替换 win over，注意主语 justice 单数，动词加 -s

classPractice.question: 对许多人来说，跑完这场马拉松与其说是一场比赛，不如说是一次战胜自我怀疑的个人胜利。（personal triumph / self-doubt）
classPractice.answer: For many people, finishing the marathon is less a competition than a personal triumph over self-doubt.
classPractice.note: 考 a personal triumph over sth 及 less A than B（与其说A不如说B）结构

translation: n. 冒名顶替者，冒名行骗者
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person who pretends to be someone else or to have qualifications, powers or status they do not really possess, in order to deceive others
(2) n. someone who deceives people by claiming a false identity, often to gain trust, money or advantage
(3) n. a fraud; a person passing themselves off as another

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （心理学）自认名不副实、觉得自己是“骗子”的人（impostor syndrome 冒充者综合征）
uncommonMeanings.example: Even after topping the entire province in the final exam, she was gripped by a nagging voice inside — a quiet impostor whispering that her success was nothing but luck, and that sooner or later everyone would see through her. （读后续写·心理描写·自我怀疑）

posExamples.sentence: The stranger who claimed to be the long-lost heir turned out to be a cunning impostor, and the moment the old butler recognised the forged signature, the whole grand hall fell into a stunned, breathless silence. （读后续写·悬疑揭穿）

I am writing to warn all club members that an impostor, posing as our new coach, has been collecting registration fees online; please verify every message through the official account before making any payment. （应用文·提醒/告示）
A society that rewards flashy self-promotion over genuine competence inevitably breeds impostors, for it teaches the young that appearing capable matters far more than actually being so. （议论文·社会诚信）
Trembling, the boy confessed that he had entered the palace as an impostor — not for gold, but for the single meal that would keep his starving sister alive one more night. （读后续写·情感反转）

wordForms.other: impostor syndrome (冒充者综合征)

collocations.translation: 揭穿冒名顶替者【课堂核心搭配】
collocations.example: The old servant stepped forward and exposed the impostor before the whole court. 老仆上前，当着满朝文武揭穿了这个冒充者。

collocations.translation: 一个假扮成……的冒充者【核心：pose as 假扮】
collocations.example: The thief was an impostor posing as a police officer. 那个小偷是个假扮成警察的骗子。
With one calm question about a childhood secret only the real prince could know, the queen unmasked the impostor before the entire court. （读后续写·智斗）
So convincing was the cunning impostor that even the family's closest friends were taken in for months. （读后续写·叙事）

collocations.phrase: pose as sb / act the impostor
collocations.translation: 假扮成某人、冒充他人（注意：pose as 后接被冒充者的身份，不是 pose as an impostor）
collocations.example: Desperate to attend the elite academy, he posed as another student, an impostor borrowing a stranger's name and identity card. （读后续写·冒险）

collocations.translation: 觉得自己名不副实、像个骗子
collocations.example: Standing on the champions' podium, she strangely felt like an impostor, as if the medal belonged to someone braver and more deserving than she. （读后续写·心理）

collocations.translation: 冒充者综合征（觉得成功靠运气、怕被识破）
collocations.example: Many high-achieving students silently suffer from impostor syndrome, doubting abilities that everyone around them clearly admires. （议论文·青少年心理）
The security officer had been trained to spot an impostor by the smallest hesitation in the voice or the eyes. （读后续写·紧张情节）
Once celebrated as a healer, he was finally revealed to be a mere impostor peddling coloured water as miracle medicine. （议论文·揭露欺诈）
The scholar rose to his feet and boldly denounced the visiting 'professor' as an impostor who had never set foot in a real laboratory. （读后续写·对峙）

synonyms.example: The self-proclaimed investment guru was exposed as a fraud who had swindled hundreds of trusting families. （议论文·社会诚信）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：泛指以欺骗手段（尤指为钱财）行骗的人或'骗局'本身，范围比 impostor 广；既可指人也可指'欺诈行为'(commit fraud)；impostor 特指'冒充某人身份'这一类欺骗，更聚焦'假冒身份'

synonyms.example: Nobody suspected the friendly newcomer of being a cheat until the missing wallets started to add up. （读后续写·叙事）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：口语常用，既是名词(骗子)也是动词(cheat sb 欺骗、cheat in an exam 作弊)，强调'欺骗/作弊'的行为本身，语气随意；impostor 更书面正式，专指'假冒身份'，无动词用法

synonyms.translation: 冒称者；（尤指）觊觎王位者
synonyms.example: History remembers him as a pretender to the throne, a man whose royal claim collapsed the instant the true heir returned. （读后续写·历史/宫廷）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：多指假称拥有某头衔或权位（尤其王位，pretender to the throne）的人，带历史/正式色彩；impostor 更强调冒充某个具体身份以骗取信任/钱财，日常与叙事更常用

synonyms.example: The swindler vanished overnight with the villagers' life savings. 那个骗子卷走村民毕生积蓄，一夜之间消失得无影无踪。
synonyms.usage: 辨析④：专指'骗取钱财'的人，重点在'诈财'(swindle sb out of money)；impostor 重点在'冒充身份'，动机不一定是钱财（也可能为名、为地位、为混入某处）

advancedExpressions.expression: impostor(冒充者) 与 impose(强加/欺骗)、imposture(冒充行为)、pose as(假扮)、pretend(假装) 同源；词根 pos/pon = to place 放置
advancedExpressions.example: An impostor imposes a false identity on others by posing as someone he is not. 冒充者假扮成他并非之人，把一个虚假身份强加于人。（一句串联 impostor / impose / pose as）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·'假冒/揭穿'高频动词
advancedExpressions.expression: pose as sb 假扮 | pass oneself off as sb 冒充 | pretend to be sb 假装是 || expose / unmask / see through / denounce ... as an impostor 揭穿/识破
advancedExpressions.example: He tried to pass himself off as a doctor, but a single wrong term saw him unmasked as an impostor. 他企图冒充医生，但一个用错的术语让他被当场识破为骗子。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·turn out to be / be revealed to be
advancedExpressions.expression: sb turn out to be an impostor 结果原来是个冒充者；be revealed / exposed to be an impostor 被揭露是骗子
advancedExpressions.example: The charming stranger turned out to be a cunning impostor. 这位迷人的陌生人原来是个狡猾的冒充者。（turn out to be 表'结果是、原来是'，续写反转常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: impostor 与 triumph 同出 Kipling《If》名句 'If you can meet with Triumph and Disaster / And treat those two impostors just the same'
advancedExpressions.example: In Kipling's poem, both Triumph and Disaster are called 'impostors' — for neither should be taken too seriously. 在吉卜林诗中，'胜利'与'失败'都被称作'骗子'，因为二者都不该被太当真。（理解一词多义与比喻用法）

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had ... than the impostor was exposed
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had the false heir raised his glass to toast than the old servant stepped forward, and in that frozen heartbeat the impostor was exposed before them all. （no sooner 倒装制造揭穿高潮，续写反转段）

advancedExpressions.expression: we urge everyone to stay alert to impostors who ...
advancedExpressions.example: In light of recent scams, we sincerely urge every resident to stay alert to impostors who pose as officials in order to extract personal information. （应用文·安全提醒，in light of + urge 结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: the real threat lies not in the impostor without, but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The real threat to genuine achievement lies not in the impostor without, but in the culture that prizes image over substance and rewards pretence over honest effort. （not ... but 对比+抽象升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The man was not the real prince. He was a liar.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The man who had dined at the king's table for a fortnight was no prince at all, but a brazen impostor whose entire nobility hung upon a stolen name and a borrowed crown. （读后续写·揭穿）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: no ... at all, but 强对比结构 + whose 定语从句补充细节 + hung upon 具象化“骗局的脆弱”

sentenceUpgrade.original: Some successful students think they don't deserve their success.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a curious paradox that many of our most accomplished students privately regard themselves as impostors, dismissing hard-won triumphs as mere strokes of luck rather than the fruit of relentless effort. （议论文·青少年心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a curious paradox that... 引出论点 + regard sb. as 结构 + dismissing... rather than... 分词状语作对比论证

classPractice.question: 选词填空（impostor / fraud / pretender）：The man who claimed to be the lost prince was soon exposed as an ____, for he could not answer a single question about the palace.
classPractice.note: 语境是'冒充某人身份'，故选 impostor；fraud 侧重诈财、pretender 多指觊觎王位者

classPractice.question: 警方警告市民要警惕假扮成官员的冒充者。The police warned citizens to stay alert to ____ posing as officials.
classPractice.note: 按语境应为复数 impostors（泛指一类人）；后接现在分词 posing as sb 作后置定语'假扮某人的'

classPractice.question: 站在冠军领奖台上，她竟觉得自己像个名不副实的冒充者，仿佛这枚奖牌属于更配得上它的人。（feel like an impostor / deserving）
classPractice.answer: Standing on the champions' podium, she strangely felt like an impostor, as if the medal belonged to someone more deserving.
classPractice.note: 考 feel like an impostor（自认名不副实）及 as if 引导的从句

classPractice.question: The stranger turned out ____ ____ (be) a cunning impostor who had stolen another man's name.
classPractice.note: turn out to be sth 结果是/原来是；固定用不定式

translation: adj. 棘手的；不饶人的，不宽容的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (of conditions, an environment or a task) harsh and difficult, leaving no room for mistakes or weakness; extremely demanding
(2) adj. (of a person) not willing to forgive or make allowances; unwilling to excuse people's faults or mistakes
(3) adj. (of terrain, climate or circumstances) severe and offering no comfort or mercy

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对失误）毫不容错的、极其苛刻的（多形容自然环境、任务、赛道等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The final ascent was brutally unforgiving — a single misstep on the ice-slicked ridge would send a climber plunging into the white silence below, and yet she inched forward, refusing to look down. （读后续写·登山/极限挑战）

posExamples.sentence: Beyond the last village stretched an unforgiving desert, where the sun hammered the cracked earth by day and the cold gnawed at the travellers' bones by night, sparing no one who dared underestimate it. （读后续写·荒野求生）

I am writing to remind all applicants that the selection process for the national team is famously unforgiving, so please ensure every document is accurate, as even a minor error may cost you the opportunity. （应用文·通知/提醒）

In an increasingly unforgiving job market, where employers demand both experience and adaptability from the young, the ability to keep learning has become not a luxury but a means of survival. （议论文·就业/成长）

Her grandmother, gentle in most things, remained strangely unforgiving of laziness, and one lazy afternoon under her stern gaze taught the girl more about discipline than a year of lectures ever could. （读后续写·人物性格）

collocations.translation: 严酷、毫不容情的环境／地形【课堂核心搭配】
collocations.example: Only the toughest plants survive in such an unforgiving environment. 只有最坚韧的植物才能在如此严酷的环境中存活。

collocations.translation: 对错误毫不宽容、不容出错【核心：be unforgiving of sth】
collocations.example: Live broadcasting is unforgiving of the smallest error. 直播不容许有丝毫差错。

collocations.translation: 严酷而不留情面的【课堂高频并列】
collocations.example: The Arctic winter is harsh and unforgiving. 北极的冬天严酷而无情。
The settlers had never imagined an unforgiving winter so fierce that the river froze solid and their crops withered overnight. （读后续写·历史/移民）

collocations.translation: 紧张苛刻、令人喘不过气的日程／节奏
collocations.example: The athletes endured an unforgiving training schedule, rising before dawn and pushing their bodies to the very edge of exhaustion. （读后续写·励志）
In today's unforgiving competition, only those who dare to innovate and refuse to give up can hope to stand out. （议论文·竞争）

collocations.translation: 严厉不容情的目光／神情
collocations.example: Under the coach's unforgiving glare, the boy swallowed his excuses and quietly picked up the ball again. （读后续写·人物神态）
The elite academy was unforgiving of weakness, yet it was precisely there that she discovered how much strength she truly had. （读后续写·成长）

synonyms.example: The harsh landscape of the plateau tested every ounce of the explorers' endurance. （读后续写·探险）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：最常用、最通用的'严酷/严厉'，可形容环境、气候、批评、待遇、声音等；典型搭配 harsh criticism / harsh conditions；unforgiving 更强调'不容出错、毫无余地、一错就付代价'这一层，语气更集中

synonyms.example: The merciless sun beat down on the marchers, yet not one of them turned back. （读后续写·意志考验）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：字面'无怜悯之心'(mercy 慈悲)，情感色彩最强，多形容人或拟人化的自然力量'绝不手软'；unforgiving 侧重'不给犯错/退路的机会'，可用于中性描述环境的苛刻，主观情绪弱一些

synonyms.example: The relentless questioning of the reporters left the exhausted official with nowhere to hide. （议论文·舆论）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：核心义'持续不停、毫不松懈'，多形容压力、追问、努力、进攻；典型搭配 relentless pressure / relentless pursuit；unforgiving 强调'不容失误、一错定输'，两者可搭配但侧重不同

synonyms.translation: 毫不松懈的；持续严酷的
synonyms.example: Through the unrelenting storm the fishermen clung to the mast, praying for the first grey light of dawn. （读后续写·海难）
synonyms.usage: 辨析④：与 relentless 近义，强调力度或强度'持续不减弱、不放松'；unforgiving 更突出'对错误零容忍、无退路'的性质，落点在'不容错'而非'不停歇'

advancedExpressions.expression: un-(否定前缀) + forgive(v. 原谅) + -ing(形容词后缀) → unforgiving = not forgiving 不宽容的/不容错的；同理 forgiving(adj. 宽容的)、unforgivable(adj. 不可原谅的)
advancedExpressions.example: 拆词记忆：un(不) + forgiv(e)(原谅) + ing(...的) = '不肯原谅的、毫不留情的'。对比 forgiving(宽容的) 与 unforgivable(罪不可恕的)。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·forgive 词族全家桶
advancedExpressions.expression: forgive(vt. 原谅) → forgave → forgiven | forgiveness(n. 宽恕) | forgiving(adj. 宽容的) / unforgiving(adj. 不宽容的、严酷的) | forgivable(adj. 可原谅的) / unforgivable(adj. 不可原谅的) | unforgivably(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: A forgiving heart offers forgiveness; an unforgiving world offers none. 一颗宽容的心给予宽恕，一个严酷的世界却毫不留情。（一句串起 forgiving / forgiveness / unforgiving）

advancedExpressions.expression: an unforgiving environment/terrain/climate 严酷环境 | unforgiving of mistakes/failure/weakness 不容错/不容失败 | harsh and unforgiving 严酷无情 | an unforgiving glare 严厉的目光
advancedExpressions.example: In an unforgiving environment that is unforgiving of the smallest mistake, only the well-prepared survive. 在一个不容丝毫差错的严酷环境里，只有准备充分者才能存活。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'严酷/不留情'
advancedExpressions.expression: unforgiving = harsh / merciless / relentless / brutal / leaving no room for error（不容出错）
advancedExpressions.example: 写作升级：把 'a very hard and dangerous place' 升级为 'a harsh and unforgiving landscape that leaves no room for error'. 使环境描写更有张力。

advancedExpressions.expression: in that unforgiving ..., every ... became a battle
advancedExpressions.example: In that unforgiving wilderness, every step became a battle and every breath a small victory wrested from the biting wind. （用环境的'不容情'反衬人物意志，续写起承段烘托）

advancedExpressions.expression: given how unforgiving ... is, it is advisable that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Given how unforgiving the qualifying round is, it is advisable that every contestant prepare thoroughly and leave nothing to chance. （given + it is advisable that 建议句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being a curse, an unforgiving ... can forge ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being a curse, an unforgiving environment can forge in the young a resilience and self-discipline that comfort alone could never cultivate. （far from 转折+can forge 抽象升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The mountain was very dangerous and hard to climb.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mountain rose before them, cold and unforgiving, its sheer cliffs offering neither foothold nor mercy to those bold enough to challenge its heights. （读后续写·环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化(offering neither foothold nor mercy) + cold and unforgiving 双形容词铺陈 + those bold enough to 定语后置增强气势

sentenceUpgrade.original: The competition is very tough, so students must work hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Because the competition ahead is so unforgiving that it rewards only the truly prepared, students would be wise to treat every ordinary day as a chance to sharpen the edge that will one day set them apart. （议论文·励志）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: so ... that 结果状语从句 + would be wise to 委婉建议 + sharpen the edge 隐喻 + that 定语从句收束升华

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（unforgiving / forgiving）：Live surgery is ____ of the smallest mistake, for a surgeon's momentary lapse can never be undone.
classPractice.note: 语境强调'不容出错、一错无法挽回'，故选 unforgiving（不容错的）；forgiving 意为'宽容的'，语义相反

classPractice.question: The desert was harsh and ____ (forgive), sparing no one who dared to underestimate it.
classPractice.note: 考 un- + forgive + -ing 构词；此处需形容词'严酷不容情的'

classPractice.question: 远非一种诅咒，严酷的环境反而能锻造出年轻人的坚韧。____ ____ being a curse, an unforgiving environment can ____ resilience in the young.
classPractice.note: far from being a curse 远非…；forge 锻造（此处及物动词，宾语 resilience）

classPractice.question: 鉴于这轮资格赛是出了名的严酷，建议每位选手都做好充分准备，不留任何侥幸。（unforgiving / it is advisable that）
classPractice.answer: Given how unforgiving the qualifying round is, it is advisable that every contestant (should) prepare thoroughly and leave nothing to chance.
classPractice.note: 考 given how + adj + sth is 结构与 it is advisable that + (should) do 虚拟语气
